`cli/src/diff.rs`:

```rs
//! `diff`: two captures, draw by draw. Draws are matched by an identity that survives a relaunch of the game (resource
//! numbers do not): their shaders, the call and its counts (not its offsets into shared buffers), what they read by
//! its upload hash (or its shape, for what has none: targets, dynamic buffers), the shapes of their targets, and how
//! many draws with that identity came before. Matched draws are compared constant by constant (named from the
//! shaders), texture by texture and state by state.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

use locum_capture::hash::KeyHasher;

use crate::describe::{Reflection, float, shape};
use crate::draws::shader_of;
use crate::open::Capture;
use crate::out;

/// A draw's identity, readable.
fn identity(c: &Capture, n: i64) -> String {
    let (call, args, shaders): (String, String, Vec<Option<String>>) = c
        .row(
            "SELECT call, args, vs, hs, ds, gs, ps, cs FROM draws WHERE n = ?1",
            [n],
            |r| {
                Ok((
                    r.get(0)?,
                    r.get(1)?,
                    (2..8).map(|i| r.get(i)).collect::<rusqlite::Result<_>>()?,
                ))
            },
        )
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let args: Vec<i64> = serde_json::from_str(&args).unwrap_or_default();
    // The counts, not the offsets: vertices or indices, instances, thread groups.
    let counts: Vec<i64> = match call.as_str() {
        "Draw" | "DrawIndexed" => args.iter().take(1).copied().collect(),
        "DrawInstanced" | "DrawIndexedInstanced" => args.iter().take(2).copied().collect(),
        "Dispatch" => args.clone(),
        _ => Vec::new(),
    };
    let mut parts = vec![format!("{call} {counts:?}")];
    for (s, h) in ["vs", "hs", "ds", "gs", "ps", "cs"].iter().zip(&shaders) {
        if let Some(h) = h {
            parts.push(format!("{s}={h}"));
        }
    }
    type Bound = (String, String, i64, Option<i64>, Option<String>, bool);
    let bound: Vec<Bound> = c.rows(
        "SELECT b.stage, b.kind, b.slot, b.resource, r.upload, coalesce(r.written, 0) FROM bindings b \
         LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = b.resource WHERE b.draw = ?1 AND b.kind IN ('srv', 'vb', 'ib', 'rtv', 'dsv') \
         ORDER BY b.stage, b.kind, b.slot",
        [n],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?, r.get(4)?, r.get(5)?)),
    );
    for (stage, kind, slot, resource, upload, written) in bound {
        let what = match (upload, written, kind.as_str()) {
            (Some(u), false, "srv" | "vb" | "ib") => u,
            _ => resource
                .and_then(|r| shape(c, r))
                .map(|s| {
                    let text = s.to_string();
                    text.split_once(' ')
                        .map_or(text.clone(), |(_, rest)| rest.to_string())
                })
                .unwrap_or_default(),
        };
        parts.push(format!("{stage}.{kind}{slot}={what}"));
    }
    parts.join(" ")
}

/// Every draw keyed by its identity and how many draws with that identity came before it.
fn keyed(c: &Capture) -> Vec<(String, i64)> {
    let mut seen: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    c.rows("SELECT n FROM draws ORDER BY n", [], |r| r.get::<_, i64>(0))
        .into_iter()
        .map(|n| {
            let id = identity(c, n);
            let mut h = KeyHasher::new();
            h.update(id.as_bytes());
            let k = seen.entry(id).or_default();
            *k += 1;
            (format!("{}#{}", h.finish(), *k - 1), n)
        })
        .collect()
}

/// What differs between draw `a` of `ca` and draw `b` of `cb`, a line each, keyed by what it is about.
fn differences(ca: &Capture, a: i64, cb: &Capture, b: i64, ra: &mut Reflection) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    // Constant buffers, register by register.
    type Cbs = BTreeMap<(String, i64), (Option<Vec<u8>>, i64)>;
    let cbs = |c: &Capture, n: i64| -> Cbs {
        c.rows(
            "SELECT b.stage, b.slot, d.bytes, b.space FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN cb_data d ON d.hash = b.content \
             WHERE b.draw = ?1 AND b.kind = 'cb'",
            [n],
            |r| Ok(((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?), (r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?))),
        )
        .into_iter()
        .collect()
    };
    let (xa, xb) = (cbs(ca, a), cbs(cb, b));
    for (k, (bytes_a, space)) in &xa {
        let Some((bytes_b, _)) = xb.get(k) else {
            out.push((format!("{} b{}", k.0, k.1), "bound only in the first".into()));
            continue;
        };
        let (Some(p), Some(q)) = (bytes_a, bytes_b) else {
            continue;
        };
        if p == q {
            continue;
        }
        let shader = shader_of(ca, a, &k.0);
        let refl = shader
            .as_deref()
            .and_then(|s| ra.cb(ca, s, k.1 as u32, *space as u32));
        for (i, (x, y)) in p
            .as_chunks::<4>()
            .0
            .iter()
            .zip(q.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter())
            .enumerate()
        {
            if x == y {
                continue;
            }
            let at = i as u32 * 4;
            let name = refl
                .and_then(|r| r.name_at(at))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("c{}.{}", at / 16, ["x", "y", "z", "w"][(at % 16 / 4) as usize]));
            out.push((
                format!("{} b{} {name}", k.0, k.1),
                format!(
                    "{} -> {}",
                    float(f32::from_le_bytes(*x)),
                    float(f32::from_le_bytes(*y))
                ),
            ));
        }
        if p.len() != q.len() {
            out.push((
                format!("{} b{}", k.0, k.1),
                format!("{} bytes -> {} bytes", p.len(), q.len()),
            ));
        }
    }
    // Textures and buffers read, by their contents as the frame began.
    let inputs = |c: &Capture, n: i64| -> BTreeMap<(String, String, i64), Option<String>> {
        c.rows(
            "SELECT b.stage, b.kind, b.slot, r.content FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = b.resource \
             WHERE b.draw = ?1 AND b.kind IN ('srv', 'vb', 'ib') AND coalesce(r.written, 0) = 0",
            [n],
            |r| Ok(((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?), r.get(3)?)),
        )
        .into_iter()
        .collect()
    };
    let (ia, ib) = (inputs(ca, a), inputs(cb, b));
    for (k, x) in &ia {
        if let Some(y) = ib.get(k)
            && x != y
        {
            out.push((
                format!("{} {}{}", k.0, k.1, k.2),
                format!(
                    "contents {} -> {}",
                    x.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
                    y.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
                ),
            ));
        }
    }
    // Fixed-function state, by its description.
    let state = |c: &Capture, n: i64| -> Vec<(String, Option<String>)> {
        c.rows(
            "SELECT s.kind, s.json FROM draws d JOIN states s ON s.id IN (d.rasterizer, d.blend, d.depth_stencil) \
             WHERE d.n = ?1 ORDER BY s.kind",
            [n],
            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
        )
    };
    let (sa, sb) = (state(ca, a), state(cb, b));
    for (x, y) in sa.iter().zip(&sb) {
        if x.0 == y.0 && x.1 != y.1 {
            out.push((
                x.0.clone(),
                format!(
                    "{} -> {}",
                    x.1.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
                    y.1.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
                ),
            ));
        }
    }
    let viewport = |c: &Capture, n: i64| -> Vec<String> {
        c.rows(
            "SELECT x || ',' || y || ' ' || width || 'x' || height FROM viewports WHERE draw = ?1 ORDER BY i",
            [n],
            |r| r.get(0),
        )
    };
    let (va, vb) = (viewport(ca, a), viewport(cb, b));
    if va != vb {
        out.push((
            "viewport".into(),
            format!("{} -> {}", va.join("; "), vb.join("; ")),
        ));
    }
    out
}

pub fn diff(ca: &Capture, cb: &Capture, draws: bool, limit: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    let ka = keyed(ca);
    let kb = keyed(cb);
    let index_b: HashMap<&str, i64> = kb.iter().map(|(k, n)| (k.as_str(), *n)).collect();
    let index_a: HashMap<&str, i64> = ka.iter().map(|(k, n)| (k.as_str(), *n)).collect();
    let only_a: Vec<i64> = ka
        .iter()
        .filter(|(k, _)| !index_b.contains_key(k.as_str()))
        .map(|x| x.1)
        .collect();
    let only_b: Vec<i64> = kb
        .iter()
        .filter(|(k, _)| !index_a.contains_key(k.as_str()))
        .map(|x| x.1)
        .collect();
    let pairs: Vec<(i64, i64)> = ka
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|(k, a)| index_b.get(k.as_str()).map(|b| (*a, *b)))
        .collect();
    out!(
        "{} draws in the first, {} in the second: {} matched, {} only in the first, {} only in the second",
        ka.len(),
        kb.len(),
        pairs.len(),
        only_a.len(),
        only_b.len()
    );
    let mut reflection = Reflection::default();
    // What differs, and in which draws.
    let mut by_what: BTreeMap<String, (usize, (i64, i64, String))> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut changed = 0;
    for &(a, b) in &pairs {
        let d = differences(ca, a, cb, b, &mut reflection);
        if d.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        changed += 1;
        if draws {
            out!(
                "draw {a} -> {b}: {}",
                identity(ca, a).split(' ').take(3).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
            );
            for (what, how) in d.iter().take(limit) {
                out!("    {what}: {how}");
            }
            if d.len() > limit {
                out!("    ... {} more", d.len() - limit);
            }
        }
        for (what, how) in d {
            let e = by_what.entry(what).or_insert((0, (a, b, how)));
            e.0 += 1;
        }
    }
    out!("{changed} matched draws differ");
    if !by_what.is_empty() {
        out!("what differs, in how many draws (with the first):");
        let mut rows: Vec<_> = by_what.into_iter().collect();
        rows.sort_by_key(|r| std::cmp::Reverse(r.1.0));
        for (what, (count, (a, b, how))) in rows.iter().take(limit) {
            out!("  {count:>6}  {what}: {how} (draw {a} -> {b})");
        }
        if rows.len() > limit {
            out!("  ... {} more (--limit)", rows.len() - limit);
        }
    }
    let list = |label: &str, c: &Capture, ns: &[i64]| {
        if ns.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        out!("only in the {label}:");
        for n in ns.iter().take(limit) {
            out!(
                "  draw {n}: {}",
                identity(c, *n).split(' ').take(4).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
            );
        }
        if ns.len() > limit {
            out!("  ... {} more", ns.len() - limit);
        }
    };
    list("first", ca, &only_a);
    list("second", cb, &only_b);
    Ok(())
}

```

`cli/src/draws.rs`:

```rs
//! `draws`, `draw`, `cb`, `find` and `passes`: the frame's draws and dispatches, what each had bound, and its
//! constants by name.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

use locum_capture::format;
use rusqlite::types::Value;

use crate::describe::{self, Reflection, STAGE_ORDER, register_name, shape, short, value};
use crate::open::Capture;
use crate::out;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Filter {
    pub vs: Option<String>,
    pub ps: Option<String>,
    pub cs: Option<String>,
    pub shader: Option<String>,
    pub pass: Option<i64>,
    pub uses: Option<i64>,
    pub target: Option<i64>,
    pub content: Option<String>,
    pub call: Option<String>,
}

const SHADER_COLUMNS: [&str; 6] = ["vs", "hs", "ds", "gs", "ps", "cs"];

pub fn draws(c: &Capture, f: &Filter) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut wh: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut params: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut param = |v: Value| {
        params.push(v);
        format!("?{}", params.len())
    };
    for (col, v) in [("vs", &f.vs), ("ps", &f.ps), ("cs", &f.cs)] {
        if let Some(v) = v {
            wh.push(format!("d.{col} LIKE {} || '%'", param(Value::Text(v.clone()))));
        }
    }
    if let Some(v) = &f.shader {
        let p = param(Value::Text(v.clone()));
        let any: Vec<String> = SHADER_COLUMNS
            .iter()
            .map(|s| format!("d.{s} LIKE {p} || '%'"))
            .collect();
        wh.push(format!("({})", any.join(" OR ")));
    }
    if let Some(p) = f.pass {
        wh.push(format!("d.pass = {}", param(Value::Integer(p))));
    }
    if let Some(r) = f.uses {
        wh.push(format!(
            "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bindings b WHERE b.draw = d.n AND b.resource = {})",
            param(Value::Integer(r))
        ));
    }
    if let Some(r) = f.target {
        wh.push(format!(
            "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bindings b WHERE b.draw = d.n AND b.kind IN ('rtv', 'dsv') AND b.resource = {})",
            param(Value::Integer(r))
        ));
    }
    if let Some(k) = &f.content {
        let p = param(Value::Text(k.clone()));
        wh.push(format!(
            "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = b.resource WHERE b.draw = d.n AND \
             (b.content LIKE {p} || '%' OR r.content LIKE {p} || '%' OR r.upload LIKE {p} || '%'))"
        ));
    }
    if let Some(call) = &f.call {
        wh.push(format!("d.call LIKE {}", param(Value::Text(call.clone()))));
    }
    let sql = format!(
        "SELECT d.n, d.pass, d.call, d.args, e.deferred, e.list, d.vs, d.ps, d.cs FROM draws d \
         JOIN events e ON e.seq = d.event {} ORDER BY d.n",
        if wh.is_empty() {
            String::new()
        } else {
            format!("WHERE {}", wh.join(" AND "))
        }
    );
    type Row = (
        i64,
        Option<i64>,
        String,
        String,
        bool,
        Option<i64>,
        [Option<String>; 3],
    );
    let rows: Vec<Row> = c.rows(&sql, rusqlite::params_from_iter(params), |r| {
        Ok((
            r.get(0)?,
            r.get(1)?,
            r.get(2)?,
            r.get(3)?,
            r.get(4)?,
            r.get(5)?,
            [r.get(6)?, r.get(7)?, r.get(8)?],
        ))
    });
    out!(
        "{:>5} {:>4} {:<26} {:<8} {:<16} {:<16} targets",
        "draw",
        "pass",
        "call",
        "context",
        "vs (cs)",
        "ps"
    );
    for (n, pass, call, args, deferred, list, [vs, ps, cs]) in &rows {
        let targets: Vec<String> = c.rows(
            "SELECT kind, slot, resource FROM bindings WHERE draw = ?1 AND kind IN ('rtv', 'dsv', 'uav') \
             ORDER BY kind DESC, slot",
            [n],
            |r| {
                let (kind, slot, res): (String, i64, Option<i64>) = (r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?);
                let name = match kind.as_str() {
                    "rtv" => format!("rt{slot}"),
                    "dsv" => "depth".into(),
                    _ => format!("u{slot}"),
                };
                Ok(format!("{name} #{}", res.unwrap_or(-1)))
            },
        );
        let context = match (deferred, list) {
            (true, Some(l)) => format!("list {l}"),
            (true, None) => "list".into(),
            _ => "imm".into(),
        };
        let first = cs.as_ref().or(vs.as_ref());
        out!(
            "{n:>5} {:>4} {:<26} {context:<8} {:<16} {:<16} {}",
            pass.map_or("-".into(), |p| p.to_string()),
            format!("{call} {args}"),
            first.map_or("-", String::as_str),
            ps.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
            targets.join(" ")
        );
    }
    out!("{} draws", rows.len());
    Ok(())
}

struct Binding {
    stage: String,
    kind: String,
    slot: u32,
    space: u32,
    view: Option<i64>,
    resource: Option<i64>,
    state: Option<i64>,
    offset: Option<i64>,
    size: Option<i64>,
    stride: Option<i64>,
    format: Option<i64>,
    content: Option<String>,
}

fn bindings(c: &Capture, draw: i64) -> Vec<Binding> {
    c.rows(
        &format!(
            "SELECT stage, kind, slot, space, view, resource, state, offset, size, stride, format, content \
             FROM bindings WHERE draw = ?1 ORDER BY {STAGE_ORDER}, kind, slot"
        ),
        [draw],
        |r| {
            Ok(Binding {
                stage: r.get(0)?,
                kind: r.get(1)?,
                slot: r.get::<_, i64>(2)? as u32,
                space: r.get::<_, i64>(3)? as u32,
                view: r.get(4)?,
                resource: r.get(5)?,
                state: r.get(6)?,
                offset: r.get(7)?,
                size: r.get(8)?,
                stride: r.get(9)?,
                format: r.get(10)?,
                content: r.get(11)?,
            })
        },
    )
}

/// The shader a draw had bound at `stage`.
pub fn shader_of(c: &Capture, draw: i64, stage: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if !SHADER_COLUMNS.contains(&stage) {
        return None;
    }
    c.row(&format!("SELECT {stage} FROM draws WHERE n = ?1"), [draw], |r| {
        r.get(0)
    })
    .flatten()
}

fn state_json(c: &Capture, id: i64) -> String {
    c.row("SELECT kind, json FROM states WHERE id = ?1", [id], |r| {
        Ok(format!(
            "{} {}",
            r.get::<_, String>(0)?,
            r.get::<_, Option<String>>(1)?.unwrap_or_default()
        ))
    })
    .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into())
}

pub fn draw(c: &Capture, n: i64, all: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
    type Head = (
        i64,
        String,
        String,
        Option<i64>,
        bool,
        Option<i64>,
        i64,
        Option<i64>,
    );
    let head: Head = c
        .row(
            "SELECT d.event, d.call, d.args, d.pass, e.deferred, e.list, e.context, e.stack FROM draws d \
             JOIN events e ON e.seq = d.event WHERE d.n = ?1",
            [n],
            |r| {
                Ok((
                    r.get(0)?,
                    r.get(1)?,
                    r.get(2)?,
                    r.get(3)?,
                    r.get(4)?,
                    r.get(5)?,
                    r.get(6)?,
                    r.get(7)?,
                ))
            },
        )
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("no draw {n}"))?;
    let (event, call, args, pass, deferred, list, context, stack) = head;
    let place = if deferred {
        format!(
            "command list {} (recorded on context {context})",
            list.map_or("?".into(), |l| l.to_string())
        )
    } else {
        "the immediate context".into()
    };
    out!(
        "draw {n}: {call} {args}, event {event}, pass {}, on {place}",
        pass.map_or("-".into(), |p| p.to_string())
    );
    if let Some(s) = stack {
        let frames = describe::stack(c, s);
        out!(
            "  called from {}",
            frames.iter().take(4).cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" < ")
        );
    }

    let shaders: Vec<Option<String>> = c
        .row(
            "SELECT vs, hs, ds, gs, ps, cs FROM draws WHERE n = ?1",
            [n],
            |r| (0..6).map(|i| r.get(i)).collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>(),
        )
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let named: Vec<String> = SHADER_COLUMNS
        .iter()
        .zip(&shaders)
        .filter_map(|(s, h)| h.as_ref().map(|h| format!("{s} {h}")))
        .collect();
    out!("shaders: {}", named.join("  "));

    type Fixed = (
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<String>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
        Option<i64>,
    );
    let fixed: Fixed = c
        .row(
            "SELECT topology, layout, rasterizer, blend, depth_stencil, blend_factor, sample_mask, stencil_ref, \
             predicate, predicate_value FROM draws WHERE n = ?1",
            [n],
            |r| {
                Ok((
                    r.get(0)?,
                    r.get(1)?,
                    r.get(2)?,
                    r.get(3)?,
                    r.get(4)?,
                    r.get(5)?,
                    r.get(6)?,
                    r.get(7)?,
                    r.get(8)?,
                    r.get(9)?,
                ))
            },
        )
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let (topology, layout, raster, blend, depth, factor, mask, stencil_ref, predicate, predicate_value) =
        fixed;
    if let Some(t) = topology {
        out!("topology: {t}");
    }
    for (name, id) in [
        ("input layout", layout),
        ("rasterizer", raster),
        ("blend", blend),
        ("depth-stencil", depth),
    ] {
        if let Some(id) = id {
            out!("{name} #{id}: {}", state_json(c, id));
        }
    }
    if blend.is_some() || factor.is_some() {
        out!(
            "blend factor {}, sample mask 0x{:x}",
            factor.unwrap_or_default(),
            mask.unwrap_or(-1) as u32
        );
    }
    if depth.is_some() {
        out!("stencil ref {}", stencil_ref.unwrap_or(0));
    }
    if let Some(p) = predicate {
        out!("predicate #{p}, drawn when {}", predicate_value.unwrap_or(0) != 0);
    }
    let viewports: Vec<String> = c.rows(
        "SELECT i, x, y, width, height, min_depth, max_depth FROM viewports WHERE draw = ?1 ORDER BY i",
        [n],
        |r| {
            Ok(format!(
                "{}: {},{} {}x{} depth {}..{}",
                r.get::<_, i64>(0)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(1)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(2)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(3)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(4)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(5)?,
                r.get::<_, f64>(6)?
            ))
        },
    );
    if !viewports.is_empty() {
        out!("viewports: {}", viewports.join("; "));
    }
    let scissors: Vec<String> = c.rows(
        "SELECT i, left, top, right, bottom FROM scissors WHERE draw = ?1 ORDER BY i",
        [n],
        |r| {
            Ok(format!(
                "{}: ({}, {})-({}, {})",
                r.get::<_, i64>(0)?,
                r.get::<_, i64>(1)?,
                r.get::<_, i64>(2)?,
                r.get::<_, i64>(3)?,
                r.get::<_, i64>(4)?
            ))
        },
    );
    if !scissors.is_empty() {
        out!("scissors: {}", scissors.join("; "));
    }

    out!("bound:");
    let list = bindings(c, n);
    for b in &list {
        let mut line = format!("  {} {}{}", b.stage, b.kind, b.slot);
        if b.space != 0 {
            line += &format!(" space {}", b.space);
        }
        if let Some(v) = b.view {
            line += &format!(" view #{v}");
            if let Some(json) = c
                .row("SELECT json FROM views WHERE id = ?1", [v], |r| {
                    r.get::<_, Option<String>>(0)
                })
                .flatten()
                && let Ok(j) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&json)
            {
                let f = j["format"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                line += &format!(" ({} {}", j["dimension"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), format::name(f));
                if let Some(r) = j["range"].as_object().filter(|r| !r.is_empty()) {
                    line += &format!(" {}", serde_json::Value::Object(r.clone()));
                }
                line += ")";
            }
        }
        if let Some(s) = b.state {
            line += &format!(" {}", state_json(c, s));
        }
        if let Some(r) = b.resource {
            match shape(c, r) {
                Some(s) => line += &format!(" -> {s}"),
                None => line += &format!(" -> #{r}"),
            }
            if let Some(m) = c.names.of(c, r) {
                line += &format!(" = {}", m.file.name);
            }
        }
        if let Some(o) = b.offset.filter(|&o| o != 0) {
            line += &format!(" offset {o}");
        }
        if b.kind == "cb"
            && let Some(sz) = b.size
        {
            line += &format!(" size {sz}");
        }
        if let Some(st) = b.stride {
            line += &format!(" stride {st}");
        }
        if let Some(f) = b.format {
            line += &format!(" {}", format::name(f as u32));
        }
        if let Some(r) = b.resource
            && b.kind != "cb"
        {
            let src: Option<(Option<String>, Option<String>)> = c.row(
                "SELECT content, content_source FROM resources WHERE id = ?1",
                [r],
                |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
            );
            if let Some((Some(key), source)) = src {
                line += &format!("  contents {} ({})", short(&key), source.unwrap_or_default());
            }
            // Written earlier in the frame: its contents at this draw are not those of the frame's start.
            let earlier: Option<i64> = c
                .row(
                    "SELECT max(event) FROM event_resources WHERE resource = ?1 AND access = 'write' AND event < ?2",
                    [r, event],
                    |r| r.get(0),
                )
                .flatten();
            if let Some(e) = earlier {
                line += &format!(", last written at event {e}");
            }
        }
        out!("{line}");
    }

    let mut reflection = Reflection::default();
    for b in list.iter().filter(|b| b.kind == "cb") {
        constants(c, &mut reflection, n, b, all)?;
    }

    let targets: Vec<(String, Option<String>, i64, i64, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT target, blob, width, height, format FROM targets WHERE draw = ?1",
        [n],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?, r.get(4)?)),
    );
    for (t, blob, w, h, f) in targets {
        out!(
            "after it, {t} read back: {w}x{h} {} {}",
            format::name(f as u32),
            blob.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Prints a bound constant buffer register by register, with names from the shader's reflection. Without `all`,
/// only the registers holding variables the shader uses.
fn constants(
    c: &Capture,
    reflection: &mut Reflection,
    draw: i64,
    b: &Binding,
    all: bool,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let Some(key) = &b.content else {
        out!("{} b{}: contents not captured", b.stage, b.slot);
        return Ok(());
    };
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = c
        .row("SELECT bytes FROM cb_data WHERE hash = ?1", [key], |r| r.get(0))
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("constant buffer contents {key} missing"))?;
    let shader = shader_of(c, draw, &b.stage);
    let cb = shader
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|s| reflection.cb(c, s, b.slot, b.space));
    out!(
        "{} b{} ({}, {} bytes{}):",
        b.stage,
        b.slot,
        cb.map_or("no reflection".into(), |cb| cb.name.clone()),
        bytes.len(),
        b.resource.map_or(String::new(), |r| format!(", buffer #{r}"))
    );
    let used: Vec<(u32, u32)> = cb
        .map(|cb| {
            cb.variables
                .iter()
                .filter(|v| v.used)
                .map(|v| (v.offset, v.offset + v.size))
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let mut skipped = 0;
    for (r, reg) in bytes.chunks(16).enumerate() {
        let at = r as u32 * 16;
        let show = all || cb.is_none() || used.iter().any(|&(a, e)| a < at + 16 && at < e);
        if !show {
            skipped += 1;
            continue;
        }
        let mut names: [Option<String>; 4] = Default::default();
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        for (i, word) in reg.chunks(4).enumerate() {
            let named = cb.and_then(|cb| cb.at(at + i as u32 * 4));
            let base = named.as_ref().map(|n| n.1);
            names[i] = named.map(|n| n.0);
            let mut w = [0u8; 4];
            w[..word.len()].copy_from_slice(word);
            values.push(value(w, base));
        }
        out!(
            "  c{r:<4}{:<53}  {}",
            values.iter().map(|v| format!(" {v:>12}")).collect::<String>(),
            register_name(&names)
        );
    }
    if skipped > 0 {
        out!("  ({skipped} registers the shader does not use; --all shows them)");
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn cb(c: &Capture, draw: i64, stage: &str, slot: u32, raw: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
    let b = bindings(c, draw)
        .into_iter()
        .find(|b| b.kind == "cb" && b.stage == stage && b.slot == slot)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("draw {draw} has no {stage} b{slot}"))?;
    if raw {
        let key = b.content.ok_or("contents not captured")?;
        let bytes: Vec<u8> = c
            .row("SELECT bytes FROM cb_data WHERE hash = ?1", [&key], |r| r.get(0))
            .ok_or("contents missing")?;
        for (i, row) in bytes.chunks(16).enumerate() {
            let hex: Vec<String> = row.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
            out!("{:6x}  {}", i * 16, hex.join(" "));
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    constants(c, &mut Reflection::default(), draw, &b, true)
}

/// Draws whose bound constants hold `target` (as a float, or an integer with `int`).
pub fn find(c: &Capture, target: f64, tolerance: f64, int: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
    let data: Vec<(String, Vec<u8>)> = c.rows("SELECT hash, bytes FROM cb_data", [], |r| {
        Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?))
    });
    let mut hits: HashMap<String, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();
    for (key, bytes) in &data {
        for (i, &w) in bytes.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter().enumerate() {
            let matched = if int {
                f64::from(i32::from_le_bytes(w)) == target || f64::from(u32::from_le_bytes(w)) == target
            } else {
                let v = f64::from(f32::from_le_bytes(w));
                (v - target).abs() <= tolerance * target.abs().max(1.0)
            };
            if matched {
                hits.entry(key.clone()).or_default().push(i as u32 * 4);
            }
        }
    }
    if hits.is_empty() {
        out!("no bound constant holds {target}");
        return Ok(());
    }
    let mut reflection = Reflection::default();
    // (stage, slot, shader, offset, name) -> draws
    let mut found: BTreeMap<(String, u32, String, u32, String), Vec<i64>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (key, offsets) in &hits {
        let users: Vec<(i64, String, i64, i64)> = c.rows(
            "SELECT draw, stage, slot, space FROM bindings WHERE kind = 'cb' AND content = ?1",
            [key],
            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?)),
        );
        for (draw, stage, slot, space) in users {
            let shader = shader_of(c, draw, &stage).unwrap_or_default();
            for &o in offsets {
                let name = reflection
                    .cb(c, &shader, slot as u32, space as u32)
                    .and_then(|cb| cb.name_at(o))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into());
                found
                    .entry((stage.clone(), slot as u32, shader.clone(), o, name))
                    .or_default()
                    .push(draw);
            }
        }
    }
    out!(
        "{:<4} {:<5} {:<16} {:<10} {:<40} draws",
        "stage",
        "slot",
        "shader",
        "register",
        "name"
    );
    for ((stage, slot, shader, o, name), mut draws) in found {
        draws.sort_unstable();
        draws.dedup();
        let listed: Vec<String> = draws.iter().take(12).map(i64::to_string).collect();
        out!(
            "{stage:<5} b{slot:<4} {shader:<16} c{}.{:<8} {name:<40} {}{}",
            o / 16,
            ["x", "y", "z", "w"][(o % 16 / 4) as usize],
            listed.join(" "),
            if draws.len() > 12 {
                format!(" ... ({} draws)", draws.len())
            } else {
                String::new()
            }
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn passes(c: &Capture) -> Result<(), String> {
    let rows: Vec<(i64, i64, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT n, first_draw, last_draw FROM passes ORDER BY n",
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?)),
    );
    out!("{:>4} {:>11} {:>5}  targets", "pass", "draws", "count");
    for (n, first, last) in rows {
        let targets: Vec<String> = c.rows(
            "SELECT kind, slot, resource FROM bindings WHERE draw = ?1 AND kind IN ('rtv', 'dsv') ORDER BY kind DESC, slot",
            [first],
            |r| Ok((r.get::<_, String>(0)?, r.get::<_, i64>(1)?, r.get::<_, Option<i64>>(2)?)),
        )
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(kind, slot, res)| {
            let name = if kind == "dsv" { "depth".to_string() } else { format!("rt{slot}") };
            let s = res.and_then(|r| shape(c, r)).map_or("?".into(), |s| s.to_string());
            format!("{name} {s}")
        })
        .collect();
        let count = c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM draws WHERE pass = ?1", [n]);
        out!(
            "{n:>4} {:>11} {count:>5}  {}",
            format!("{first}-{last}"),
            targets.join(", ")
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

`cli/src/export.rs`:

```rs
//! `export`, `target` and `blob`: contents out of the store as DDS, PNG or raw bytes.

use std::path::Path;

use locum_capture::dds::{self, Texture};
use locum_capture::format;
use locum_capture::texels::{self, Range};

use crate::describe::shape;
use crate::open::Capture;
use crate::out;

/// What to write, from the output file's extension.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Kind {
    Dds,
    Png,
    Raw,
}

fn kind_of(out: &Path) -> Kind {
    match out
        .extension()
        .map(|e| e.to_string_lossy().to_ascii_lowercase())
        .as_deref()
    {
        Some("dds") => Kind::Dds,
        Some("png") => Kind::Png,
        _ => Kind::Raw,
    }
}

pub fn png(path: &Path, width: u32, height: u32, rgba: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let file = std::fs::File::create(path).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    let mut encoder = png::Encoder::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(file), width, height);
    encoder.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgba);
    encoder.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
    let mut writer = encoder.write_header().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    writer.write_image_data(rgba).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    writer.finish().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn write(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::write(path, bytes).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))
}

pub struct Which {
    pub sub: Option<u32>,
    pub mip: u32,
    pub slice: u32,
    /// The depth slice of a volume, for PNG.
    pub z: u32,
    /// The upload instead of the contents as the frame began.
    pub upload: bool,
}

pub fn export(c: &Capture, id: i64, out_path: &Path, which: &Which, range: Range) -> Result<(), String> {
    let s = shape(c, id).ok_or_else(|| format!("no resource #{id}"))?;
    let column = if which.upload { "upload" } else { "content" };
    let key: String = c
        .row(
            &format!("SELECT {column} FROM resources WHERE id = ?1"),
            [id],
            |r| r.get::<_, Option<String>>(0),
        )
        .flatten()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("#{id} has no {column} in this capture"))?;
    let bytes = c.blob(&key)?;
    let subs = s.subs();
    if subs.is_empty() {
        return Err(format!("{} has no layout locum knows", format::name(s.format)));
    }
    let total = locum_capture::layout::total(&subs);
    if bytes.len() as u64 != total {
        return Err(format!(
            "blob {key} has {} bytes, {} expected for {s}",
            bytes.len(),
            total
        ));
    }
    let kind = kind_of(out_path);
    if s.kind == "buffer" && kind != Kind::Raw {
        return Err("a buffer exports as raw bytes (give a file name without .dds or .png)".into());
    }
    let pick = || -> Result<locum_capture::layout::Sub, String> {
        let index = which.sub.unwrap_or(which.mip + which.slice * s.mips.max(1));
        subs.iter()
            .find(|x| x.index == index)
            .copied()
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("{s} has no subresource {index}"))
    };
    let readable = format::readable(s.format);
    match kind {
        Kind::Raw => {
            let (from, len) = if which.sub.is_some() || which.mip > 0 || which.slice > 0 {
                let sub = pick()?;
                (sub.offset as usize, sub.size as usize)
            } else {
                (0, bytes.len())
            };
            write(out_path, &bytes[from..from + len])?;
            out!("{}: {len} bytes of #{id} ({key})", out_path.display());
        }
        Kind::Dds => {
            let whole = which.sub.is_none() && which.mip == 0 && which.slice == 0;
            let dimensions = match s.kind.as_str() {
                "texture1d" => 1,
                "texture3d" => 3,
                _ => 2,
            };
            let file = if whole {
                dds::file(
                    &Texture {
                        format: readable,
                        dimensions,
                        width: s.width,
                        height: s.height,
                        depth: s.depth,
                        mips: s.mips,
                        array: s.array,
                        cube: s.cube(),
                    },
                    &bytes,
                )
            } else {
                let sub = pick()?;
                dds::file(
                    &Texture {
                        format: readable,
                        dimensions,
                        width: sub.width,
                        height: sub.height,
                        depth: sub.depth,
                        mips: 1,
                        array: 1,
                        cube: false,
                    },
                    &bytes[sub.offset as usize..(sub.offset + sub.size) as usize],
                )
            };
            write(out_path, &file)?;
            if whole {
                out!("{}: {s} as {}", out_path.display(), format::name(readable));
            } else {
                let sub = pick()?;
                out!(
                    "{}: #{id} mip {} slice {} {}x{} as {}",
                    out_path.display(),
                    sub.mip,
                    sub.slice,
                    sub.width,
                    sub.height,
                    format::name(readable)
                );
            }
        }
        Kind::Png => {
            let sub = pick()?;
            let z = which.z.min(sub.depth.saturating_sub(1));
            let start = sub.offset + sub.slice_bytes() * u64::from(z);
            let image = texels::decode(
                s.format,
                sub.width,
                sub.height,
                &bytes[start as usize..(start + sub.slice_bytes()) as usize],
            )?;
            png(out_path, sub.width, sub.height, &image.rgba8(range))?;
            out!(
                "{}: #{id} mip {} slice {}{} {}x{} {}",
                out_path.display(),
                sub.mip,
                sub.slice,
                if sub.depth > 1 {
                    format!(" z {z}")
                } else {
                    String::new()
                },
                sub.width,
                sub.height,
                format::name(s.format)
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn target(c: &Capture, draw: i64, name: &str, out_path: &Path, range: Range) -> Result<(), String> {
    let (key, w, h, f): (Option<String>, i64, i64, i64) = c
        .row(
            "SELECT blob, width, height, format FROM targets WHERE draw = ?1 AND target = ?2",
            rusqlite::params![draw, name],
            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?)),
        )
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            let read: Vec<String> = c.rows(
                "SELECT draw || ' ' || target FROM targets ORDER BY draw",
                [],
                |r| r.get(0),
            );
            format!(
                "no {name} read back after draw {draw}; targets are read after each pass's last draw: {}",
                read.join(", ")
            )
        })?;
    let key = key.ok_or("the target was not stored")?;
    let bytes = c.blob(&key)?;
    let (w, h, f) = (w as u32, h as u32, f as u32);
    match kind_of(out_path) {
        Kind::Png => {
            let image = texels::decode(f, w, h, &bytes)?;
            png(out_path, w, h, &image.rgba8(range))?;
        }
        Kind::Dds => {
            let t = Texture {
                format: f,
                dimensions: 2,
                width: w,
                height: h,
                depth: 1,
                mips: 1,
                array: 1,
                cube: false,
            };
            write(out_path, &dds::file(&t, &bytes))?;
        }
        Kind::Raw => write(out_path, &bytes)?,
    }
    out!(
        "{}: {name} after draw {draw}, {w}x{h} {}",
        out_path.display(),
        format::name(f)
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn blob(c: &Capture, key: &str, out_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let bytes = c.blob(key)?;
    write(out_path, &bytes)?;
    out!("{}: {} bytes", out_path.display(), bytes.len());
    Ok(())
}
```

`cli/src/info.rs`:

```rs
//! `captures` and `info`: what captures there are, and what one holds and lacks.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::path::Path;

use crate::describe::mib;
use crate::open::{self, Capture};
use crate::out;

pub fn captures(dir: &Path, blobs: Option<&Path>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let found = open::list(dir);
    if found.is_empty() {
        out!("no captures in {}", dir.join("captures").display());
        return Ok(());
    }
    for path in found {
        let name = path
            .parent()
            .and_then(Path::file_name)
            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        match open::open(&path.display().to_string(), blobs) {
            Ok(c) => {
                let counts = c.meta_json("counts");
                let exe = c.meta("exe").unwrap_or_default();
                let exe = exe.rsplit(['\\', '/']).next().unwrap_or(&exe).to_string();
                out!(
                    "{name:<24} frame {:<7} {:>6} draws {:>7} events  {:>9} contents  {exe}",
                    c.meta("frame").unwrap_or_default(),
                    counts["draws"],
                    counts["events"],
                    mib(counts["content_bytes"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0))
                );
            }
            Err(e) => out!("{name:<24} {e}"),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn info(c: &Capture) -> Result<(), String> {
    let counts = c.meta_json("counts");
    let request = c.meta_json("request");
    let n = |k: &str| counts[k].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
    out!(
        "capture {} ({})",
        c.meta("name").unwrap_or_default(),
        c.path.display()
    );
    out!(
        "  frame {} of {} (pid {}), {}, locum {}",
        c.meta("frame").unwrap_or_default(),
        c.meta("exe").unwrap_or_default(),
        c.meta("pid").unwrap_or_default(),
        c.meta("api").unwrap_or_default(),
        c.meta("locum").unwrap_or_default()
    );
    out!("  request: {request}");
    out!("  blob store: {}", c.blobs.root().display());
    out!("");

    let kinds: Vec<(String, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT kind, count(*) FROM events GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC",
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
    );
    let kinds: Vec<String> = kinds.iter().map(|(k, n)| format!("{k} {n}")).collect();
    out!(
        "timeline: {} events ({}), {} draws and dispatches in {} passes",
        n("events"),
        kinds.join(", "),
        n("draws"),
        c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM passes", [])
    );
    out!(
        "command lists: {} spliced in ({} recorded the frame before), {} executed without a recording",
        n("lists_spliced"),
        n("lists_recorded_before"),
        n("lists_unrecorded")
    );
    out!(
        "constants: {} distinct buffer contents, {} copies failed",
        c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM cb_data", []),
        n("cb_copy_failures")
    );

    let sources: Vec<(Option<String>, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT content_source, count(*) FROM resources WHERE used = 1 GROUP BY content_source",
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
    );
    let sources: Vec<String> = sources
        .iter()
        .map(|(s, n)| format!("{} {n}", s.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")))
        .collect();
    out!(
        "resources: {} live, {} used by the frame ({} written); contents as the frame began for {} ({}): {}",
        n("resources_live"),
        n("resources_used"),
        n("resources_written"),
        n("contents"),
        mib(n("content_bytes")),
        sources.join(", ")
    );
    let uploads = c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM resources WHERE upload IS NOT NULL", []);
    let stored = c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM resources WHERE upload_stored = 1", []);
    out!(
        "uploads: {uploads} live resources were created with data or updated whole ({stored} stored, {} hash only); \
         {} have no upload hash",
        uploads - stored,
        c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM resources WHERE upload IS NULL", [])
    );
    out!(
        "targets: {} read back after their pass ({}), {} skipped",
        n("targets"),
        mib(n("target_bytes")),
        n("targets_skipped")
    );
    out!(
        "shaders: {} used ({} with bytecode)",
        c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM shaders", []),
        c.count("SELECT count(*) FROM shaders WHERE blob IS NOT NULL", [])
    );
    out!("");

    // What is missing.
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    let gaps: Vec<(String, Option<String>, i64)> =
        c.rows("SELECT what, detail, count FROM gaps ORDER BY what", [], |r| {
            Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?))
        });
    for (what, detail, count) in gaps {
        missing.push(format!("{what}: {} ({count})", detail.unwrap_or_default()));
    }
    let unread: Vec<(String, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT coalesce(content_note, 'not read'), count(*) FROM resources WHERE used = 1 AND content IS NULL \
         GROUP BY content_note",
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
    );
    for (why, count) in unread {
        missing.push(format!("contents of {count} used resources: {why}"));
    }
    let approximate: Vec<(String, i64)> = c.rows(
        "SELECT content_note, count(*) FROM resources WHERE content IS NOT NULL AND content_note IS NOT NULL \
         GROUP BY content_note",
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
    );
    for (why, count) in approximate {
        missing.push(format!("contents of {count} resources may be off: {why}"));
    }
    let mut keys: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();
    for sql in [
        "SELECT content FROM resources WHERE content IS NOT NULL",
        "SELECT upload FROM resources WHERE upload_stored = 1",
        "SELECT blob FROM targets WHERE blob IS NOT NULL",
        "SELECT data FROM events WHERE data IS NOT NULL",
        "SELECT blob FROM shaders WHERE blob IS NOT NULL",
    ] {
        keys.extend(c.rows(sql, [], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0)));
    }
    let absent = keys.iter().filter(|k| !c.blobs.has(k)).count();
    if absent > 0 {
        missing.push(format!(
            "{absent} of {} blobs it refers to are not in the store",
            keys.len()
        ));
    }
    let memory = c.meta_json("memory");
    match memory["path"].as_str() {
        Some(path) => {
            let p = std::path::Path::new(path);
            match std::fs::metadata(p) {
                Ok(m) => out!(
                    "memory: {path} ({}; the game waited {} ms for the snapshot)",
                    mib(m.len()),
                    memory["held_ms"]
                ),
                Err(_) if std::path::Path::new(&format!("{path}.part")).is_file() => missing.push(format!(
                    "memory: {path} is still being written, or its writer died"
                )),
                Err(_) => missing.push(format!("memory: {path} is gone")),
            }
        }
        // A failed dump is among the gaps.
        None if request["memory"] == true && memory["error"].is_null() => {
            missing.push("memory: not dumped (no dumper set: settings.txt `dumper`)".into())
        }
        None => {}
    }
    if missing.is_empty() {
        out!("missing: nothing");
    } else {
        out!("missing:");
        for m in missing {
            out!("  {m}");
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

`cli/src/join.rs`:

```rs
//! Names for a capture's resources from indexes of files (`locum_capture::index`): `index` keys loose DDS files,
//! `join` lists what each resource was made from, and every command that shows a bound resource shows its name when
//! an index is given (`--index`, or `LOCUM_INDEX` with paths separated by `;`).

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use locum_capture::index::{File, Index, Like};

use crate::describe::shape;
use crate::open::Capture;
use crate::out;

/// The indexes `--index` names, or else `LOCUM_INDEX`.
pub fn paths(given: &[PathBuf]) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    if !given.is_empty() {
        return given.to_vec();
    }
    std::env::var("LOCUM_INDEX")
        .map(|v| {
            v.split(';')
                .filter(|p| !p.is_empty())
                .map(PathBuf::from)
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// What a resource was made from.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Match {
    pub file: File,
    /// How the resource and the file correspond: "upload", "contents", or which subresources.
    pub how: String,
    /// Other files in the indexes with the same bytes.
    pub others: usize,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Match {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{} ({})", self.file.name, self.how)?;
        if self.others > 0 {
            write!(f, " +{} with the same bytes", self.others)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Names {
    indexes: Vec<Index>,
    cache: RefCell<HashMap<i64, Option<Match>>>,
}

impl Names {
    pub fn open(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<Names, String> {
        Ok(Names {
            indexes: paths.iter().map(|p| Index::open(p)).collect::<Result<_, _>>()?,
            cache: RefCell::default(),
        })
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.indexes.is_empty()
    }

    fn whole(&self, key: &str, like: &Like) -> Option<(File, usize)> {
        let mut found = None;
        let mut count = 0;
        for index in &self.indexes {
            let (files, n) = index.whole(key, like, 1);
            count += n;
            if found.is_none() {
                found = files.into_iter().next();
            }
        }
        found.map(|f| (f, count - 1))
    }

    /// What resource `id` of `c` was made from, if an index knows.
    pub fn of(&self, c: &Capture, id: i64) -> Option<Match> {
        if self.indexes.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        if let Some(m) = self.cache.borrow().get(&id) {
            return m.clone();
        }
        let m = self.find(c, id);
        self.cache.borrow_mut().insert(id, m.clone());
        m
    }

    fn find(&self, c: &Capture, id: i64) -> Option<Match> {
        let (upload, content): (Option<String>, Option<String>) =
            c.row("SELECT upload, content FROM resources WHERE id = ?1", [id], |r| {
                Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?))
            })?;
        let s = shape(c, id)?;
        let like = if s.kind == "buffer" {
            Like::Buffer
        } else {
            Like::texture(s.format, s.width, s.height)
        };
        for (key, how) in [(&upload, "upload"), (&content, "contents")] {
            if let Some((file, others)) = key.as_deref().and_then(|k| self.whole(k, &like)) {
                return Some(Match {
                    file,
                    how: how.into(),
                    others,
                });
            }
        }
        // Subresource by subresource: a texture made from part of a file (fewer mips, one face).
        if s.kind == "buffer" {
            return None;
        }
        let subs: Vec<(i64, i64, i64, Option<String>, u32, u32)> = c.rows(
            "SELECT sub, mip, slice, hash, width, height FROM subresources WHERE resource = ?1 ORDER BY sub",
            [id],
            |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?, r.get(3)?, r.get(4)?, r.get(5)?)),
        );
        let total = subs.len();
        let mut matched: Vec<(i64, i64, File, u32, u32, usize)> = Vec::new();
        for (_, mip, slice, hash, width, height) in &subs {
            let Some(hash) = hash else { continue };
            let like = Like::texture(s.format, *width, *height);
            if let Some((s, n)) = self.indexes.iter().find_map(|i| i.sub(hash, &like)) {
                matched.push((*mip, *slice, s.file, s.mip, s.slice, n));
            }
        }
        let (mip, slice, file, fmip, fslice, n) = matched.first().cloned()?;
        let same_file = matched.iter().all(|m| m.2.name == file.name);
        let identical = matched
            .iter()
            .all(|m| m.0 == i64::from(m.3) && m.1 == i64::from(m.4));
        let how = if same_file && identical && matched.len() == total {
            "every subresource".to_string()
        } else if same_file {
            let mips: Vec<i64> = matched.iter().map(|m| m.0).collect();
            let (lo, hi) = (mips.iter().min()?, mips.iter().max()?);
            let shift = i64::from(fmip) - mip;
            let mut how = format!("{} of {total} subresources: mips {lo}..={hi}", matched.len());
            if shift != 0 {
                how += &format!(" are the file's mips {}..={}", lo + shift, hi + shift);
            }
            if slice != i64::from(fslice) {
                how += &format!(", slice {slice} its slice {fslice}");
            }
            how
        } else {
            format!(
                "{} of {total} subresources, from more than one file; mip {mip} slice {slice}",
                matched.len()
            )
        };
        Some(Match {
            file,
            how,
            others: n - 1,
        })
    }
}

/// Adds every DDS file under each of `inputs` (or the file itself) to the index at `out`, named by its path from the
/// input.
pub fn index(out: &Path, inputs: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut index = Index::create(out)?;
    let (mut added, mut refused) = (0usize, Vec::new());
    for input in inputs {
        let mut stack = vec![input.clone()];
        while let Some(p) = stack.pop() {
            if p.is_dir() {
                let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(&p)
                    .map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", p.display()))?
                    .filter_map(|e| e.ok().map(|e| e.path()))
                    .collect();
                entries.sort();
                stack.extend(entries.into_iter().rev());
                continue;
            }
            if !p.extension().is_some_and(|e| e.eq_ignore_ascii_case("dds")) {
                continue;
            }
            let name = p
                .strip_prefix(input)
                .ok()
                .filter(|r| !r.as_os_str().is_empty())
                .unwrap_or(&p)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .replace('\\', "/");
            let bytes = std::fs::read(&p).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", p.display()))?;
            match index.add_dds(&name, &bytes) {
                Ok(()) => added += 1,
                Err(e) => refused.push(format!("{name}: {e}")),
            }
            if added % 1000 == 999 {
                index.commit()?;
            }
        }
    }
    index.commit()?;
    out!("{added} DDS files added to {}", out.display());
    if !refused.is_empty() {
        out!("{} refused:", refused.len());
        for r in refused.iter().take(20) {
            out!("  {r}");
        }
        if refused.len() > 20 {
            out!("  ... {} more", refused.len() - 20);
        }
    }
    let counts: Vec<String> = index
        .counts()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(k, n)| format!("{n} {k}s"))
        .collect();
    out!("the index holds {}", counts.join(", "));
    Ok(())
}

/// What each resource of `c` was made from: those the frame used (but its targets), or `all`.
pub fn join(c: &Capture, all: bool, unnamed: bool, limit: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    if c.names.is_empty() {
        return Err("no index: give --index INDEX.db (or set LOCUM_INDEX)".into());
    }
    let ids: Vec<(i64, String, i64)> = c.rows(
        &format!(
            "SELECT r.id, r.kind, (SELECT count(DISTINCT draw) FROM bindings b WHERE b.resource = r.id) \
             FROM resources r WHERE (r.kind != 'buffer' OR r.bind & 0x4 = 0) {} ORDER BY r.id",
            // Constant buffers are never files; render and depth targets are what the frame makes.
            if all {
                ""
            } else {
                "AND r.used = 1 AND r.bind & 0x60 = 0"
            }
        ),
        [],
        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?)),
    );
    // Named and not, by kind: textures, buffers.
    let mut tally: HashMap<&str, (usize, usize)> = HashMap::new();
    let mut shown = 0;
    for (id, kind, draws) in &ids {
        let k = if kind == "buffer" { "buffer" } else { "texture" };
        let m = c.names.of(c, *id);
        let t = tally.entry(k).or_default();
        if m.is_some() {
            t.0 += 1;
        } else {
            t.1 += 1;
        }
        if m.is_some() == unnamed || shown >= limit {
            continue;
        }
        shown += 1;
        let s = shape(c, *id).map_or(format!("#{id}"), |s| s.to_string());
        let used = if *draws > 0 {
            format!(", bound by {draws} draws")
        } else {
            String::new()
        };
        match m {
            Some(m) => out!("{s}{used}\n    {m}"),
            None => out!("{s}{used}"),
        }
    }
    let what = if all { "alive" } else { "the frame used" };
    for k in ["texture", "buffer"] {
        if let Some((named, not)) = tally.get(k) {
            out!("{k}s {what}: {named} of {} named", named + not);
        }
    }
    if shown >= limit {
        out!("(at most {limit} listed: --limit)");
    }
    Ok(())
}

```

```rs
//! locum-cli: reads the captures locum writes. A capture is named by its `capture.db`, the folder holding it, its
//! name under locum's folder (`LOCUM_DIR`, or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\locum`), or `last`.

    },
    /// Replays a draw offline (with what it depends on), optionally with rules changing it, and writes what it drew.
    /// With rules, writes the draw's targets before and after them and where they differ.
    Replay {
        capture: String,
        /// The draw's number, or `last`.
        draw: String,
        /// A rule as in overrides.txt (`constant ps b3 c0 1 0 0 1`, `skip vs=<hash>`, ...); may be given many times.
        #[arg(long)]
        rule: Vec<String>,
        /// A file of rules.
        #[arg(long)]
        rules: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// slice (the draw and what it depends on), frame (everything up to it), or draw (it alone).
        #[arg(long, default_value = "slice")]
        mode: String,
        /// Run on WARP, the software rasterizer, instead of the GPU.
        #[arg(long)]
        warp: bool,
        /// Enable D3D11 validation; errors make verification fail.
        #[arg(long)]
        debug: bool,
        #[arg(short, long, default_value = "replay")]
        out: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long, default_value = "auto")]
        range: String,
    },
    /// Replays the whole frame and compares every target the capture read back.
    Verify {
        capture: String,
        #[arg(long)]
        warp: bool,
        /// Enable D3D11 validation; errors make verification fail.
        #[arg(long)]
        debug: bool,
        /// Compare at most this many targets.
        #[arg(long)]
        limit: Option<i64>,
    },
    /// Writes a full-memory minidump of a process from a snapshot of it (locum runs this at a capture: settings.txt
    /// `dumper`).
    Dump {
        #[arg(long)]
        pid: u32,
        #[arg(long)]
        out: PathBuf,
        /// An event to set once the snapshot is taken.
        #[arg(long)]
        signal: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Searches a capture's memory dump (or a .dmp file) for a value: a float, an integer, bytes, or the registers of
    /// a constant buffer a draw had bound.
    Memfind {
        /// A capture, or a .dmp file.
        target: String,
        #[arg(long, allow_negative_numbers = true)]
        float: Option<f32>,
        /// Relative tolerance for --float.
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 1e-6)]
        tolerance: f32,
        #[arg(long, allow_negative_numbers = true)]
        int: Option<i64>,
        /// Hex bytes, like 0000803f.
        #[arg(long)]
        bytes: Option<String>,
        /// DRAW STAGE SLOT: each non-zero register of that constant buffer (or --register N alone).
        #[arg(long, num_args = 3, value_names = ["DRAW", "STAGE", "SLOT"])]
        cb: Option<Vec<String>>,
        #[arg(long)]
        register: Option<u32>,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 20)]
        limit: usize,
    },
    /// Compares two memory dumps at the same addresses: words that went from one float to another, or with neither
    /// given, how many words changed in each region.
    Memdiff {
        a: String,
        b: String,
        #[arg(long, allow_negative_numbers = true)]
        from: Option<f32>,
        #[arg(long, allow_negative_numbers = true)]
        to: Option<f32>,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 1e-6)]
        tolerance: f32,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 40)]
        limit: usize,
    },
    /// Compares two captures draw by draw (matched by shaders, inputs and order, not by numbers that change between
    /// launches): what differs, in how many draws, and the draws only one has.
    Diff {
        a: String,
        b: String,
        /// Every differing draw, not only the summary.
        #[arg(long)]
        draws: bool,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 30)]
        limit: usize,
    },
    /// Adds DDS files (each file given, and every one under each folder given) to an index of files by the keys of
    /// their bytes, made if there is none.
    Index {
        /// The index to make or add to.
        #[arg(short, long)]
        out: PathBuf,
        inputs: Vec<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// What each resource the frame used was made from, by the indexes given (--index).
    Join {
        capture: String,
        /// Every resource alive at the capture, not only those the frame used.
        #[arg(long)]
        all: bool,
        /// List those not found instead.
        #[arg(long)]
        unnamed: bool,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 200)]
        limit: usize,
    },
    /// Any SQL on the capture; rows tab-separated.
    Sql { capture: String, query: String },
}

fn range(s: &str) -> Result<Range, String> {
    Range::parse(s).ok_or_else(|| format!("--range {s}: auto, clamp, tonemap or LO:HI"))
}

fn sql(c: &open::Capture, query: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut q = c.db.prepare(query).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let n = q.column_count();
    out!("{}", q.column_names().collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\t"));
    let mut rows = q.query([]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    while let Some(r) = rows.next().map_err(|e| e.to_string())? {
        let cells: Vec<String> = (0..n)
            .map(|i| match r.get_ref(i) {
                Ok(rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Null) => "NULL".into(),
                Ok(rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Integer(v)) => v.to_string(),
                Ok(rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Real(v)) => v.to_string(),
                Ok(rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Text(t)) => String::from_utf8_lossy(t).into_owned(),
                Ok(rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Blob(b)) => {
                    let hex: String = b.iter().take(64).map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect();
                    if b.len() > 64 {
                        format!("{hex}... ({} bytes)", b.len())
                    } else {
                        hex
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => e.to_string(),
            })
            .collect();
        out!("{}", cells.join("\t"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<(), String> {
    let blobs = cli.blobs.as_deref();
    let indexes = join::paths(&cli.index);
    let open = |name: &str| open::open(name, blobs)?.named(&indexes);
    match cli.command {
        Command::Captures { dir } => info::captures(&dir.unwrap_or_else(open::locum_dir), blobs),
        Command::Info { capture } => info::info(&open(&capture)?),
        Command::Draws {
            capture,
            vs,
            ps,
            cs,
            shader,
            pass,
            uses,
            target,
            content,
            call,
        } => draws::draws(
            &open(&capture)?,
            &draws::Filter {
                vs,
                ps,
                cs,
                shader,
                pass,
                uses,
                target,
                content,
                call,
            },
        ),
        Command::Draw { capture, n, all } => draws::draw(&open(&capture)?, n, all),
        Command::Cb {
            capture,
            draw,
            stage,
            slot,
            raw,
        } => draws::cb(&open(&capture)?, draw, &stage, slot, raw),
        Command::Find {
            capture,
            value,
            tolerance,
            int,
        } => draws::find(&open(&capture)?, value, tolerance, int),
        Command::Passes { capture } => draws::passes(&open(&capture)?),
        Command::Resources {
            capture,
            used,
            written,
            kind,
            format,
            width,
            height,
            hash,
        } => resources::resources(
            &open(&capture)?,
            &resources::Filter {
                used,
                written,
                kind,
                format,
                hash,
                width,
                height,
            },
        ),
        Command::Resource { capture, id } => resources::resource(&open(&capture)?, id),
        Command::Events {
            capture,
            kind,
            resource,
            from,
            limit,
        } => resources::events(
            &open(&capture)?,
            &resources::EventFilter {
                kind,
                resource,
                from,
                limit,
            },
        ),
        Command::Stack { capture, id } => resources::stack(&open(&capture)?, id),
        Command::Shaders { capture } => shaders::shaders(&open(&capture)?),
        Command::Shader {
            capture,
            hash,
            disassemble,
        } => shaders::shader(&open(&capture)?, &hash, disassemble),
        Command::Export {
            capture,
            id,
            out,
            sub,
            mip,
            slice,
            z,
            upload,
            range: r,
        } => export::export(
            &open(&capture)?,
            id,
            &out,
            &export::Which {
                sub,
                mip,
                slice,
                z,
                upload,
            },
            range(&r)?,
        ),
        Command::Target {
            capture,
            draw,
            name,
            out,
            range: r,
        } => export::target(&open(&capture)?, draw, &name, &out, range(&r)?),
        Command::Blob { capture, key, out } => export::blob(&open(&capture)?, &key, &out),
        Command::Replay {
            capture,
            draw,
            rule,
            rules,
            mode,
            warp,
            debug,
            out,
            range: r,
        } => {
            let c = open(&capture)?;
            let n = replay::draw_number(&c, &draw)?;
            let mode =
                replay::Mode::parse(&mode).ok_or_else(|| format!("--mode {mode}: slice, frame or draw"))?;
            replay::replay(
                &c,
                n,
                &replay::Options {
                    mode,
                    rules: rule,
                    rules_file: rules,
                    warp,
                    debug,
                    out,
                    range: range(&r)?,
                },
            )
        }
        Command::Verify {
            capture,
            warp,
            debug,
            limit,
        } => replay::verify(&open(&capture)?, warp, debug, limit),
        Command::Dump { pid, out, signal } => memory::dump(pid, &out, signal.as_deref()),
        Command::Memfind {
            target,
            float,
            tolerance,
            int,
            bytes,
            cb,
            register,
            limit,
        } => {
            let needle = match (float, int, bytes, cb) {
                (Some(f), None, None, None) => memory::Needle::Float(f, tolerance),
                (None, Some(i), None, None) => memory::Needle::Int(i),
                (None, None, Some(hex), None) => {
                    let hex: String = hex.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_whitespace()).collect();
                    let bytes = (0..hex.len())
                        .step_by(2)
                        .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(hex.get(i..i + 2).unwrap_or("x"), 16))
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<u8>, _>>()
                        .map_err(|_| format!("--bytes {hex}: not hex bytes"))?;
                    memory::Needle::Bytes(bytes)
                }
                (None, None, None, Some(cb)) => memory::Needle::Cb(
                    cb[0]
                        .parse()
                        .map_err(|_| format!("{}: not a draw number", cb[0]))?,
                    cb[1].clone(),
                    cb[2].parse().map_err(|_| format!("{}: not a slot", cb[2]))?,
                    register,
                ),
                _ => return Err("give one of --float, --int, --bytes or --cb".into()),
            };
            let (dump, capture) = memory::open(&target, blobs)?;
            memory::memfind(&dump, capture.as_ref(), &needle, limit)
        }
        Command::Memdiff {
            a,
            b,
            from,
            to,
            tolerance,
            limit,
        } => {
            let (a, _) = memory::open(&a, blobs)?;
            let (b, _) = memory::open(&b, blobs)?;
            memory::memdiff(&a, &b, from, to, tolerance, limit)
        }
        Command::Diff { a, b, draws, limit } => diff::diff(&open(&a)?, &open(&b)?, draws, limit),
        Command::Index { out, inputs } => join::index(&out, &inputs),
        Command::Join {
            capture,
            all,
            unnamed,
            limit,
        } => join::join(&open(&capture)?, all, unnamed, limit),
        Command::Sql { capture, query } => sql(&open(&capture)?, &query),
    }
}

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    match run(Cli::parse()) {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("locum-cli: {e}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}
```
