```rs
//! Shared COM plumbing for the wrappers.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::*;
use windows::core::{GUID, HRESULT, IUnknown, Interface};

use crate::log::log;

/// `QueryInterface` on a raw COM pointer.
///
/// # Safety
/// `object` must be a live COM object.
pub unsafe fn query(object: *mut c_void, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
    unsafe { ((**(object as *const *const windows::core::IUnknown_Vtbl)).QueryInterface)(object, iid, out) }
}

/// Answers `QueryInterface` for a wrapper: `iids` are the interfaces the wrapper itself implements (it hands out
/// itself); anything else goes to the wrapped object, and the game then holds a real object locum does not see.
/// Those side doors are logged, once per wrapper kind and interface.
///
/// # Safety
/// `this` must be the wrapper, `inner` the live wrapped object, `add_ref` the wrapper's own `AddRef`.
pub unsafe fn answer_query(
    kind: &'static str,
    this: *const c_void,
    inner: *mut c_void,
    iids: &[GUID],
    iid: *const GUID,
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
    add_ref: impl FnOnce(),
) -> HRESULT {
    if out.is_null() || iid.is_null() {
        return windows::Win32::Foundation::E_POINTER;
    }
    let wanted = unsafe { *iid };
    if iids.contains(&wanted) {
        add_ref();
        unsafe { *out = this as *mut c_void };
        return windows::Win32::Foundation::S_OK;
    }
    let hr = unsafe { query(inner, iid, out) };
    side_door(kind, &wanted, hr);
    hr
}

fn side_door(kind: &'static str, iid: &GUID, hr: HRESULT) {
    static SEEN: Mutex<Option<HashMap<(&'static str, u128), u64>>> = Mutex::new(None);
    let mut seen = SEEN.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let count = seen
        .get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new)
        .entry((kind, iid.to_u128()))
        .or_insert(0);
    *count += 1;
    if *count == 1 {
        log!(
            "side door: {kind} QueryInterface {} ({}) -> {hr:?}, answered by the real object",
            guid(iid),
            name_of(iid)
        );
    }
}

pub fn guid(g: &GUID) -> String {
    format!("{g:?}")
}

/// A readable name for the interfaces a game is likely to ask about.
pub fn name_of(iid: &GUID) -> &'static str {
    let known: &[(GUID, &str)] = &[
        (IUnknown::IID, "IUnknown"),
        (ID3D11Device::IID, "ID3D11Device"),
        (ID3D11Device1::IID, "ID3D11Device1"),
        (ID3D11Device2::IID, "ID3D11Device2"),
        (ID3D11Device3::IID, "ID3D11Device3"),
        (ID3D11Device4::IID, "ID3D11Device4"),
        (ID3D11Device5::IID, "ID3D11Device5"),
        (ID3D11DeviceContext::IID, "ID3D11DeviceContext"),
        (ID3D11DeviceContext1::IID, "ID3D11DeviceContext1"),
        (ID3D11DeviceContext2::IID, "ID3D11DeviceContext2"),
        (ID3D11DeviceContext3::IID, "ID3D11DeviceContext3"),
        (ID3D11DeviceContext4::IID, "ID3D11DeviceContext4"),
        (ID3D11Multithread::IID, "ID3D11Multithread"),
        (ID3DUserDefinedAnnotation::IID, "ID3DUserDefinedAnnotation"),
        (ID3D11VideoDevice::IID, "ID3D11VideoDevice"),
        (ID3D11VideoContext::IID, "ID3D11VideoContext"),
        (ID3D11Debug::IID, "ID3D11Debug"),
        (ID3D11InfoQueue::IID, "ID3D11InfoQueue"),
        (IDXGIObject::IID, "IDXGIObject"),
        (IDXGIDevice::IID, "IDXGIDevice"),
        (IDXGIDevice1::IID, "IDXGIDevice1"),
        (IDXGIDevice2::IID, "IDXGIDevice2"),
        (IDXGIDevice3::IID, "IDXGIDevice3"),
        (IDXGIDevice4::IID, "IDXGIDevice4"),
        (IDXGIAdapter::IID, "IDXGIAdapter"),
        (IDXGIAdapter1::IID, "IDXGIAdapter1"),
        (IDXGIFactory::IID, "IDXGIFactory"),
        (IDXGIFactory1::IID, "IDXGIFactory1"),
        (IDXGIFactory2::IID, "IDXGIFactory2"),
        (IDXGIFactory3::IID, "IDXGIFactory3"),
        (IDXGIFactory4::IID, "IDXGIFactory4"),
        (IDXGIFactory5::IID, "IDXGIFactory5"),
        (IDXGIFactory6::IID, "IDXGIFactory6"),
        (IDXGIFactory7::IID, "IDXGIFactory7"),
        (IDXGISwapChain::IID, "IDXGISwapChain"),
        (IDXGISwapChain1::IID, "IDXGISwapChain1"),
        (IDXGISwapChain2::IID, "IDXGISwapChain2"),
        (IDXGISwapChain3::IID, "IDXGISwapChain3"),
        (IDXGISwapChain4::IID, "IDXGISwapChain4"),
        (IDXGIDeviceSubObject::IID, "IDXGIDeviceSubObject"),
        (IDXGIResource::IID, "IDXGIResource"),
        (IDXGIOutput::IID, "IDXGIOutput"),
    ];
    known.iter().find(|(g, _)| g == iid).map_or("?", |(_, n)| n)
}
```

```rs
//! What locum's own work cost since the last report, as one log line: on the game's threads (resources made,
//! updates, a capture's map shadows, recorded events and contents copies) and on the writer's (blobs written, and what happened to
//! blobs it could not take at once).

use locum_capture::writer;

use crate::d3d11::capture::{COPIED, RECORDED, ops::SHADOWED};
use crate::d3d11::registry::{REGISTERED, UPDATES};

/// The counts since the last call, which starts them again from zero.
pub fn line() -> String {
    format!(
        "locum on the game's threads: resources made {}, updates {}, maps shadowed {}, events recorded {}, contents copied {}; writer: blobs written {}, already taken {}, dropped {}, waited for {}",
        REGISTERED.take(),
        UPDATES.take(),
        SHADOWED.take(),
        RECORDED.take(),
        COPIED.take(),
        writer::WRITTEN.take(),
        writer::KNOWN.take(),
        writer::DROPPED.take(),
        writer::WAITED.take()
    )
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/contents.rs`:

```rs
//! Reading resource contents back for a capture (the copy and the canonical layout are in
//! [`locum_d3d11::readback`]): each read is hashed, whole and per subresource, and handed to the blob store.

use locum_capture::hash::key;
use locum_capture::writer;
use locum_d3d11::readback;
pub use locum_d3d11::readback::Readback;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;

use crate::settings::settings;

/// Bytes of staging copies a capture has in flight before it reads them (waiting for the GPU).
pub const IN_FLIGHT: u64 = 512 << 20;

/// Contents read back: the key of their bytes in the canonical layout and each subresource's key, or why there are
/// none.
pub type Read = Result<(String, Vec<String>), String>;

/// Records a copy of `resource` into a new staging resource on `c`.
///
/// # Safety
/// `c` must be a context of the device that made `resource`.
pub unsafe fn issue(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, resource: &ID3D11Resource) -> Result<Readback, String> {
    unsafe { readback::issue(c, resource) }
}

/// The key of a copy's bytes in the canonical layout, and each subresource's key. Waits for the GPU. The bytes go to
/// the blob store.
///
/// # Safety
/// `immediate` must be the immediate context of the device that made the copy.
pub unsafe fn read(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, rb: &Readback) -> Read {
    let bytes = unsafe { rb.read(immediate) }?;
    let hashes = rb
        .subs
        .iter()
        .map(|s| key(&bytes[s.offset as usize..(s.offset + s.size) as usize]))
        .collect();
    let k = key(&bytes);
    let blobs = &settings().blobs;
    writer::blob(blobs, k.clone(), bytes, true);
    Ok((k, hashes))
}

/// Reads `copies` (or keeps why they could not be made).
///
/// # Safety
/// `immediate` must be the immediate context of the device that made the copies.
pub unsafe fn read_all(
    immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    copies: Vec<(u64, Result<Readback, String>)>,
) -> Vec<(u64, Read)> {
    copies
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(id, rb)| (id, rb.and_then(|rb| unsafe { read(immediate, &rb) })))
        .collect()
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/counters.rs`:

```rs
//! Hidden append/consume counters belong to views, separately from resource bytes.

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;

use super::state;
use locum_d3d11::predication::unpredicated;

pub(super) fn track(id: u64, view: &ID3D11UnorderedAccessView) {
    let mut desc = D3D11_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC::default();
    unsafe { view.GetDesc(&mut desc) };
    if desc.ViewDimension == D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER
        && unsafe { desc.Anonymous.Buffer.Flags }
            & (D3D11_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_APPEND.0 | D3D11_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_COUNTER.0) as u32
            != 0
    {
        state().counter_views.insert(id, view.clone());
    }
}

/// Called before the first event using a counter runs on the immediate context.
pub(super) fn touch(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, ids: &[u64]) {
    let todo: Vec<_> = {
        let mut s = state();
        ids.iter()
            .filter_map(|id| s.counter_views.remove(id).map(|v| (*id, v)))
            .collect()
    };
    for (id, view) in todo {
        let copied = issue(c, &view).map_err(|e| e.to_string());
        state().counter_copies.insert(id, copied);
    }
}

fn issue(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, view: &ID3D11UnorderedAccessView) -> windows::core::Result<ID3D11Buffer> {
    let device = unsafe { c.GetDevice() }?;
    let desc = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC {
        ByteWidth: 4,
        Usage: D3D11_USAGE_STAGING,
        CPUAccessFlags: D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ.0 as u32,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut buffer = None;
    unsafe { device.CreateBuffer(&desc, None, Some(&mut buffer)) }?;
    let buffer = buffer.expect("a successful CreateBuffer returns a buffer");
    unsafe { unpredicated(c, || c.CopyStructureCount(&buffer, 0, view)) };
    Ok(buffer)
}

pub(super) fn read(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, buffer: &ID3D11Buffer) -> Result<u32, String> {
    let mut mapped = D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE::default();
    unsafe { c.Map(buffer, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, Some(&mut mapped)) }.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let count = unsafe { mapped.pData.cast::<u32>().read_unaligned() };
    unsafe { c.Unmap(buffer, 0) };
    Ok(count)
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/ids.rs`:

```rs
//! Numbers for the resources, views and state objects a capture records, and a description of each, written once
//! per capture. Resources are numbered by the registry when created; views and states the first time a capture sees
//! them. The number lives on the object (private data), so it survives the game's own reuse of addresses.

use core::ffi::c_void;

use locum_capture::db;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::core::{GUID, Interface};

use super::{Tracked, state};
use crate::d3d11::registry::{self, id_on, next_id, set_id};

/// The private-data key of an input layout's elements (JSON) and the key of the bytecode it was created against.
pub const LAYOUT_KEY: GUID = GUID::from_u128(0x6c6f_6375_6d00_4a5e_9d1b_7a2f_8c3e_0003);

fn bytes_of<T>(t: &T) -> Vec<u8> {
    unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts((t as *const T).cast::<u8>(), size_of::<T>()) }.to_vec()
}

/// Whether `object` was already described in the current capture; marks it described. Returns its number.
fn number(object: &ID3D11DeviceChild, capture: u64) -> (u64, bool) {
    match id_on(object) {
        Some((id, c)) if c == capture => (id, true),
        Some((id, _)) => {
            set_id(object, id, capture);
            (id, false)
        }
        None => {
            let id = next_id();
            set_id(object, id, capture);
            (id, false)
        }
    }
}

/// The number of a resource, recording it as used by the current capture (holding a reference until the capture
/// ends, so it can be read back).
pub(super) fn resource_id(resource: &ID3D11Resource) -> u64 {
    let id = registry::id_of(resource);
    let mut s = state();
    if let std::collections::btree_map::Entry::Vacant(slot) = s.resources.entry(id) {
        let dims = registry::entry(id)
            .map(|e| e.dims)
            .or_else(|| registry::dims_of(resource));
        slot.insert(Tracked {
            resource: resource.clone(),
            dims: dims.unwrap_or_default(),
            touched: false,
        });
    }
    id
}

/// The id of a buffer passed to an indirect draw (0 for null).
///
/// # Safety
/// `buffer` must be null or a live `ID3D11Buffer`.
pub unsafe fn buffer_id(buffer: *mut c_void) -> u64 {
    let Some(buffer) = (unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&buffer) }) else {
        return 0;
    };
    resource_id(buffer)
}

/// A view's number and its resource's number, describing the view the first time this capture sees it.
pub(super) fn view_ids(view: &ID3D11View) -> (u64, u64) {
    let resource = unsafe { view.GetResource() }.ok();
    let resource_id = resource.as_ref().map_or(0, resource_id);
    let child: ID3D11DeviceChild = view.cast().expect("a view is a device child");
    let capture = state().captures;
    let (id, known) = number(&child, capture);
    if !known {
        let row = describe_view(id, resource_id, view);
        if let Ok(uav) = view.cast::<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>() {
            super::counters::track(id, &uav);
        }
        state().views.push(row);
    }
    (id, resource_id)
}

fn describe_view(id: u64, resource: u64, view: &ID3D11View) -> db::View {
    unsafe {
        if let Ok(v) = view.cast::<ID3D11ShaderResourceView>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC::default();
            v.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return db::View {
                id,
                kind: "srv",
                resource,
                format: d.Format.0 as u32,
                dimension: d.ViewDimension.0 as u32,
                desc: bytes_of(&d),
                json: srv_json(&d).to_string(),
            };
        }
        if let Ok(v) = view.cast::<ID3D11RenderTargetView>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC::default();
            v.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return db::View {
                id,
                kind: "rtv",
                resource,
                format: d.Format.0 as u32,
                dimension: d.ViewDimension.0 as u32,
                desc: bytes_of(&d),
                json: rtv_json(&d).to_string(),
            };
        }
        if let Ok(v) = view.cast::<ID3D11DepthStencilView>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC::default();
            v.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return db::View {
                id,
                kind: "dsv",
                resource,
                format: d.Format.0 as u32,
                dimension: d.ViewDimension.0 as u32,
                desc: bytes_of(&d),
                json: dsv_json(&d).to_string(),
            };
        }
        if let Ok(v) = view.cast::<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC::default();
            v.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return db::View {
                id,
                kind: "uav",
                resource,
                format: d.Format.0 as u32,
                dimension: d.ViewDimension.0 as u32,
                desc: bytes_of(&d),
                json: uav_json(&d).to_string(),
            };
        }
    }
    db::View {
        id,
        kind: "unknown",
        resource,
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

fn srv_json(d: &D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC) -> Value {
    let a = &d.Anonymous;
    let range = unsafe {
        match d.ViewDimension.0 {
            1 => {
                json!({"first_element": a.Buffer.Anonymous1.FirstElement, "elements": a.Buffer.Anonymous2.NumElements})
            }
            2 => json!({"first_mip": a.Texture1D.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.Texture1D.MipLevels}),
            3 => json!({"first_mip": a.Texture1DArray.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.Texture1DArray.MipLevels,
                "first_slice": a.Texture1DArray.FirstArraySlice, "slices": a.Texture1DArray.ArraySize}),
            4 => json!({"first_mip": a.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.Texture2D.MipLevels}),
            5 => json!({"first_mip": a.Texture2DArray.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.Texture2DArray.MipLevels,
                "first_slice": a.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice, "slices": a.Texture2DArray.ArraySize}),
            7 => {
                json!({"first_slice": a.Texture2DMSArray.FirstArraySlice, "slices": a.Texture2DMSArray.ArraySize})
            }
            8 => json!({"first_mip": a.Texture3D.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.Texture3D.MipLevels}),
            9 => json!({"first_mip": a.TextureCube.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.TextureCube.MipLevels}),
            10 => {
                json!({"first_mip": a.TextureCubeArray.MostDetailedMip, "mips": a.TextureCubeArray.MipLevels,
                "first_cube": a.TextureCubeArray.First2DArrayFace, "cubes": a.TextureCubeArray.NumCubes})
            }
            11 => json!({"first_element": a.BufferEx.FirstElement, "elements": a.BufferEx.NumElements,
                "flags": a.BufferEx.Flags}),
            _ => json!({}),
        }
    };
    json!({"format": d.Format.0, "dimension": SRV_DIMENSIONS.get(d.ViewDimension.0 as usize).copied().unwrap_or("?"), "range": range})
}

const SRV_DIMENSIONS: [&str; 12] = [
    "unknown",
    "buffer",
    "texture1d",
    "texture1darray",
    "texture2d",
    "texture2darray",
    "texture2dms",
    "texture2dmsarray",
    "texture3d",
    "texturecube",
    "texturecubearray",
    "bufferex",
];

fn rtv_json(d: &D3D11_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC) -> Value {

    let range = unsafe {
        match d.ViewDimension.0 {

                json!({"first_element": a.Buffer.Anonymous1.FirstElement, "elements": a.Buffer.Anonymous2.NumElements})
            }
            2 => json!({"mip": a.Texture1D.MipSlice}),

                json!({"first_slice": a.Texture2DMSArray.FirstArraySlice, "slices": a.Texture2DMSArray.ArraySize})
            }
            8 => {
                json!({"mip": a.Texture3D.MipSlice, "first_w": a.Texture3D.FirstWSlice, "w": a.Texture3D.WSize})

        }

        "unknown",
        "buffer",

        "texture2d",
        "texture2darray",
        "texture2dms",
        "texture2dmsarray",
        "texture3d",
    ];

}

/// A state object's or input layout's number (None for none bound), describing it the first time this capture sees
/// it.
pub(super) fn state_id<T: Interface>(object: Option<T>, kind: &'static str) -> Option<u64> {
    let child = object.and_then(|o| o.cast::<ID3D11DeviceChild>().ok())?;
    let capture = state().captures;
    let (id, known) = number(&child, capture);
    if !known {
        let row = describe_state(id, kind, &child);
        state().states.push(row);
    }
    Some(id)
}

fn describe_state(id: u64, kind: &'static str, object: &ID3D11DeviceChild) -> db::State {
    let mut row = db::State {
        id,
        kind,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    unsafe {
        match kind {
            "rasterizer" => {
                if let Ok(r) = object.cast::<ID3D11RasterizerState2>() {
                    let mut d = D3D11_RASTERIZER_DESC2::default();
                    r.GetDesc2(&mut d);
                    row.desc = bytes_of(&d);
                    row.json = json!({"fill": d.FillMode.0, "cull": d.CullMode.0, "front_ccw": d.FrontCounterClockwise.as_bool(),
                        "depth_bias": d.DepthBias, "depth_bias_clamp": d.DepthBiasClamp,
                        "slope_scaled_depth_bias": d.SlopeScaledDepthBias, "depth_clip": d.DepthClipEnable.as_bool(),
                        "scissor": d.ScissorEnable.as_bool(), "multisample": d.MultisampleEnable.as_bool(),
                        "antialiased_line": d.AntialiasedLineEnable.as_bool(), "forced_sample_count": d.ForcedSampleCount,
                        "conservative": d.ConservativeRaster.0})
                    .to_string();
                } else if let Ok(r) = object.cast::<ID3D11RasterizerState>() {
                    let mut d = D3D11_RASTERIZER_DESC::default();
                    r.GetDesc(&mut d);
                    row.desc = bytes_of(&d);
                    row.json = json!({"fill": d.FillMode.0, "cull": d.CullMode.0, "front_ccw": d.FrontCounterClockwise.as_bool(),
                        "depth_bias": d.DepthBias, "scissor": d.ScissorEnable.as_bool(), "depth_clip": d.DepthClipEnable.as_bool()})
                    .to_string();
                }
            }
            "blend" => {
                if let Ok(b) = object.cast::<ID3D11BlendState1>() {
                    let mut d = D3D11_BLEND_DESC1::default();
                    b.GetDesc1(&mut d);
                    row.desc = bytes_of(&d);
                    let targets: Vec<Value> = d
                        .RenderTarget
                        .iter()
                        .map(|t| {
                            json!({"blend": t.BlendEnable.as_bool(), "logic": t.LogicOpEnable.as_bool(),
                                "src": t.SrcBlend.0, "dst": t.DestBlend.0, "op": t.BlendOp.0, "src_alpha": t.SrcBlendAlpha.0,
                                "dst_alpha": t.DestBlendAlpha.0, "op_alpha": t.BlendOpAlpha.0, "logic_op": t.LogicOp.0,
                                "write_mask": t.RenderTargetWriteMask})
                        })
                        .collect();
                    row.json = json!({"alpha_to_coverage": d.AlphaToCoverageEnable.as_bool(),
                        "independent": d.IndependentBlendEnable.as_bool(), "targets": targets})
                    .to_string();
                }
            }
            "depth_stencil" => {
                if let Ok(s) = object.cast::<ID3D11DepthStencilState>() {
                    let mut d = D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC::default();
                    s.GetDesc(&mut d);
                    row.desc = bytes_of(&d);
                    let face = |f: &D3D11_DEPTH_STENCILOP_DESC| {
                        json!({"fail": f.StencilFailOp.0, "depth_fail": f.StencilDepthFailOp.0,
                            "pass": f.StencilPassOp.0, "func": f.StencilFunc.0})
                    };
                    row.json = json!({"depth": d.DepthEnable.as_bool(), "write": d.DepthWriteMask.0 != 0,
                        "func": d.DepthFunc.0, "stencil": d.StencilEnable.as_bool(), "read_mask": d.StencilReadMask,
                        "write_mask": d.StencilWriteMask, "front": face(&d.FrontFace), "back": face(&d.BackFace)})
                    .to_string();
                }
            }
            "sampler" => {
                if let Ok(s) = object.cast::<ID3D11SamplerState>() {
                    let mut d = D3D11_SAMPLER_DESC::default();
                    s.GetDesc(&mut d);
                    row.desc = bytes_of(&d);
                    row.json = json!({"filter": d.Filter.0, "address": [d.AddressU.0, d.AddressV.0, d.AddressW.0],
                        "mip_lod_bias": d.MipLODBias, "max_anisotropy": d.MaxAnisotropy, "compare": d.ComparisonFunc.0,
                        "border": d.BorderColor, "min_lod": d.MinLOD, "max_lod": d.MaxLOD})
                    .to_string();
                }
            }
            "input_layout" => {
                let mut size = 0u32;
                let _ = object.GetPrivateData(&LAYOUT_KEY, &mut size, None);
                if size > 0 {
                    let mut buf = vec![0u8; size as usize];
                    if object
                        .GetPrivateData(&LAYOUT_KEY, &mut size, Some(buf.as_mut_ptr().cast()))
                        .is_ok()
                        && let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&buf)
                    {
                        row.signature = v["signature"].as_str().map(str::to_string);
                        row.json = v["elements"].to_string();
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    row
}

/// After `CreateInputLayout`: keeps the elements and the bytecode they were matched against on the layout, for
/// captures (the runtime has no way to read them back).
///
/// # Safety
/// `elements` must hold `count` element descriptions; `code` must point to `len` bytes; `out` is the call's.
pub unsafe fn input_layout_created(
    hr: windows::core::HRESULT,
    elements: *const D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC,
    count: u32,
    code: *const c_void,
    len: usize,
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
) {
    if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
        return;
    }
    let Some(layout) = (unsafe { ID3D11DeviceChild::from_raw_borrowed(&*out) }) else {
        return;
    };
    let elements: Vec<Value> = (0..count as usize)
        .map(|i| unsafe {
            let e = &*elements.add(i);
            let semantic = if e.SemanticName.is_null() {
                String::new()
            } else {
                e.SemanticName.to_string().unwrap_or_default()
            };
            json!({"semantic": semantic, "index": e.SemanticIndex, "format": e.Format.0, "slot": e.InputSlot,
                "offset": e.AlignedByteOffset, "per_instance": e.InputSlotClass.0 == 1,
                "step": e.InstanceDataStepRate})
        })
        .collect();
    let signature = if code.is_null() || len == 0 {
        None
    } else {
        let bytes = unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(code.cast::<u8>(), len) }.to_vec();
        let key = locum_capture::hash::key(&bytes);
        let blobs = &crate::settings::settings().blobs;
        locum_capture::writer::blob(blobs, key.clone(), bytes, true);
        Some(key)
    };
    let text = json!({"elements": elements, "signature": signature}).to_string();
    let _ = unsafe { layout.SetPrivateData(&LAYOUT_KEY, text.len() as u32, Some(text.as_ptr().cast())) };
}

```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! One-frame capture: everything a frame did on the GPU, with the state of every draw and the contents of every
//! resource it used, written to `captures/<name>/capture.db` with the contents in the blob store.
//!
//! Requested by creating the file `capture` in locum's folder; it is removed when seen. Everything is captured by
//! default; its lines can change that:
//! - `label NAME`: the capture's folder name (default `frame-<n>`);
//! - `skip targets`: no target readback at pass ends; `skip contents`: no resource contents;
//! - `max_mb N`: the most memory the copies of targets and of what draws and dispatches wrote through UAVs may use
//!   (default 4096);
//! - `skip memory`: no memory dump of the process (see [`super::dump`]).
//!
//! A capture runs over two frames:
//! - **before** (from the present that sees the file): deferred contexts record their work, so command lists
//!   recorded now and executed in the captured frame are complete;
//! - **recording** (the next frame): every draw, dispatch and resource-changing call on every context, in the order
//!   the GPU runs them (a command list's work where it is executed);
//! - **finish** (the present ending that frame): the copies are read and the capture is handed to the writer thread.
//!
//! A resource's contents as the frame began are copied on the immediate context just before the first event on the
//! GPU's timeline that touches it (reads or writes it): before an immediate-context call, or before the
//! `ExecuteCommandList` whose list touches it first. Nothing has touched it since the frame began, so the copy is
//! exact whatever the frame does to it later, on whichever context, and however often a list runs. Immutable
//! resources whose upload is stored are not copied: the upload is their contents.
//!
//! The state of each draw is read from the real context with its getters. Constant buffers are copied by the GPU on
//! the draw's own context, so each draw's constants are the ones the GPU read. A pass ends where the targets in
//! effect change on the GPU's timeline; its targets are read back there (see [`targets`]).

pub mod contents;
mod counters;
pub mod ids;
pub mod ops;
mod snapshot;
mod targets;
mod write;

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};

use locum_capture::cost::Cost;
use locum_capture::db;
use serde_json::Value;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;

use crate::d3d11::registry::Dims;
use crate::log::{folder, log};

use ids::buffer_id;
pub use ids::input_layout_created;

/// True from the request to the end of the captured frame: the only check on the hot paths otherwise.
static ARMED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub fn armed() -> bool {
    ARMED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
enum Phase {
    Idle,
    Before,
    Recording,
}

/// What a capture request asked for.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Request {
    label: Option<String>,
    targets: bool,
    contents: bool,
    memory: bool,
    max_target_bytes: u64,
}

impl Request {
    fn parse(text: &str) -> Request {
        let mut r = Request {
            label: None,
            targets: true,
            contents: true,
            memory: true,
            max_target_bytes: 4096 << 20,
        };
        for line in text.lines() {
            let mut words = line.split_whitespace();
            match (words.next(), words.next()) {
                (Some("label"), Some(name)) => {
                    let clean: String = name
                        .chars()
                        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "-_.".contains(*c))
                        .collect();
                    r.label = (!clean.is_empty()).then_some(clean);
                }
                (Some("skip"), Some("targets")) => r.targets = false,
                (Some("skip"), Some("contents")) => r.contents = false,
                (Some("skip"), Some("memory")) => r.memory = false,
                (Some("max_mb"), Some(n)) => {
                    if let Ok(n) = n.parse::<u64>() {
                        r.max_target_bytes = n << 20;
                    }
                }
                // Older requests asked for targets; they are on by default now.
                (Some("targets"), None) => {}
                (Some(other), _) => log!("capture request: unknown option {other:?} ignored"),
                (None, _) => {}
            }
        }
        r
    }
}

/// The context a call is made on: the real context, locum's number for it, and whether it is deferred.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Ctx<'a> {
    pub c: &'a ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    pub id: u32,
    pub deferred: bool,
}

/// A constant buffer bound at a draw and where its GPU copy went.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct CbCopy {
    /// Its row in the draw's bindings.
    binding: usize,
    source: Option<ID3D11Buffer>,
    first: u32,
    count: u32,
    /// The bound window intersects no constants in the buffer.
    empty: bool,
    /// Staging chunk, offset, bytes.
    copy: Option<(u32, u32, u32)>,
}

/// A draw's or dispatch's state.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub(super) struct Draw {
    shaders: [Option<String>; 6],
    bindings: Vec<db::Binding>,
    cb_copies: Vec<CbCopy>,
    viewports: Vec<db::Viewport>,
    scissors: Vec<db::Scissor>,
    topology: i32,
    layout: Option<u64>,
    rasterizer: Option<u64>,
    blend: Option<u64>,
    depth_stencil: Option<u64>,
    blend_factor: Option<[f32; 4]>,
    sample_mask: Option<u32>,
    stencil_ref: Option<u32>,
    predicate: Option<u64>,
    predicate_value: Option<bool>,
    /// The targets as they were when the pass this draw is the last of ended, and how many events (clears, copies,
    /// dispatches) after the draw on its context ran before that.
    after: Vec<targets::Target>,
    after_events: u32,
    /// The targets bound at the draw.
    bound: Vec<targets::Bound>,
    /// Whether the pass this draw ends has been dealt with.
    closed: bool,
    /// Whether one of its shaders writes what depends on the order the GPU runs its threads.
    order_dependent: bool,
    /// Copies of what it wrote through UAVs, made right after it ran (or why there is none).
    results: Vec<(u64, Result<contents::Readback, String>)>,
    results_taken: bool,
}

/// One thing a context did, as recorded on it.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct Event {
    kind: &'static str,
    call: &'static str,
    context: u32,
    deferred: bool,
    args: Value,
    /// Key of the bytes an update or map wrote.
    data: Option<String>,
    stack: Vec<u64>,
    draw: Option<Box<Draw>>,
    reads: Vec<u64>,
    writes: Vec<u64>,
    /// Views whose hidden counters this event uses or resets.
    counters: Vec<u64>,
    /// The number of the command list execution it came in with (set when spliced).
    list: Option<u64>,
}

/// A finished command list's events, whether it was finished before the captured frame, and how often the captured
/// frame executed it.
struct List {
    events: Vec<Event>,
    before: bool,
    executions: u32,
}

/// A resource the capture uses, held until it ends.
pub(super) struct Tracked {
    resource: ID3D11Resource,
    dims: Dims,
    /// Whether an event on the timeline has touched it (so its contents were copied, or are its upload).
    touched: bool,
}

struct State {
    phase: Phase,
    frame: u64,
    request: Request,
    /// Events recorded on a deferred context since its last FinishCommandList, by context id.
    pending: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<Event>>,
    /// Finished command lists, by address.
    lists: BTreeMap<usize, List>,
    timeline: Vec<Event>,
    lists_spliced: u32,
    lists_before: u32,
    lists_unrecorded: u32,
    /// Constant-buffer staging chunks and the bytes used in the last one.
    staging: Vec<ID3D11Buffer>,
    used: u32,
    copy_failures: u32,
    /// Bytes of target and output copies made so far, against the request's `max_mb`.
    target_bytes: u64,
    targets_skipped: u32,
    targets_skipped_bytes: u64,
    /// Captures requested so far: the current capture's number.
    captures: u64,
    views: Vec<db::View>,
    states: Vec<db::State>,
    resources: BTreeMap<u64, Tracked>,
    /// Copies of contents not read yet, and their bytes.
    in_flight: Vec<(u64, Result<contents::Readback, String>)>,
    in_flight_bytes: u64,
    /// Contents read so far (key and subresource keys), or why there are none.
    contents: BTreeMap<u64, contents::Read>,
    counter_views: BTreeMap<u64, ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>,
    counter_copies: BTreeMap<u64, Result<ID3D11Buffer, String>>,
    gaps: BTreeMap<(String, String), u64>,
}

static STATE: Mutex<State> = Mutex::new(State {
    phase: Phase::Idle,
    frame: 0,
    request: Request {
        label: None,
        targets: false,
        contents: false,
        memory: false,
        max_target_bytes: 0,
    },
    pending: BTreeMap::new(),
    lists: BTreeMap::new(),
    timeline: Vec::new(),
    lists_spliced: 0,
    lists_before: 0,
    lists_unrecorded: 0,
    staging: Vec::new(),
    used: 0,
    copy_failures: 0,
    target_bytes: 0,
    targets_skipped: 0,
    targets_skipped_bytes: 0,
    captures: 0,
    views: Vec::new(),
    states: Vec::new(),
    resources: BTreeMap::new(),
    in_flight: Vec::new(),
    in_flight_bytes: 0,
    contents: BTreeMap::new(),
    counter_views: BTreeMap::new(),
    counter_copies: BTreeMap::new(),
    gaps: BTreeMap::new(),
});

fn state() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, State> {
    STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

impl State {
    /// Whether work on a context is recorded now: deferred contexts from the request on, the immediate context only
    /// in the captured frame.
    fn records(&self, deferred: bool) -> bool {
        match self.phase {
            Phase::Idle => false,
            Phase::Before => deferred,
            Phase::Recording => true,
        }
    }

    fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.pending.clear();
        self.lists.clear();
        self.timeline.clear();
        self.lists_spliced = 0;
        self.lists_before = 0;
        self.lists_unrecorded = 0;
        self.staging.clear();
        self.used = 0;
        self.copy_failures = 0;
        self.target_bytes = 0;
        self.targets_skipped = 0;
        self.targets_skipped_bytes = 0;
        self.views.clear();
        self.states.clear();
        self.resources.clear();
        self.in_flight.clear();
        self.in_flight_bytes = 0;
        self.contents.clear();
        self.counter_views.clear();
        self.counter_copies.clear();
        self.gaps.clear();
    }
}

/// Ids for contexts, handed out as they are wrapped.
pub fn next_context_id() -> u32 {
    static NEXT: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
    NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// Gives up a capture in progress, if any, releasing everything it holds (a swap chain resize needs its back buffers
/// free). The request is not taken again: a new one is needed.
pub fn abandon(why: &str) {
    if !armed() {
        return;
    }
    let mut s = state();
    if s.phase == Phase::Idle {
        return;
    }
    ARMED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    s.phase = Phase::Idle;
    s.reset();
    drop(s);
    ops::reset();
    log!("capture abandoned: {why}");
}

/// At each present, before the real one (and after [`end_frame`]). Ends a frame being recorded.
pub fn before_present() -> bool {
    let mut s = state();
    s.frame += 1;
    if s.phase == Phase::Recording {
        ARMED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        s.phase = Phase::Idle;
        return true;
    }
    false
}

/// At each present, after the real one. `finished` is what [`before_present`] returned; `immediate` is the real
/// immediate context.
pub fn after_present(finished: bool, immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) {
    if finished {
        write::finish(immediate);
        return;
    }
    let phase = state().phase;
    match phase {
        Phase::Idle => {
            let mut s = state();
            // Look for a request every 30 frames.
            if !s.frame.is_multiple_of(30) {
                return;
            }
            let Some(path) = folder().map(|d| d.join("capture")) else {
                return;
            };
            let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
                return;
            };
            if std::fs::remove_file(&path).is_err() {
                return;
            }
            s.reset();
            s.request = Request::parse(&text);
            s.phase = Phase::Before;
            s.captures += 1;
            ARMED.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            log!(
                "capture requested at frame {}: {:?}; recording frame {}",
                s.frame,
                s.request,
                s.frame + 2
            );
            log!("  {}", crate::cost::line());
        }
        Phase::Before => start(),
        Phase::Recording => {}
    }
}

/// The present before the captured frame: the frame is recorded from here.
fn start() {
    state().phase = Phase::Recording;
    log!("capture: recording");
    log!("  getting ready, {}", crate::cost::line());
}

/// Copies the contents of each resource `event` touches that the timeline has not touched before, on the immediate
/// context `immediate`, before the caller makes the real call (see the module's documentation). A copy that would
/// take the bytes in flight past [`contents::IN_FLIGHT`] has those read first.
fn first_touch(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, event: &Event) {
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let todo: Vec<(u64, ID3D11Resource, u64)> = {
        let mut s = state();
        if s.phase != Phase::Recording || !s.request.contents {
            return;
        }
        let mut todo = Vec::new();
        for id in event.reads.iter().chain(&event.writes) {
            if let Some(t) = s.resources.get_mut(id)
                && !t.touched
            {
                t.touched = true;
                let bytes = t.dims.subs().map_or(0, |s| locum_capture::layout::total(&s));
                todo.push((*id, t.resource.clone(), bytes));
            }
        }
        todo
    };
    counters::touch(immediate, &event.counters);
    if todo.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let mut bytes = 0;
    for (id, resource, size) in todo {
        if write::upload_of(id).is_some() {
            continue;
        }
        let full = state().in_flight_bytes + size > contents::IN_FLIGHT;
        if full {
            read_in_flight(immediate);
        }
        let copy = unsafe { contents::issue(immediate, &resource) };
        bytes += size;
        let mut s = state();
        s.in_flight.push((id, copy));
        s.in_flight_bytes += size;
    }
    COPIED.add(started, bytes);
}

/// Reads the copies in flight (waiting for the GPU to make them), outside the capture's lock.
fn read_in_flight(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) {
    let copies = {
        let mut s = state();
        s.in_flight_bytes = 0;
        std::mem::take(&mut s.in_flight)
    };
    let read = unsafe { contents::read_all(immediate, copies) };
    state().contents.extend(read);
}

/// Contents copied before the timeline first touched them, with the time it took (and any reads keeping the copies
/// in flight under their limit).
pub static COPIED: Cost = Cost::new();

/// Records an event on a context, while armed. An event on the immediate context in the captured frame first has
/// the contents of what it touches copied (see [`first_touch`]); a deferred context's wait for its command list.
pub(super) fn record(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, event: Event) {
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    if !state().records(event.deferred) {
        return;
    }
    if event.deferred {
        state().pending.entry(event.context).or_default().push(event);
    } else {
        first_touch(c, &event);
        state().timeline.push(event);
    }
    RECORDED.add(started, 0);
}

/// Events recorded (the copies before them are [`COPIED`]).
pub static RECORDED: Cost = Cost::new();

/// What [`record`] does before recording an event, for a call recorded later: a map's resource is copied before the
/// map, and the map is recorded at the unmap, when its data is known.
pub(super) fn touch_only(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, event: &Event) {
    if !event.deferred {
        first_touch(c, event);
    }
}

fn new_event(kind: &'static str, call: &'static str, context: u32, deferred: bool, args: Value) -> Event {
    let mut counters: Vec<_> = args["view"].as_u64().into_iter().collect();
    counters.extend(
        args["set"]
            .as_array()
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter_map(|s| s["view"].as_u64()),
    );
    Event {
        kind,
        call,
        context,
        deferred,
        args,
        data: None,
        stack: Vec::new(),
        draw: None,
        reads: Vec::new(),
        writes: Vec::new(),
        counters,
        list: None,
    }
}

/// A draw or dispatch on a context, while armed. `context` is the real context it runs on.
pub fn on_draw(x: Ctx, call: &'static str, args: &[i64]) {
    draw_event(x, call, args.iter().map(|&a| Value::from(a)).collect(), &[]);
}

/// An indirect draw or dispatch, while armed: its arguments are the buffer's number and offset, and it reads the
/// buffer.
///
/// # Safety
/// `buffer` must be null or a live `ID3D11Buffer`.
pub unsafe fn on_indirect(x: Ctx, call: &'static str, buffer: *mut c_void, offset: u32) {
    let id = unsafe { buffer_id(buffer) };
    let reads: Vec<u64> = (id != 0).then_some(id).into_iter().collect();
    draw_event(x, call, vec![Value::from(id), Value::from(offset)], &reads);
}

fn draw_event(
    Ctx {
        c: context,
        id,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    call: &'static str,
    args: Vec<Value>,
    extra_reads: &[u64],
) {
    let (records, targets) = {
        let s = state();
        (s.records(deferred), s.request.targets)
    };
    let compute = call.starts_with("Dispatch");
    let mut draw = Box::<Draw>::default();
    let touches = unsafe { snapshot::snapshot(context, compute, &mut draw) };
    if records {
        if targets && !compute {
            draw.bound = unsafe { targets::bound(context) };
        }
        // Constant-buffer copies, recorded on this context right now.
        for cb in &mut draw.cb_copies {
            cb.copy = unsafe { snapshot::copy_cb(context, cb) };
        }
    }
    let kind = if compute { "dispatch" } else { "draw" };
    let mut event = new_event(kind, call, id, deferred, Value::Array(args));
    event.reads = touches.reads;
    event.reads.extend_from_slice(extra_reads);
    event.writes = touches.writes;
    event.counters.extend(
        draw.bindings
            .iter()
            .filter(|b| b.kind == "uav")
            .filter_map(|b| b.view),
    );
    event.draw = Some(draw);
    record(context, event);
}

/// After a draw or dispatch ran on a context, while armed: what it wrote through UAVs is copied now, on its context,
/// within the capture's memory limit. Replay checks its own output against the game's and goes on from the game's, so
/// the first event whose output differs is the one named, and what follows is compared from the game's state. For a
/// shader whose writes depend on the order the GPU runs its threads, the same records in another order are that
/// order, not a difference.
pub fn after_draw(
    Ctx {
        c: context,
        id,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
) {
    let uavs: Vec<(u64, ID3D11Resource)> = {
        let mut s = state();
        if !s.records(deferred) || !s.request.contents {
            return;
        }
        let last = if deferred {
            s.pending.get_mut(&id).and_then(|p| p.last_mut())
        } else {
            s.timeline.last_mut()
        };
        let Some(d) = last.and_then(|e| e.draw.as_deref_mut()) else {
            return;
        };
        if d.results_taken {
            return;
        }
        d.results_taken = true;
        let mut ids: Vec<u64> = d
            .bindings
            .iter()
            .filter(|b| b.kind == "uav")
            .filter_map(|b| b.resource)
            .collect();
        ids.sort_unstable();
        ids.dedup();
        ids.into_iter()
            .filter_map(|i| s.resources.get(&i).map(|t| (i, t.resource.clone())))
            .collect()
    };
    let results: Vec<(u64, Result<contents::Readback, String>)> = uavs
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(i, r)| (i, unsafe { output_copy(context, &r) }))
        .collect();
    let mut s = state();
    let last = if deferred {
        s.pending.get_mut(&id).and_then(|p| p.last_mut())
    } else {
        s.timeline.last_mut()
    };
    if let Some(d) = last.and_then(|e| e.draw.as_deref_mut()) {
        d.results = results;
    }
}

/// A copy of what a draw or dispatch wrote to `resource`, unless it would take the capture past its memory limit.
///
/// # Safety
/// `resource` must be a live resource of `context`'s device.
unsafe fn output_copy(
    context: &ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    resource: &ID3D11Resource,
) -> Result<contents::Readback, String> {
    let bytes = locum_d3d11::readback::bytes(resource)?;
    {
        let mut s = state();
        if s.target_bytes + bytes > s.request.max_target_bytes {
            return Err(OVER_LIMIT.into());
        }
        s.target_bytes += bytes;
    }
    unsafe { contents::issue(context, resource) }
}

/// Why an output was not copied: the capture's target and output copies reached `max_mb`.
pub(super) const OVER_LIMIT: &str = "over the capture's memory limit (max_mb)";

/// `OMSetRenderTargets` (or `ClearState`, with no targets) on a context, while armed: if it binds other targets than
/// the context's last draw used, that draw ended a pass and its targets are copied now, on this context.
///
/// # Safety
/// `rtvs` must hold null or live render target views, `dsv` null or a live depth stencil view.
pub unsafe fn targets_changing(
    Ctx {
        c: context,
        id,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    rtvs: &[*mut c_void],
    dsv: *mut c_void,
) {
    if !state().request.targets {
        return;
    }
    let next = unsafe { targets::from_raw(rtvs, dsv) };
    if !deferred {
        close_timeline_pass(context, Some(&next));
        return;
    }
    let (index, bound) = {
        let s = state();
        if !s.records(true) {
            return;
        }
        let Some(pending) = s.pending.get(&id) else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(index) = pending.iter().rposition(|e| e.kind == "draw") else {
            return;
        };
        match pending[index].draw.as_deref() {
            Some(last) if !last.closed && !last.bound.is_empty() && !targets::same(&last.bound, &next) => {
                (index, last.bound.clone())
            }
            _ => return,
        }
    };
    let copied = unsafe { targets::copy(context, &bound) };
    let mut s = state();
    let Some(pending) = s.pending.get_mut(&id) else {
        return;
    };
    let after_events = (pending.len() - 1 - index) as u32;
    if let Some(last) = pending.get_mut(index).and_then(|e| e.draw.as_deref_mut()) {
        last.after = copied;
        last.after_events = after_events;
        last.closed = true;
    }
}

/// The timeline's last draw, if it is the last event that is a draw.
fn last_timeline_draw(s: &mut State) -> Option<(usize, &mut Draw)> {
    let index = s.timeline.iter().rposition(|e| e.kind == "draw")?;
    let draw = s.timeline[index].draw.as_deref_mut()?;
    Some((index, draw))
}

/// Copies the targets of the timeline's last draw, on the immediate context `immediate`, unless that pass is closed
/// already or `next` (the targets about to be used) are the same ones.
fn close_timeline_pass(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, next: Option<&[targets::Bound]>) {
    let (index, bound) = {
        let mut s = state();
        if !s.request.targets || s.phase != Phase::Recording {
            return;
        }
        let Some((index, last)) = last_timeline_draw(&mut s) else {
            return;
        };
        if last.closed || last.bound.is_empty() || next.is_some_and(|n| targets::same(&last.bound, n)) {
            return;
        }
        (index, last.bound.clone())
    };
    let copied = unsafe { targets::copy(immediate, &bound) };
    let mut s = state();
    let after_events = (s.timeline.len() - 1 - index) as u32;
    if let Some(d) = s.timeline[index].draw.as_deref_mut() {
        d.after = copied;
        d.after_events = after_events;
        d.closed = true;
    }
}

/// At each present, before [`before_present`]: the frame's last pass ends.
pub fn end_frame(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) {
    if armed() {
        close_timeline_pass(immediate, None);
    }
}

/// A deferred context's FinishCommandList: its pending events (possibly none) belong to the list.
pub fn on_finish_list(id: u32, list: *mut c_void) {
    let mut s = state();
    let events = s.pending.remove(&id).unwrap_or_default();
    let before = s.phase == Phase::Before;
    if !list.is_null() {
        s.lists.insert(
            list as usize,
            List {
                events,
                before,
                executions: 0,
            },
        );
    }
}

/// ExecuteCommandList on `context`. On the immediate context the list's events join the timeline (after the pass
/// before them is closed if the list starts with other targets); on a deferred context (a list run from inside
/// another) they join that context's pending events. A list can be executed more than once, so its recording is kept
/// until the capture ends.
pub fn on_execute_list(
    Ctx {
        c: context,
        id,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    list: *mut c_void,
) {
    let first = {
        let mut s = state();
        if !s.records(deferred) {
            return;
        }
        match s.lists.get(&(list as usize)) {
            Some(l) => l
                .events
                .iter()
                .find_map(|e| e.draw.as_deref().filter(|_| e.kind == "draw"))
                .map(|d| d.bound.clone()),
            None => {
                if !deferred {
                    s.lists_unrecorded += 1;
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    };
    if !deferred {
        if let Some(first) = first {
            close_timeline_pass(context, Some(&first));
        }
        // What the list touches first is copied before it runs.
        let touches = {
            let s = state();
            let mut e = new_event("execute", "ExecuteCommandList", id, false, Value::Null);
            if let Some(l) = s.lists.get(&(list as usize)) {
                for le in &l.events {
                    e.reads.extend_from_slice(&le.reads);
                    e.writes.extend_from_slice(&le.writes);
                    e.counters.extend_from_slice(&le.counters);
                }
            }
            e
        };
        first_touch(context, &touches);
    }
    let mut s = state();
    let number = u64::from(s.lists_spliced);
    let Some(l) = s.lists.get_mut(&(list as usize)) else {
        return;
    };
    l.executions += 1;
    let (mut events, before) = (l.events.clone(), l.before);
    if deferred {
        s.pending.entry(id).or_default().extend(events);
    } else {
        for e in &mut events {
            e.list = Some(number);
        }
        s.lists_spliced += 1;
        s.lists_before += u32::from(before);
        s.timeline.extend(events);
    }
}

/// The resources the timeline touches, in the order it first touches them, with whether it writes them.
pub(super) fn touched(timeline: &[Event]) -> (BTreeSet<u64>, BTreeSet<u64>) {
    let mut used = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut written = BTreeSet::new();
    for e in timeline {
        used.extend(e.reads.iter().copied());
        used.extend(e.writes.iter().copied());
        written.extend(e.writes.iter().copied());
    }
    (used, written)
}

```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/ops.rs`:

```rs
//! The calls besides draws that change what is on the GPU, recorded as events while a capture runs: maps, updates,
//! copies, clears, resolves, mip generation, discards.
//!
//! **Maps.** While a capture runs, a write map hands the game a shadow in locum's memory instead of the driver's
//! (write-combined, slow to read) memory; at `Unmap` the whole shadow is copied to the driver's memory and the bytes
//! the game wrote are recorded. A discard map's shadow starts as a known pattern, so what differs from it is what was
//! written; any other write map's shadow starts as the resource's contents (from locum's own copy when it has one,
//! else read from the mapping) and what changed is what was written. The game's data reaches the driver in full
//! either way. Read maps are passed through.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use locum_capture::cost::Cost;
use locum_capture::layout;
use locum_capture::{hash, maps, stacks, writer};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::core::{HRESULT, Interface};

pub use super::Ctx;
use super::ids::{resource_id, view_ids};
use super::{armed, new_event, record};
use crate::d3d11::registry;
use crate::settings::settings;

/// A map handed out with a shadow.
struct Shadow {
    real: *mut c_void,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    /// What the shadow started as, when not the discard pattern.
    reference: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    map_type: i32,
    row_pitch: u32,
    depth_pitch: u32,
    resource_id: u64,
    context: u32,
    deferred: bool,
}

unsafe impl Send for Shadow {}

/// Shadows by (context, resource, subresource) address.
type Shadows = HashMap<(usize, usize, u32), Shadow>;
static SHADOWS: Mutex<Option<Shadows>> = Mutex::new(None);
/// Maps given a shadow (bytes) and unmaps of one recorded, on the game's threads.
pub static SHADOWED: Cost = Cost::new();
static OUTSTANDING: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
/// The last bytes locum wrote through each (context, resource, subresource) during this capture: the contents a
/// following no-overwrite map starts from.
type Mirrors = HashMap<(u32, u64, u32), Vec<u8>>;
static MIRRORS: Mutex<Option<Mirrors>> = Mutex::new(None);

/// Clears the mirrors when a capture ends.
pub(super) fn reset() {
    *MIRRORS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = None;
}

/// `Map` on a context. `real` makes the real call.
///
/// # Safety
/// The arguments are the call's.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub unsafe fn map(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    resource: *mut c_void,
    sub: u32,
    map_type: D3D11_MAP,
    out: *mut D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE,
    real: impl FnOnce() -> HRESULT,
) -> HRESULT {
    if !armed() {
        return real();
    }
    let Some(r) = (unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&resource) }) else {
        return real();
    };
    let id = resource_id(r);
    let write = map_type != D3D11_MAP_READ;
    let mut e = new_event(
        "map",
        "Map",
        context,
        deferred,
        json!({"resource": id, "sub": sub, "type": map_type.0}),
    );
    // The resource is copied before the map (a mapped resource cannot be copied); a write is recorded at the unmap,
    // a read now.
    if write {
        e.kind = "map_begin";
        e.writes.push(id);
        super::touch_only(c, &e);
    } else {
        e.kind = "map_read";
        e.reads.push(id);
        super::touch_only(c, &e);
    }
    let hr = real();
    if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || !write {
        if hr.is_ok() && !write {
            record(c, e);
        }
        return hr;
    }
    let Some((kind, Some(s))) = registry::sub_of(id, sub) else {
        return hr;
    };
    let m = unsafe { &mut *out };
    let size = if kind == "buffer" {
        s.size as usize
    } else if s.depth > 1 {
        m.DepthPitch as usize * s.depth as usize
    } else {
        m.RowPitch as usize * s.rows as usize
    };
    if size == 0 || m.pData.is_null() {
        return hr;
    }
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut data = vec![0u8; size];
    let reference = if map_type == D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD {
        maps::fill(&mut data);
        None
    } else {
        // A dynamic resource changes only through maps, so what locum last wrote through this context is what its
        // memory holds; anything else (a staging resource the GPU copies into) is read from the map itself.
        let mirror = dynamic(r)
            .then(|| {
                MIRRORS
                    .lock()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|m| m.get(&(context, id, sub)).filter(|v| v.len() == size).cloned())
            })
            .flatten();
        match mirror {
            Some(v) => data = v,
            None => unsafe { core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(m.pData.cast::<u8>(), data.as_mut_ptr(), size) },
        }
        Some(data.clone())
    };
    let shadow = Shadow {
        real: m.pData,
        data,
        reference,
        map_type: map_type.0,
        row_pitch: m.RowPitch,
        depth_pitch: m.DepthPitch,
        resource_id: id,
        context,
        deferred,
    };
    let mut shadows = SHADOWS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let map = shadows.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new);
    let key = (c.as_raw() as usize, resource as usize, sub);
    let entry = map.entry(key).insert_entry(shadow);
    m.pData = entry.get().data.as_ptr() as *mut c_void;
    OUTSTANDING.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    SHADOWED.add(started, size as u64);
    hr
}

/// `Unmap` on a context. `real` makes the real call.
///
/// # Safety
/// The arguments are the call's.
pub unsafe fn unmap(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, resource: *mut c_void, sub: u32, real: impl FnOnce()) {
    if OUTSTANDING.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 {
        return real();
    }
    let shadow = SHADOWS
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .as_mut()
        .and_then(|m| m.remove(&(c.as_raw() as usize, resource as usize, sub)));
    let Some(shadow) = shadow else { return real() };
    OUTSTANDING.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    // A discarding map hands out memory with nothing in it, so all of the shadow goes (the pattern where the game
    // wrote nothing); any other map gets back only the words the game wrote, and the rest stays as it was.
    match &shadow.reference {
        None => unsafe {
            core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(shadow.data.as_ptr(), shadow.real.cast::<u8>(), shadow.data.len())
        },
        Some(reference) => {
            for (a, b) in maps::changed(&shadow.data, Some(reference)) {
                unsafe {
                    core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
                        shadow.data.as_ptr().add(a),
                        shadow.real.cast::<u8>().add(a),
                        b - a,
                    )
                };
            }
        }
    }
    real();
    if !armed() {
        return;
    }
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let ranges = maps::written(&shadow.data, shadow.reference.as_deref());
    let texture = registry::sub_of(shadow.resource_id, sub).filter(|(kind, _)| *kind != "buffer");
    let (bytes, args) = match texture {
        // A texture's map is recorded as its whole subresource, tightly packed.
        Some((_, s)) => {
            let Some(s) = s else { return };
            let mut packed = Vec::with_capacity(s.size as usize);
            unsafe {
                layout::pack(
                    &s,
                    shadow.data.as_ptr(),
                    shadow.row_pitch as usize,
                    shadow.depth_pitch as usize,
                    &mut packed,
                )
            };
            (
                packed,
                json!({"resource": shadow.resource_id, "sub": sub, "type": shadow.map_type, "whole": true}),
            )
        }
        None => {
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            for &(a, b) in &ranges {
                out.extend_from_slice(&shadow.data[a..b]);
            }
            let r: Vec<Value> = ranges.iter().map(|&(a, b)| json!([a, b - a])).collect();
            (
                out,
                json!({"resource": shadow.resource_id, "sub": sub, "type": shadow.map_type, "ranges": r}),
            )
        }
    };
    MIRRORS
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new)
        .insert((shadow.context, shadow.resource_id, sub), shadow.data);
    let key = hash::key(&bytes);
    let blobs = &settings().blobs;
    writer::blob(blobs, key.clone(), bytes, true);
    let mut e = new_event("map", "Unmap", shadow.context, shadow.deferred, args);
    e.data = Some(key);
    e.stack = stacks::capture();
    e.writes.push(shadow.resource_id);
    record(c, e);
    SHADOWED.add(started, 0);
}

/// Whether `r` was made with `D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC`.
fn dynamic(r: &ID3D11Resource) -> bool {
    let usage = if let Ok(b) = r.cast::<ID3D11Buffer>() {
        let mut d = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC::default();
        unsafe { b.GetDesc(&mut d) };
        d.Usage
    } else if let Ok(t) = r.cast::<ID3D11Texture2D>() {
        let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC::default();
        unsafe { t.GetDesc(&mut d) };
        d.Usage
    } else if let Ok(t) = r.cast::<ID3D11Texture1D>() {
        let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE1D_DESC::default();
        unsafe { t.GetDesc(&mut d) };
        d.Usage
    } else if let Ok(t) = r.cast::<ID3D11Texture3D>() {
        let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE3D_DESC::default();
        unsafe { t.GetDesc(&mut d) };
        d.Usage
    } else {
        return false;
    };
    usage == D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC
}

fn res(raw: *mut c_void) -> Option<ID3D11Resource> {
    unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&raw) }.cloned()
}

fn view(raw: *mut c_void) -> Option<ID3D11View> {
    unsafe { ID3D11View::from_raw_borrowed(&raw) }.cloned()
}

fn box_json(b: *const D3D11_BOX) -> Value {
    if b.is_null() {
        return Value::Null;
    }
    let b = unsafe { &*b };
    json!([b.left, b.top, b.front, b.right, b.bottom, b.back])
}

/// An event that reads `reads` and writes `writes`.
fn op(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    kind: &'static str,
    call: &'static str,
    args: Value,
    reads: &[u64],
    writes: &[u64],
) {
    let mut e = new_event(kind, call, context, deferred, args);
    e.reads = reads.to_vec();
    e.writes = writes.to_vec();
    record(c, e);
}

pub fn copy_resource(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    dst: *mut c_void,
    src: *mut c_void,
) {
    let (Some(d), Some(s)) = (res(dst), res(src)) else {
        return;
    };
    let (d, s) = (resource_id(&d), resource_id(&s));
    op(
        Ctx {
            c,
            id: context,
            deferred,
        },
        "copy",
        "CopyResource",
        json!({"dst": d, "src": s}),
        &[s],
        &[d],
    );
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn copy_region(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    call: &'static str,
    dst: *mut c_void,
    dst_sub: u32,
    at: [u32; 3],
    src: *mut c_void,
    src_sub: u32,
    region: *const D3D11_BOX,
    flags: u32,
) {
    let (Some(d), Some(s)) = (res(dst), res(src)) else {
        return;
    };
    let (d, s) = (resource_id(&d), resource_id(&s));
    let args = json!({"dst": d, "dst_sub": dst_sub, "at": at, "src": s, "src_sub": src_sub, "box": box_json(region),
        "flags": flags});
    op(
        Ctx {
            c,
            id: context,
            deferred,
        },
        "copy_region",
        call,
        args,
        &[s],
        &[d],
    );
}

/// `UpdateSubresource` while armed: the bytes it writes (canonical layout of the region) go to the blob store.
///
/// # Safety
/// The arguments are the call's.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub unsafe fn update(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    call: &'static str,
    dst: *mut c_void,
    sub: u32,
    region: *const D3D11_BOX,
    data: *const c_void,
    row_pitch: u32,
    depth_pitch: u32,
    flags: u32,
) {
    let Some(d) = res(dst) else { return };
    let id = resource_id(&d);
    let region_ref = if region.is_null() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(unsafe { &*region })
    };
    let bytes = unsafe { registry::updated(&d, sub, region_ref, data, row_pitch, depth_pitch, true) };
    let mut e = new_event(
        "update",
        call,
        context,
        deferred,
        json!({"dst": id, "sub": sub, "box": box_json(region), "flags": flags}),
    );
    if let Some((bytes, key)) = bytes {
        let blobs = &settings().blobs;
        writer::blob(blobs, key.clone(), bytes, true);
        e.data = Some(key);
    }
    e.stack = stacks::capture();
    e.writes.push(id);
    record(c, e);
}

fn view_target(raw: *mut c_void) -> Option<(u64, u64)> {
    view(raw).map(|v| view_ids(&v))
}

    );
}

pub fn clear_view(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    target: *mut c_void,
    color: *const f32,
    rects: *const windows::Win32::Foundation::RECT,

        &[r],
    );
}

}

pub fn discard(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    call: &'static str,
    target: *mut c_void,
) {
    // A discard leaves the resource undefined: it counts as a write, so the contents are copied before it.
    let id = if call == "DiscardResource" {
        res(target).map(|r| {
            let id = resource_id(&r);
            ("resource", id, id)
        })
    } else {
        view_target(target).map(|(v, r)| ("view", v, r))
    };
    let Some((what, id, resource)) = id else {
        return;
    };
    let mut args = serde_json::Map::new();
    args.insert(what.into(), id.into());
    op(
        Ctx {
            c,
            id: context,
            deferred,
        },
        "discard",
        call,
        Value::Object(args),
        &[],
        &[resource],
    );
}

/// UAV counters set when UAVs are bound (`-1` keeps the counter).
pub fn uav_counters(
    Ctx {
        c,
        id: context,
        deferred,
    }: Ctx,
    call: &'static str,
    start: u32,
    views: *const *mut c_void,
    counts: *const u32,
    n: u32,
) {
    if counts.is_null() || views.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    let mut set = Vec::new();
    let mut written = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..n as usize {
        let count = unsafe { *counts.add(i) };
        if count == u32::MAX {
            continue;
        }
        let raw = unsafe { *views.add(i) };
        if let Some((v, resource)) = view_target(raw) {
            set.push(json!({"slot": start + i as u32, "view": v, "count": count}));
            written.push(resource);
        }
    }
    if !set.is_empty() {
        op(
            Ctx {
                c,
                id: context,
                deferred,
            },
            "uav_counter",
            call,
            json!({"set": set}),
            &[],
            &written,
        );
    }
}
```
