`locum/src/d3d11/capture/snapshot.rs`:

```rs
//! The state a draw or dispatch runs with, read from the real context with its getters, and the GPU copies of its
//! constant buffers.

use locum_capture::db;
use windows::Win32::Foundation::RECT;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_FORMAT;
use windows::core::{BOOL, Interface};

use super::ids::{resource_id, state_id, view_ids};
use super::{CbCopy, Draw, state};
use crate::d3d11::shaders::{self, Stage};
use crate::d3d11::stages;
use locum_d3d11::predication::unpredicated;

/// Staging buffers for constant-buffer copies: 32 MiB each, at most 16 (512 MiB) per capture.
pub(super) const CHUNK: u32 = 32 << 20;
const MAX_CHUNKS: usize = 16;
/// The most of one bound constant-buffer range copied (the whole D3D11 limit is 64 KiB: 4096 constants).
const MAX_CB_COPY: u32 = 65536;
/// UAV slots: 64 on Direct3D 11.1.
const UAV_SLOTS: u32 = D3D11_1_UAV_SLOT_COUNT;

fn stage_index(stage: Stage) -> usize {
    match stage {
        Stage::Vertex => 0,
        Stage::Hull => 1,
        Stage::Domain => 2,
        Stage::Geometry => 3,
        Stage::Pixel => 4,
        Stage::Compute => 5,
    }
}

fn binding(stage: &'static str, kind: &'static str, slot: u32) -> db::Binding {
    db::Binding {
        stage,
        kind,
        slot,
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

/// What a draw reads and writes, by resource number.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Touches {
    pub reads: Vec<u64>,
    pub writes: Vec<u64>,
}

/// Reads the state a draw runs with from the real context into `draw`, and the resources it reads and writes.
pub(super) unsafe fn snapshot(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, compute: bool, draw: &mut Draw) -> Touches {
    let mut t = Touches::default();
    let stages: &[Stage] = if compute {
        &[Stage::Compute]
    } else {
        &Stage::GRAPHICS
    };
    for &stage in stages {
        let Some(shader) = (unsafe { stages::shader(c, stage) }) else {
            continue;
        };
        let name = stage.short();
        let hash = unsafe { shaders::hash_of(shader.as_raw()) };
        draw.order_dependent |= hash.is_some_and(shaders::order_dependent);
        draw.shaders[stage_index(stage)] =
            Some(hash.map_or_else(|| "unknown".into(), |h| format!("{h:016x}")));
        for (slot, b) in unsafe { stages::constant_buffers(c, stage) }
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
        {
            let Some(buffer) = b.buffer else { continue };
            let resource: ID3D11Resource = buffer.cast().expect("a buffer is a resource");
            let id = resource_id(&resource);
            t.reads.push(id);
            let mut row = binding(name, "cb", slot as u32);
            row.resource = Some(id);
            row.offset = Some(u64::from(b.first) * 16);
            row.size = Some(u64::from(b.count) * 16);
            draw.cb_copies.push(CbCopy {
                binding: draw.bindings.len(),
                source: Some(buffer),
                first: b.first,
                count: b.count,
                empty: false,
                copy: None,
            });
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        for (slot, view) in unsafe { stages::shader_resources(c, stage) }.iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(view) = view else { continue };
            let v: ID3D11View = view.cast().expect("a shader resource view is a view");
            let (id, resource) = view_ids(&v);
            t.reads.push(resource);
            let mut row = binding(name, "srv", slot as u32);
            row.view = Some(id);
            row.resource = Some(resource);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        for (slot, sampler) in unsafe { stages::samplers(c, stage) }.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(id) = state_id(sampler, "sampler") else {
                continue;
            };
            let mut row = binding(name, "sampler", slot as u32);
            row.state = Some(id);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
    }
    unsafe {
        let D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY(topology) = c.IAGetPrimitiveTopology();
        draw.topology = topology;
        let mut predicate = None;
        let mut value = BOOL::default();
        c.GetPredication(Some(&mut predicate), Some(&mut value));
        if predicate.is_some() {
            draw.predicate = state_id(predicate, "predicate");
            draw.predicate_value = Some(value.as_bool());
        }
    }
    if compute {
        let mut uavs: [Option<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>; UAV_SLOTS as usize] =
            [const { None }; UAV_SLOTS as usize];
        unsafe { c.CSGetUnorderedAccessViews(0, Some(&mut uavs)) };
        uav_bindings(draw, &mut t, "cs", &uavs);
        return t;
    }
    unsafe {
        let mut rtvs: [Option<ID3D11RenderTargetView>; 8] = Default::default();
        let mut dsv = None;
        c.OMGetRenderTargets(Some(&mut rtvs), Some(&mut dsv));
        for (slot, view) in rtvs.iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(view) = view else { continue };
            let v: ID3D11View = view.cast().expect("a render target view is a view");
            let (id, resource) = view_ids(&v);
            t.reads.push(resource);
            t.writes.push(resource);
            let mut row = binding("om", "rtv", slot as u32);
            row.view = Some(id);
            row.resource = Some(resource);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        if let Some(view) = dsv {
            let v: ID3D11View = view.cast().expect("a depth stencil view is a view");
            let (id, resource) = view_ids(&v);
            t.reads.push(resource);
            t.writes.push(resource);
            let mut row = binding("om", "dsv", 0);
            row.view = Some(id);
            row.resource = Some(resource);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        let mut uavs: [Option<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>; UAV_SLOTS as usize] =
            [const { None }; UAV_SLOTS as usize];
        c.OMGetRenderTargetsAndUnorderedAccessViews(None, None, 0, Some(&mut uavs));
        uav_bindings(draw, &mut t, "om", &uavs);

        draw.layout = state_id(c.IAGetInputLayout().ok(), "input_layout");
        let mut vbs: [Option<ID3D11Buffer>; 32] = Default::default();
        let mut strides = [0u32; 32];
        let mut offsets = [0u32; 32];
        c.IAGetVertexBuffers(
            0,
            32,
            Some(vbs.as_mut_ptr()),
            Some(strides.as_mut_ptr()),
            Some(offsets.as_mut_ptr()),
        );
        for (slot, vb) in vbs.iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(vb) = vb else { continue };
            let resource: ID3D11Resource = vb.cast().expect("a buffer is a resource");
            let id = resource_id(&resource);
            t.reads.push(id);
            let mut row = binding("ia", "vb", slot as u32);
            row.resource = Some(id);
            row.offset = Some(u64::from(offsets[slot]));
            row.stride = Some(strides[slot]);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        let mut ib = None;
        let mut ib_format = DXGI_FORMAT::default();
        let mut ib_offset = 0u32;
        c.IAGetIndexBuffer(Some(&mut ib), Some(&mut ib_format), Some(&mut ib_offset));
        if let Some(ib) = ib {
            let resource: ID3D11Resource = ib.cast().expect("a buffer is a resource");
            let id = resource_id(&resource);
            t.reads.push(id);
            let mut row = binding("ia", "ib", 0);
            row.resource = Some(id);
            row.offset = Some(u64::from(ib_offset));
            row.format = Some(ib_format.0 as u32);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }
        let mut so: [Option<ID3D11Buffer>; 4] = Default::default();
        c.SOGetTargets(Some(&mut so));
        for (slot, b) in so.iter().enumerate() {
            let Some(b) = b else { continue };
            let resource: ID3D11Resource = b.cast().expect("a buffer is a resource");
            let id = resource_id(&resource);
            t.writes.push(id);
            let mut row = binding("so", "so", slot as u32);
            row.resource = Some(id);
            draw.bindings.push(row);
        }

        draw.rasterizer = state_id(c.RSGetState().ok(), "rasterizer");
        let mut blend = None;
        let mut factor = [0f32; 4];
        let mut mask = 0u32;
        c.OMGetBlendState(Some(&mut blend), Some(&mut factor), Some(&mut mask));
        draw.blend = state_id(blend, "blend");
        draw.blend_factor = Some(factor);
        draw.sample_mask = Some(mask);
        let mut depth = None;
        let mut stencil_ref = 0u32;
        c.OMGetDepthStencilState(Some(&mut depth), Some(&mut stencil_ref));
        draw.depth_stencil = state_id(depth, "depth_stencil");
        draw.stencil_ref = Some(stencil_ref);

        let mut count = D3D11_VIEWPORT_AND_SCISSORRECT_OBJECT_COUNT_PER_PIPELINE;
        let mut viewports = [D3D11_VIEWPORT::default(); 16];
        c.RSGetViewports(&mut count, Some(viewports.as_mut_ptr()));
        for (i, v) in viewports[..count.min(16) as usize].iter().enumerate() {
            draw.viewports.push(db::Viewport {
                draw: 0,
                i: i as u32,
                x: v.TopLeftX,
                y: v.TopLeftY,
                width: v.Width,
                height: v.Height,
                min_depth: v.MinDepth,
                max_depth: v.MaxDepth,
            });
        }
        let mut count = D3D11_VIEWPORT_AND_SCISSORRECT_OBJECT_COUNT_PER_PIPELINE;
        let mut rects = [RECT::default(); 16];
        c.RSGetScissorRects(&mut count, Some(rects.as_mut_ptr()));
        for (i, r) in rects[..count.min(16) as usize].iter().enumerate() {
            draw.scissors.push(db::Scissor {
                draw: 0,
                i: i as u32,
                left: r.left,
                top: r.top,
                right: r.right,
                bottom: r.bottom,
            });
        }
    }
    t
}

fn uav_bindings(
    draw: &mut Draw,
    t: &mut Touches,
    stage: &'static str,
    uavs: &[Option<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>],
) {
    for (slot, view) in uavs.iter().enumerate() {
        let Some(view) = view else { continue };
        let v: ID3D11View = view.cast().expect("an unordered access view is a view");
        let (id, resource) = view_ids(&v);
        t.reads.push(resource);
        t.writes.push(resource);
        let mut row = binding(stage, "uav", slot as u32);
        row.view = Some(id);
        row.resource = Some(resource);
        draw.bindings.push(row);
    }
}

/// Records a GPU copy of the bound range of a constant buffer into the staging pool, on context `c`.
pub(super) unsafe fn copy_cb(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, cb: &mut CbCopy) -> Option<(u32, u32, u32)> {
    let source = cb.source.take()?;
    let mut desc = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC::default();
    unsafe { source.GetDesc(&mut desc) };
    let start = cb.first.saturating_mul(16).min(desc.ByteWidth);
    let wanted = cb.count.saturating_mul(16);
    let bytes = wanted.min(desc.ByteWidth - start).min(MAX_CB_COPY);
    if bytes == 0 {
        cb.empty = true;
        return None;
    }
    let (chunk, offset, staging) = {
        let mut s = state();
        let aligned = (bytes + 15) & !15;
        if s.staging.is_empty() || s.used + aligned > CHUNK {
            if s.staging.len() >= MAX_CHUNKS {
                s.copy_failures += 1;
                return None;
            }
            let device = unsafe { c.GetDevice() }.ok()?;
            let d = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC {
                ByteWidth: CHUNK,
                Usage: D3D11_USAGE_STAGING,
                CPUAccessFlags: D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ.0 as u32,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let mut buffer = None;
            if unsafe { device.CreateBuffer(&d, None, Some(&mut buffer)) }.is_err() {
                s.copy_failures += 1;
                return None;
            }
            s.staging.push(buffer?);
            s.used = 0;
        }
        let chunk = s.staging.len() as u32 - 1;
        let offset = s.used;
        s.used += aligned;
        (chunk, offset, s.staging[chunk as usize].clone())
    };
    let source_box = D3D11_BOX {
        left: start,
        top: 0,
        front: 0,
        right: start + bytes,
        bottom: 1,
        back: 1,
    };
    unsafe {
        unpredicated(c, || {
            c.CopySubresourceRegion(&staging, 0, offset, 0, 0, &source, 0, Some(&source_box))
        })
    };
    Some((chunk, offset, bytes))
}
```

```rs
//! Render and depth targets read back at the end of each pass, in the format the pass drew in (depth as the colour
//! format of the same bits), into the blob store.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::*;
use windows::core::Interface;

use super::ids::view_ids;
use super::state;
use crate::log::log;
use locum_d3d11::predication::unpredicated;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Target {
    /// `rt0` to `rt7`, or `depth`.
    pub target: String,
    pub view: u64,
    pub resource: u64,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    /// The format it is read as: the view's, with depth and typeless formats as the readable format of the same bits.
    pub format: i32,
    /// The subresource of the resource the view writes.
    pub sub: u32,
    staging: Option<ID3D11Texture2D>,
}

/// A target bound at a draw, kept with the draw so that it can be copied later, on another context.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Bound {
    /// `rt0` to `rt7`, or `depth`.
    target: String,
    view: ID3D11View,
    format: DXGI_FORMAT,
    dimension: i32,
    mip: u32,
    slice: u32,
    depth: bool,
}

/// Whether two sets of targets are the same views in the same slots.
pub(super) fn same(a: &[Bound], b: &[Bound]) -> bool {
    a.len() == b.len()
        && a.iter()
            .zip(b)
            .all(|(x, y)| x.target == y.target && x.view.as_raw() == y.view.as_raw())
}

fn render_target(slot: usize, view: &ID3D11RenderTargetView) -> Bound {
    let mut d = D3D11_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC::default();
    unsafe { view.GetDesc(&mut d) };
    let (mip, slice) = unsafe {
        match d.ViewDimension {
            D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D => (d.Anonymous.Texture2D.MipSlice, 0),
            D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY => (
                d.Anonymous.Texture2DArray.MipSlice,
                d.Anonymous.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice,
            ),
            D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMSARRAY => (0, d.Anonymous.Texture2DMSArray.FirstArraySlice),
            _ => (0, 0),
        }
    };
    Bound {
        target: format!("rt{slot}"),
        view: view.cast().expect("a render target view is a view"),
        format: d.Format,
        dimension: d.ViewDimension.0,
        mip,
        slice,
        depth: false,
    }
}

fn depth_target(view: &ID3D11DepthStencilView) -> Bound {
    let mut d = D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC::default();
    unsafe { view.GetDesc(&mut d) };
    let (mip, slice) = unsafe {
        match d.ViewDimension {
            D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D => (d.Anonymous.Texture2D.MipSlice, 0),
            D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY => (
                d.Anonymous.Texture2DArray.MipSlice,
                d.Anonymous.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice,
            ),
            D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMSARRAY => (0, d.Anonymous.Texture2DMSArray.FirstArraySlice),
            _ => (0, 0),
        }
    };
    Bound {
        target: "depth".into(),
        view: view.cast().expect("a depth stencil view is a view"),
        format: d.Format,
        dimension: d.ViewDimension.0,
        mip,
        slice,
        depth: true,
    }
}

/// The targets bound on `c`.
pub(super) unsafe fn bound(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) -> Vec<Bound> {
    let mut rtvs: [Option<ID3D11RenderTargetView>; 8] = Default::default();
    let mut dsv = None;
    unsafe { c.OMGetRenderTargets(Some(&mut rtvs), Some(&mut dsv)) };
    let mut out: Vec<Bound> = rtvs
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter_map(|(slot, v)| v.as_ref().map(|v| render_target(slot, v)))
        .collect();
    out.extend(dsv.as_ref().map(depth_target));
    out
}

/// The targets an `OMSetRenderTargets` call is about to bind.
///
/// # Safety
/// `rtvs` must hold null or live render target views, `dsv` null or a live depth stencil view.
pub(super) unsafe fn from_raw(rtvs: &[*mut c_void], dsv: *mut c_void) -> Vec<Bound> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (slot, raw) in rtvs.iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some(v) = unsafe { ID3D11RenderTargetView::from_raw_borrowed(raw) } {
            out.push(render_target(slot, v));
        }
    }
    if let Some(v) = unsafe { ID3D11DepthStencilView::from_raw_borrowed(&dsv) } {
        out.push(depth_target(v));
    }
    out
}

/// Copies `targets` into new staging textures, on `c`.
pub(super) unsafe fn copy(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, targets: &[Bound]) -> Vec<Target> {
    let Ok(device) = (unsafe { c.GetDevice() }) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    targets
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|t| unsafe {
            copy_one(
                c,
                &device,
                &t.view,
                t.target.clone(),
                t.format,
                t.dimension,
                t.mip,
                t.slice,
                t.depth,
            )
        })
        .collect()
}

fn skip(why: &str) {
    let mut s = state();
    s.targets_skipped += 1;
    if s.targets_skipped <= 8 {
        log!("capture: a target not read back: {why}");
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
unsafe fn copy_one(
    c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    device: &ID3D11Device,
    view: &ID3D11View,
    target: String,
    view_format: DXGI_FORMAT,
    dimension: i32,
    mip: u32,
    slice: u32,
    depth: bool,
) -> Option<Target> {
    let resource = unsafe { view.GetResource() }.ok()?;
    let Ok(texture) = resource.cast::<ID3D11Texture2D>() else {
        skip("not a 2D texture");
        return None;
    };
    let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC::default();
    unsafe { texture.GetDesc(&mut d) };
    let format = file_format(view_format, d.Format, depth);
    let Some(bits) = bits_per_pixel(format) else {
        skip(&format!("format {} has no readable layout", format.0));
        return None;
    };
    let (width, height) = ((d.Width >> mip).max(1), (d.Height >> mip).max(1));
    let bytes = u64::from(width) * u64::from(height) * u64::from(bits) / 8;
    {
        let mut s = state();
        if s.target_bytes + bytes > s.request.max_target_bytes {
            s.targets_skipped_bytes += bytes;
            drop(s);
            skip(super::OVER_LIMIT);
            return None;
        }
        s.target_bytes += bytes;
    }

    let mut source: ID3D11Resource = resource.clone();
    let mut source_sub = mip + slice * d.MipLevels;
    if d.SampleDesc.Count > 1 {
        if depth {
            skip("multisampled depth");
            return None;
        }
        // A multisampled target is resolved into a one-sample texture first.
        let resolved = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC {
            Width: width,
            Height: height,
            MipLevels: 1,
            ArraySize: 1,
            Format: d.Format,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC { Count: 1, Quality: 0 },
            Usage: D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut t = None;
        if unsafe { device.CreateTexture2D(&resolved, None, Some(&mut t)) }.is_err() {
            skip("could not make a texture to resolve into");
            return None;
        }
        let t = t?;
        unsafe {
            unpredicated(c, || {
                c.ResolveSubresource(&t, 0, &source, source_sub, view_format)
            })
        };
        source = t.cast().expect("a texture is a resource");
        source_sub = 0;
    }
    let staging_desc = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC {
        Width: width,
        Height: height,
        MipLevels: 1,
        ArraySize: 1,
        Format: d.Format,
        SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC { Count: 1, Quality: 0 },
        Usage: D3D11_USAGE_STAGING,
        CPUAccessFlags: D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ.0 as u32,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut staging = None;
    if let Err(e) = unsafe { device.CreateTexture2D(&staging_desc, None, Some(&mut staging)) } {
        skip(&format!("no staging texture of format {} ({e})", d.Format.0));
        return None;
    }
    let staging = staging?;
    unsafe {
        unpredicated(c, || {
            c.CopySubresourceRegion(&staging, 0, 0, 0, 0, &source, source_sub, None)
        })
    };
    let _ = dimension;
    let (view, resource) = view_ids(view);
    Some(Target {
        target,
        view,
        resource,
        width,
        height,
        format: format.0,
        sub: mip + slice * d.MipLevels,
        staging: Some(staging),
    })
}

impl Target {
    /// Which copy holds it: the same for each execution of the command list it was copied in.
    pub(super) fn copy_id(&self) -> Option<usize> {
        self.staging.as_ref().map(|s| s.as_raw() as usize)
    }

    /// Maps the copy (waiting for the GPU) and hands its rows, tightly packed, to the blob store. Returns the key and
    /// the bytes read.
    pub(super) unsafe fn read(&mut self, immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) -> Option<(String, u64)> {
        let staging = self.staging.take()?;
        let bits = bits_per_pixel(DXGI_FORMAT(self.format)).expect("checked when copied");
        let row = (self.width * bits / 8) as usize;
        let mut mapped = D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE::default();
        unsafe { immediate.Map(&staging, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, Some(&mut mapped)) }.ok()?;
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(row * self.height as usize);
        for y in 0..self.height as usize {
            let line = unsafe {
                core::slice::from_raw_parts(
                    (mapped.pData as *const u8).add(y * mapped.RowPitch as usize),
                    row,
                )
            };
            out.extend_from_slice(line);
        }
        unsafe { immediate.Unmap(&staging, 0) };
        let key = locum_capture::hash::key(&out);
        let bytes = out.len() as u64;
        let blobs = &crate::settings::settings().blobs;
        locum_capture::writer::blob(blobs, key.clone(), out, true);
        Some((key, bytes))
    }
}

/// The format a target is written in: the view's (or the resource's), with depth formats as the colour format of the
/// same bits and typeless formats as their plain typed format.
fn file_format(view: DXGI_FORMAT, resource: DXGI_FORMAT, depth: bool) -> DXGI_FORMAT {
    let f = if view == DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN {
        resource
    } else {
        view
    };
    if depth {
        return match f {
            DXGI_FORMAT_R32G8X24_TYPELESS | DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT_S8X24_UINT => {
                DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT_X8X24_TYPELESS
            }
            DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS | DXGI_FORMAT_D32_FLOAT => DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT,
            DXGI_FORMAT_R24G8_TYPELESS | DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT => DXGI_FORMAT_R24_UNORM_X8_TYPELESS,
            DXGI_FORMAT_R16_TYPELESS | DXGI_FORMAT_D16_UNORM => DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM,
            other => other,
        };
    }
    match f {
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R16_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT,
        DXGI_FORMAT_R8_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
        DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8X8_TYPELESS => DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8X8_UNORM,
        other => other,
    }
}

/// Bits per pixel of the uncompressed formats a target can have; None for the rest.
fn bits_per_pixel(f: DXGI_FORMAT) -> Option<u32> {
    Some(match f.0 {
        1..=4 => 128,
        5..=8 => 96,
        9..=22 => 64,
        23..=47 | 67 | 87..=93 => 32,
        48..=59 | 85 | 86 | 115 => 16,
        60..=65 => 8,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn depth_is_written_as_colour() {
        let f = file_format(DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT, DXGI_FORMAT_R24G8_TYPELESS, true);
        assert_eq!(f, DXGI_FORMAT_R24_UNORM_X8_TYPELESS);
        assert_eq!(bits_per_pixel(f), Some(32));
        assert_eq!(bits_per_pixel(DXGI_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT), Some(32));
        assert_eq!(bits_per_pixel(DXGI_FORMAT_BC1_UNORM), None);
    }
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/capture/write.rs`:

```rs
//! The end of a capture: the copies of the contents of every resource the frame used (made before the timeline
//! first touched each) are read, and the whole capture is handed to the writer thread as `captures/<name>/capture.db`.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap};

use locum_capture::db::{self, Capture};
use locum_capture::stacks::{self, Interner};
use locum_capture::{hash, writer};
use serde_json::json;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;

use super::contents;
use super::snapshot::CHUNK;
use super::{Tracked, state, touched};
use crate::d3d11::registry;
use crate::log::{folder, log};
use crate::settings::settings;

/// Where a used resource's contents came from.
struct Content {
    key: String,
    subs: Vec<String>,
    source: &'static str,
    note: Option<&'static str>,
}

/// An immutable resource's contents when its upload is stored: the upload's key and its subresources' keys.
pub(super) fn upload_of(id: u64) -> Option<(String, Vec<String>)> {
    let e = registry::entry(id).filter(|e| e.dims.immutable() && e.upload_stored)?;
    let subs = e
        .sub_hashes
        .iter()
        .map(|h| h.clone().unwrap_or_default())
        .collect();
    Some((e.upload?, subs))
}

/// The ids without repeats, in order.
fn sorted(ids: &[u64]) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut v = ids.to_vec();
    v.sort_unstable();
    v.dedup();
    v
}

/// Reads everything back and hands the capture to the writer. Runs on the presenting thread after the real Present.
pub(super) fn finish(immediate: &ID3D11DeviceContext4) {
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut s = state();
    let frame = s.frame;
    let request = s.request.clone();
    let name = request.label.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| format!("frame-{frame}"));
    let Some(dir) = folder().map(|d| d.join("captures").join(&name)) else {
        s.reset();
        return;
    };
    let timeline = std::mem::take(&mut s.timeline);
    let tracked: BTreeMap<u64, Tracked> = std::mem::take(&mut s.resources);
    let in_flight = std::mem::take(&mut s.in_flight);
    let mut read = std::mem::take(&mut s.contents);
    let counters = std::mem::take(&mut s.counter_copies);
    let views = std::mem::take(&mut s.views);
    let states = std::mem::take(&mut s.states);
    let staging = std::mem::take(&mut s.staging);
    let used_bytes = s.used;
    let counts = (
        s.lists_spliced,
        s.lists_before,
        s.lists_unrecorded,
        s.copy_failures,
        s.targets_skipped,
        s.targets_skipped_bytes,
    );
    let mut gaps = std::mem::take(&mut s.gaps);
    s.reset();
    drop(s);
    super::ops::reset();

    // The process's memory, as close to the frame as can be: before anything is read back.
    let memory = if request.memory {
        match crate::dump::dump(&name, &dir) {
            Ok(d) => {
                log!(
                    "memory dump started: {} (the game waited {:.0} ms for the snapshot)",
                    d.path.display(),
                    d.held.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0
                );
                json!({"path": d.path.display().to_string(), "held_ms": d.held.as_millis() as u64})
            }
            Err(e) => {
                log!("no memory dump: {e}");
                gaps.insert(("memory".into(), e.clone()), 1);
                json!({"error": e})
            }
        }
    } else {
        serde_json::Value::Null
    };

    // Constant-buffer copies (waits for the GPU to finish the frame).
    let mut chunks: Vec<Vec<u8>> = Vec::new();
    for (i, buffer) in staging.iter().enumerate() {
        let len = if i + 1 == staging.len() { used_bytes } else { CHUNK } as usize;
        let mut mapped = D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE::default();
        if unsafe { immediate.Map(buffer, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, Some(&mut mapped)) }.is_ok() {
            chunks.push(unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(mapped.pData as *const u8, len) }.to_vec());
            unsafe { immediate.Unmap(buffer, 0) };
        } else {
            chunks.push(Vec::new());
        }
    }
    drop(staging);

    // Contents of the resources the frame used, as the timeline first touched them.
    let (used, written) = touched(&timeline);
    let mut content: BTreeMap<u64, Result<Content, String>> = BTreeMap::new();
    if request.contents {
        read.extend(unsafe { contents::read_all(immediate, in_flight) });
        for &id in &used {
            let multisampled = tracked.get(&id).is_some_and(|t| t.dims.samples > 1);
            let c = match read.remove(&id) {
                Some(r) => r.map(|(key, subs)| Content {
                    key,
                    subs,
                    source: "first-use",
                    note: multisampled.then_some("multisampled: the copy is the resolve of its samples"),
                }),
                None => match upload_of(id) {
                    Some((key, subs)) => Ok(Content {
                        key,
                        subs,
                        source: "upload",
                        note: None,
                    }),
                    None if tracked.contains_key(&id) => {
                        Err("not copied before the timeline first touched it".into())
                    }
                    None => Err("not known to the capture".into()),
                },
            };
            content.insert(id, c);
        }
    }

    // Number draws, read targets, collect stacks.
    let mut capture = Capture::default();
    for (view, copy) in counters {
        match copy.and_then(|buffer| super::counters::read(immediate, &buffer)) {
            Ok(count) => capture.uav_counters.push((view, count)),
            Err(e) => {
                *gaps
                    .entry(("counters".into(), format!("view #{view}: {e}")))
                    .or_insert(0) += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    let mut interner = Interner::default();
    let mut cb_seen: HashMap<String, ()> = HashMap::new();
    let mut shader_hashes: BTreeSet<(String, &'static str)> = BTreeSet::new();
    let (mut targets_read, mut target_bytes) = (0u32, 0u64);
    // A command list executed more than once made its copies (constants, targets) into the same places each time,
    // so they hold what its last execution saw: earlier executions' are not kept (replay works their constants out
    // from the replayed buffers instead).
    let mut last_cb: HashMap<(u32, u32), usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut last_target: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut last_result: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
    for (seq, e) in timeline.iter().enumerate() {
        let Some(d) = e.draw.as_deref() else { continue };
        for cb in &d.cb_copies {
            if let Some((chunk, offset, _)) = cb.copy {
                last_cb.insert((chunk, offset), seq);
            }
        }
        for t in &d.after {
            if let Some(id) = t.copy_id() {
                last_target.insert(id, seq);
            }
        }
        for (_, r) in &d.results {
            if let Ok(rb) = r {
                last_result.insert(rb.copy_id(), seq);
            }
        }
    }
    let (mut cbs_repeated, mut targets_repeated, mut results_repeated) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64);
    let mut outputs_repeated = 0u64;
    let mut n = 0u64;
    let mut pass: Option<(u64, Vec<(u32, u64)>)> = None;
    let mut timeline = timeline;
    for (seq, e) in timeline.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let index = seq;
        let seq = seq as u64;
        let stack = interner.id(&e.stack);
        let draw_n = e.draw.as_ref().map(|_| n);
        capture.events.push(db::Event {
            seq,
            kind: e.kind,
            call: e.call,
            context: e.context,
            deferred: e.deferred,
            list: e.list,
            draw: draw_n,
            args: e.args.to_string(),
            data: e.data.clone(),
            stack,
            reads: sorted(&e.reads),
            writes: sorted(&e.writes),
        });
        let Some(d) = e.draw.as_deref_mut() else { continue };
        for cb in &d.cb_copies {
            if let Some((chunk, offset, _)) = cb.copy
                && last_cb.get(&(chunk, offset)) != Some(&index)
            {
                cbs_repeated += 1;
                continue;
            }
            let data = if cb.empty {
                Some(&[][..])
            } else {
                cb.copy.and_then(|(chunk, offset, bytes)| {
                    chunks
                        .get(chunk as usize)?
                        .get(offset as usize..(offset + bytes) as usize)
                })
            };
            if let Some(bytes) = data {
                let key = hash::key(bytes);
                if cb_seen.insert(key.clone(), ()).is_none() {
                    capture.cb_data.push((key.clone(), bytes.to_vec()));
                }
                d.bindings[cb.binding].content = Some(key);
                d.bindings[cb.binding].size = Some(bytes.len() as u64);
            }
        }
        // Passes: runs of draws with the same targets.
        let mut target_set: Vec<(u32, u64)> = d
            .bindings
            .iter()
            .filter(|b| b.kind == "rtv" || b.kind == "dsv")
            .map(|b| (if b.kind == "dsv" { 99 } else { b.slot }, b.view.unwrap_or(0)))
            .collect();
        target_set.sort();
        let graphics = e.kind == "draw";
        let pass_n = if graphics {
            match &mut pass {
                Some((p, set)) if *set == target_set => {
                    let last = capture.passes.last_mut().expect("a pass");
                    last.last_draw = n;
                    Some(*p)
                }
                _ => {
                    let p = capture.passes.len() as u64;
                    capture.passes.push(db::Pass {
                        n: p,
                        first_draw: n,
                        last_draw: n,
                    });
                    pass = Some((p, target_set));
                    Some(p)
                }
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
        for (i, sh) in d.shaders.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(h) = sh.as_ref().filter(|h| h.as_str() != "unknown") {
                shader_hashes.insert((h.clone(), db::stage_names()[i]));
            }
        }
        // Without an order-dependent event's output replay cannot go on in the game's order (a gap that leaves the
        // capture incomplete); without another's, that output is only not compared.
        let ordered = d.order_dependent;
        for (resource, r) in std::mem::take(&mut d.results) {
            let read = match r {
                Ok(rb) if last_result.get(&rb.copy_id()) != Some(&index) => {
                    if ordered {
                        results_repeated += 1;
                    } else {
                        outputs_repeated += 1;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                Ok(rb) => unsafe { contents::read(immediate, &rb) },
                Err(e) => Err(e),
            };
            match read {
                Ok((key, _)) => capture.results.push((seq, resource, key, ordered)),
                Err(e) => {
                    let gap = if ordered {
                        (
                            "results".into(),
                            format!("an order-dependent shader's output not read: {e}"),
                        )
                    } else {
                        (
                            "outputs".into(),
                            format!("what a draw or dispatch wrote through UAVs, not read: {e}"),
                        )
                    };
                    *gaps.entry(gap).or_insert(0) += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        let after = seq + u64::from(d.after_events);
        for t in &mut d.after {
            if t.copy_id().is_some_and(|id| last_target.get(&id) != Some(&index)) {
                targets_repeated += 1;
                continue;
            }
            if let Some((key, bytes)) = unsafe { t.read(immediate) } {
                targets_read += 1;
                target_bytes += bytes;
                capture.targets.push(db::Target {
                    draw: n,
                    target: t.target.clone(),
                    view: t.view,
                    resource: t.resource,
                    width: t.width,
                    height: t.height,
                    format: t.format as u32,
                    sub: t.sub,
                    blob: Some(key),
                    event: after,
                });
            }
        }
        for mut b in d.bindings.drain(..) {
            b.draw = n;
            capture.bindings.push(b);
        }
        for mut v in d.viewports.drain(..) {
            v.draw = n;
            capture.viewports.push(v);
        }
        for mut v in d.scissors.drain(..) {
            v.draw = n;
            capture.scissors.push(v);
        }
        capture.draws.push(db::Draw {
            n,
            event: seq,
            call: e.call,
            args: e.args.to_string(),
            pass: pass_n,
            shaders: d.shaders.clone(),
            topology: d.topology,
            layout: d.layout,
            rasterizer: d.rasterizer,
            blend: d.blend,
            depth_stencil: d.depth_stencil,
            blend_factor: d.blend_factor,
            sample_mask: d.sample_mask,
            stencil_ref: d.stencil_ref,
            predicate: d.predicate,
            predicate_value: d.predicate_value,
        });
        n += 1;
    }
    let draws = n;
    drop(timeline);

    // Every live resource, and any used one the registry does not know.
    let mut ids: BTreeSet<u64> = registry::live().into_iter().collect();
    ids.extend(used.iter().copied());
    let (mut with_content, mut content_bytes, mut missing) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64);
    for id in ids {
        let entry = registry::entry(id);
        let dims = entry
            .as_ref()
            .map(|e| e.dims.clone())
            .or_else(|| tracked.get(&id).map(|t| t.dims.clone()))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let subs = dims.subs().unwrap_or_default();
        let bytes = locum_capture::layout::total(&subs);
        let mut row = db::Resource {
            id,
            kind: if dims.kind.is_empty() {
                "unknown"
            } else {
                dims.kind
            },
            width: dims.width,
            height: dims.height,
            depth: dims.depth,
            mips: dims.mips,
            array: dims.array,
            format: dims.format,
            samples: dims.samples,
            bytes,
            stride: dims.stride,
            usage: dims.usage,
            bind: dims.bind,
            cpu: dims.cpu,
            misc: dims.misc,
            desc: dims.desc.clone(),
            used: used.contains(&id),
            written: written.contains(&id),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut sub_hashes: Vec<Option<String>> = vec![None; subs.len()];
        if let Some(e) = &entry {
            row.created_frame = e.created_frame;
            row.created_stack = interner.id(&e.created_stack);
            row.upload = e.upload.clone();
            row.upload_stored = e.upload_stored;
            row.updated_frame = e.updated_frame;
            row.updated_stack = interner.id(&e.updated_stack);
            row.update_count = e.update_count;
            for (i, h) in e.sub_hashes.iter().enumerate() {
                if let Some(slot) = sub_hashes.get_mut(i) {
                    slot.clone_from(h);
                }
            }
        }
        match content.remove(&id) {
            Some(Ok(c)) => {
                with_content += 1;
                content_bytes += bytes;
                row.content = Some(c.key);
                row.content_source = Some(c.source);
                row.content_note = c.note.map(String::from);
                for (i, h) in c.subs.into_iter().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(slot) = sub_hashes.get_mut(i)
                        && !h.is_empty()
                    {
                        *slot = Some(h);
                    }
                }
            }
            Some(Err(why)) => {
                missing += 1;
                row.content_note = Some(why.clone());
                *gaps.entry(("contents".into(), why)).or_insert(0) += 1;
            }
            None if row.used && request.contents => {
                missing += 1;
                row.content_note = Some("not read".into());
            }
            None => {}
        }
        for (sub, hash) in subs.iter().zip(sub_hashes) {
            if row.used || hash.is_some() {
                capture.subresources.push(db::Subresource {
                    resource: id,
                    sub: *sub,
                    hash,
                });
            }
        }
        capture.resources.push(row);
    }
    drop(tracked);
    capture.views = views;
    capture.states = states;

    // Shader bytecode, from the files written as shaders were created.
    let shader_dir = folder().map(|d| d.join("shaders"));
    for (h, stage) in shader_hashes {
        let mut row = db::Shader {
            hash: h.clone(),
            stage,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        if let Some(dir) = &shader_dir
            && let Ok(code) = std::fs::read(dir.join(format!("{h}.{stage}.dxbc")))
        {
            let key = hash::key(&code);
            row.size = code.len() as u64;
            let blobs = &settings().blobs;
            writer::blob(blobs, key.clone(), code, true);
            row.blob = Some(key);
        } else {
            *gaps
                .entry(("shaders".into(), "bytecode not found".into()))
                .or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
        capture.shaders.push(row);
    }

    let (spliced, before, unrecorded, copy_failures, targets_skipped, skipped_bytes) = counts;
    capture.modules = stacks::modules();
    capture.stacks = interner.into_rows();
    capture.meta("api", "d3d11");
    capture.meta("name", &name);
    capture.meta("frame", frame);
    capture.meta(
        "exe",
        std::env::current_exe()
            .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
    );
    capture.meta("pid", std::process::id());
    if !memory.is_null() {
        capture.meta("memory", memory.to_string());
    }
    capture.meta("locum", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    capture.meta("blobs", settings().blobs.root().display());
    capture.meta(
        "time",
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_secs())
            .unwrap_or(0),
    );
    capture.meta(
        "request",
        json!({"targets": request.targets, "contents": request.contents, "memory": request.memory,
            "max_target_mb": request.max_target_bytes >> 20})
        .to_string(),
    );
    capture.meta(
        "counts",
        json!({"events": capture.events.len(), "draws": draws, "lists_spliced": spliced,
            "lists_recorded_before": before, "lists_unrecorded": unrecorded, "cb_copy_failures": copy_failures,
            "targets": targets_read, "target_bytes": target_bytes, "targets_skipped": targets_skipped,
            "targets_skipped_bytes": skipped_bytes, "resources_live": capture.resources.len(),
            "resources_used": used.len(), "resources_written": written.len(), "contents": with_content,
            "content_bytes": content_bytes, "contents_missing": missing})
        .to_string(),
    );
    if unrecorded > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            ("lists".into(), "executed without a recording".into()),
            u64::from(unrecorded),
        );
    }
    if cbs_repeated > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            (
                "evidence".into(),
                "constants of a command list executed more than once: only its last execution's were kept (replay \
                 reads the others from the replayed buffers)"
                    .into(),
            ),
            cbs_repeated,
        );
    }
    if results_repeated > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            (
                "results".into(),
                "an order-dependent shader in a command list executed more than once: only its last execution's \
                 output was kept"
                    .into(),
            ),
            results_repeated,
        );
    }
    if outputs_repeated > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            (
                "outputs".into(),
                "what a draw or dispatch in a command list executed more than once wrote through UAVs: only its last \
                 execution's output was kept"
                    .into(),
            ),
            outputs_repeated,
        );
    }
    if targets_repeated > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            (
                "evidence".into(),
                "targets of a command list executed more than once: only its last execution's were read back"
                    .into(),
            ),
            targets_repeated,
        );
    }
    if copy_failures > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            ("constants".into(), "constant-buffer copies failed".into()),
            u64::from(copy_failures),
        );
    }
    if targets_skipped > 0 {
        gaps.insert(
            (
                "targets".into(),
                "over the target memory limit or unreadable".into(),
            ),
            u64::from(targets_skipped),
        );
    }
    for ((what, detail), count) in gaps {
        capture.gap(&what, detail, count);
    }
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
    let path = dir.join("capture.db");
    let summary = format!(
        "capture of frame {frame} ({name}): {draws} draws, {} events, {spliced} command lists spliced, {unrecorded} \
         executed without a recording, {copy_failures} constant copy failures, {targets_read} targets ({} MiB), {} of \
         {} used resources with contents ({} MiB), {missing} missing; read back in {:.1} s",
        capture.events.len(),
        target_bytes >> 20,
        with_content,
        used.len(),
        content_bytes >> 20,
        started.elapsed().as_secs_f64()
    );
    log!("{summary}");
    log!("  the frame, {}", crate::cost::line());
    writer::run(move || {
        let t = std::time::Instant::now();
        match db::write(&path, &capture) {
            Ok(()) => log!(
                "capture written: {} ({:.1} s after the readback)",
                path.display(),
                t.elapsed().as_secs_f64()
            ),
            Err(e) => log!("capture NOT written to {}: {e}", path.display()),
        }
    });
}

```

`locum/src/d3d11/device.rs`:

```rs
//! The device and its contexts.
//!
//! The immediate context lives inside the device and shares its reference count, as in DXVK: a game that holds only
//! the immediate context keeps the device alive. A deferred context has its own count and holds one reference to the
//! device.
//!
//! The device is also its own DXGI device (`IDXGIDevice` to `IDXGIDevice4`), as in DXVK: the usual way to a swap chain
//! is device -> IDXGIDevice -> GetAdapter -> GetParent (the factory) -> CreateSwapChain, and every object on that path
//! has to be locum's for the swap chain to be. The DXGI device lives inside the device like the immediate context.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};

use std::sync::OnceLock;

use windows::Win32::Foundation::{E_NOINTERFACE, E_POINTER, RECT, S_OK};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_FORMAT;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::{
    IDXGIDevice, IDXGIDevice1, IDXGIDevice2, IDXGIDevice3, IDXGIDevice4, IDXGIDevice4_Vtbl, IDXGIObject,
};
use windows::core::{BOOL, GUID, HRESULT, IUnknown, Interface};

use crate::com::answer_query;
use crate::d3d11::capture::{self, ops};
use crate::d3d11::overrides;
use crate::d3d11::registry;
use crate::d3d11::shaders::{self, Stage};
use crate::dxgi::Adapter;
use crate::log::log;
use crate::vtables::adapter::AdapterMethods;
use crate::vtables::context::{ContextMethods, real as real_context};
use crate::vtables::device::{DeviceMethods, real};
use crate::vtables::dxgi_device::DxgiDeviceMethods;

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Device {
    vtbl: *const ID3D11Device5_Vtbl,
    refs: AtomicU32,
    inner: ID3D11Device5,
    immediate: Context,
    dxgi: DxgiDevice,
    /// Our wrapper of the device's adapter, with one reference (0 until asked for, 1 if it could not be wrapped).
    adapter: OnceLock<usize>,
}

/// The device's `IDXGIDevice4` face. Counts on the device.
#[repr(C)]
pub struct DxgiDevice {
    vtbl: *const IDXGIDevice4_Vtbl,
    inner: IDXGIDevice4,
    device: *const Device,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Context {
    vtbl: *const ID3D11DeviceContext4_Vtbl,
    /// Deferred contexts only; the immediate context counts on its device.
    refs: AtomicU32,
    inner: ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    device: *const Device,
    deferred: bool,
    /// locum's number for the context, in captures.
    id: u32,
}

static DEVICE_VTBL: ID3D11Device5_Vtbl = crate::vtables::device::vtable::<Device>();
static CONTEXT_VTBL: ID3D11DeviceContext4_Vtbl = crate::vtables::context::vtable::<Context>();
static DXGI_DEVICE_VTBL: IDXGIDevice4_Vtbl = crate::vtables::dxgi_device::vtable::<DxgiDevice>();

const DXGI_DEVICE_IIDS: [GUID; 6] = [
    IDXGIObject::IID,
    IDXGIDevice::IID,
    IDXGIDevice1::IID,
    IDXGIDevice2::IID,
    IDXGIDevice3::IID,
    IDXGIDevice4::IID,
];

const DEVICE_IIDS: [GUID; 7] = [
    IUnknown::IID,
    ID3D11Device::IID,
    ID3D11Device1::IID,
    ID3D11Device2::IID,
    ID3D11Device3::IID,
    ID3D11Device4::IID,
    ID3D11Device5::IID,
];

const CONTEXT_IIDS: [GUID; 7] = [
    IUnknown::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceChild::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceContext::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceContext1::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceContext2::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceContext3::IID,
    ID3D11DeviceContext4::IID,
];

impl Context {
    /// Runs the real draw or dispatch, with the overrides that hold for it if any are loaded.
    fn run(&self, compute: bool, real: impl FnOnce()) {
        if overrides::active() {
            unsafe { overrides::around(&self.inner, compute, real) }
        } else {
            real()
        }
        if capture::armed() {
            capture::after_draw(self.ctx());
        }
    }

    /// Records a draw or dispatch if a capture is running.
    fn draw(&self, call: &'static str, args: &[i64]) {
        if capture::armed() {
            capture::on_draw(self.ctx(), call, args);
        }
    }

    /// Targets about to be bound on this context, if a capture is running (see [`capture::targets_changing`]).
    unsafe fn targets_changing(&self, count: u32, rtvs: *const *mut c_void, dsv: *mut c_void) {
        if capture::armed() {
            let rtvs = if rtvs.is_null() || count == 0 {
                &[][..]
            } else {
                unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(rtvs, count.min(8) as usize) }
            };
            unsafe { capture::targets_changing(self.ctx(), rtvs, dsv) };
        }
    }

    /// An update: recorded while a capture runs, else only noted on the resource's registry entry.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    unsafe fn update(
        &self,
        call: &'static str,
        dst: *mut c_void,
        sub: u32,
        region: *const D3D11_BOX,
        data: *const c_void,
        row: u32,
        depth: u32,
        flags: u32,
    ) {
        if dst.is_null() || data.is_null() {
            return;
        }
        // Emulated command lists add the destination offset to UpdateSubresource's source pointer.
        // Record those bytes, including when the application already compensated for that runtime behavior.
        // UpdateSubresource1 and native command lists use the supplied pointer without this offset.
        let mut data = data;
        if self.deferred && call == "UpdateSubresource" && !region.is_null() {
            let mut threading = D3D11_FEATURE_DATA_THREADING::default();
            let emulated = unsafe { self.inner.GetDevice() }.is_ok_and(|device| {
                unsafe {
                    device.CheckFeatureSupport(
                        D3D11_FEATURE_THREADING,
                        (&mut threading as *mut D3D11_FEATURE_DATA_THREADING).cast(),
                        size_of_val(&threading) as u32,
                    )
                }
                .is_ok()
                    && !threading.DriverCommandLists.as_bool()
            });
            if emulated
                && let Some(resource) = unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&dst) }
                && let Some(dims) = registry::dims_of(resource)
                && let Some(offset) = registry::source_offset(&dims, unsafe { &*region }, row, depth)
            {
                data = data.wrapping_byte_add(offset);
            }
        }
        if capture::armed() {
            unsafe { ops::update(self.ctx(), call, dst, sub, region, data, row, depth, flags) };
        } else if let Some(r) = unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&dst) } {
            let region = if region.is_null() {
                None
            } else {
                Some(unsafe { &*region })
            };
            unsafe { registry::updated(r, sub, region, data, row, depth, false) };
        }
    }

    /// This context as the capture's ops name it.
    fn ctx(&self) -> ops::Ctx<'_> {
        ops::Ctx {
            c: &self.inner,
            id: self.id,
            deferred: self.deferred,
        }
    }

    /// The real context.
    pub fn real(&self) -> &ID3D11DeviceContext4 {
        &self.inner
    }

    /// Records an indirect draw or dispatch if a capture is running: its arguments are the buffer's id and offset.
    unsafe fn draw_indirect(&self, call: &'static str, buffer: *mut c_void, offset: u32) {
        if capture::armed() {
            unsafe { capture::on_indirect(self.ctx(), call, buffer, offset) };
        }
    }
}

impl Device {
    /// Wraps a device the real runtime created. Takes over the caller's reference to `device` and returns the
    /// wrapper with one reference, or gives `device` back if it is not an `ID3D11Device5`.
    pub fn wrap(device: ID3D11Device) -> Result<*mut Device, ID3D11Device> {
        let Ok(inner) = device.cast::<ID3D11Device5>() else {
            log!("device is not an ID3D11Device5: left unwrapped");
            return Err(device);
        };
        let immediate =
            match unsafe { inner.GetImmediateContext3() }.and_then(|c| c.cast::<ID3D11DeviceContext4>()) {
                Ok(c) => c,
                Err(e) => {
                    log!("immediate context is not an ID3D11DeviceContext4 ({e}): device left unwrapped");
                    return Err(device);
                }
            };
        let dxgi = match inner.cast::<IDXGIDevice4>() {
            Ok(d) => d,
            Err(e) => {
                log!("device is not an IDXGIDevice4 ({e}): left unwrapped");
                return Err(device);
            }
        };
        let wrapper = Box::into_raw(Box::new(Device {
            vtbl: &DEVICE_VTBL,
            refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
            inner,
            dxgi: DxgiDevice {
                vtbl: &DXGI_DEVICE_VTBL,
                inner: dxgi,
                device: core::ptr::null(),
            },
            adapter: OnceLock::new(),
            immediate: Context {
                vtbl: &CONTEXT_VTBL,
                refs: AtomicU32::new(0),
                inner: immediate,
                device: core::ptr::null(),
                deferred: false,
                id: capture::next_context_id(),
            },
        }));
        unsafe {
            (*wrapper).immediate.device = wrapper;
            (*wrapper).dxgi.device = wrapper;
        }
        log!("wrapped device {:p} as {wrapper:p}", device.as_raw());
        Ok(wrapper)
    }

    /// If `object` is one of our devices (either face), the real device under it; otherwise `object` unchanged.
    pub fn unwrap_raw(object: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void {
        match Self::from_raw(object) {
            Some(device) => device.inner.as_raw(),
            None => object,
        }
    }

    /// `object` as one of our devices, if it is one: its `ID3D11Device` face or its `IDXGIDevice` face.
    pub fn from_raw<'a>(object: *mut c_void) -> Option<&'a Device> {
        if object.is_null() {
            return None;
        }
        let vtbl = unsafe { *(object as *const *const c_void) };
        if core::ptr::eq(vtbl, (&DEVICE_VTBL as *const ID3D11Device5_Vtbl).cast()) {
            return Some(unsafe { &*(object as *const Device) });
        }
        if core::ptr::eq(vtbl, (&DXGI_DEVICE_VTBL as *const IDXGIDevice4_Vtbl).cast()) {
            return Some(unsafe { &*(*(object as *const DxgiDevice)).device });
        }
        None
    }

    /// Our wrapper of the device's adapter, made the first time it is asked for.
    fn adapter(&self) -> Option<&Adapter> {
        let p = *self.adapter.get_or_init(|| {
            let real = match unsafe { self.dxgi.inner.GetAdapter() } {
                Ok(a) => a,
                Err(e) => {
                    log!("IDXGIDevice::GetAdapter on the real device failed: {e}");
                    return 1;
                }
            };
            match Adapter::wrap(real.into(), None) {
                Ok(w) => w as usize,
                Err(_) => 1,
            }
        });
        (p > 1).then(|| unsafe { &*(p as *const Adapter) })
    }

    pub fn immediate(&self) -> &Context {
        &self.immediate
    }

    pub fn immediate_raw(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        &self.immediate as *const Context as *mut c_void
    }

    /// Hands out the immediate context with a reference.
    unsafe fn give_immediate(&self, out: *mut *mut c_void) {
        if out.is_null() {
            return;
        }
        unsafe {
            self.AddRef();
            *out = self.immediate_raw();
        }
    }

    /// Replaces the real deferred context the runtime wrote to `out` with a wrapper.
    unsafe fn wrap_deferred(&self, hr: HRESULT, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
            return hr;
        }
        let real = unsafe { ID3D11DeviceContext::from_raw(*out) };
        match real.cast::<ID3D11DeviceContext4>() {
            Ok(inner) => {
                unsafe { self.AddRef() };
                let wrapper = Box::into_raw(Box::new(Context {
                    vtbl: &CONTEXT_VTBL,
                    refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
                    inner,
                    device: self,
                    deferred: true,
                    id: capture::next_context_id(),
                }));
                unsafe { *out = wrapper.cast() };
            }
            Err(e) => {
                log!("deferred context is not an ID3D11DeviceContext4 ({e}): left unwrapped");
                unsafe { *out = real.into_raw() };
            }
        }
        hr
    }
}

unsafe impl DeviceMethods for Device {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if !iid.is_null() && !out.is_null() && DXGI_DEVICE_IIDS.contains(unsafe { &*iid }) {
            unsafe {
                self.AddRef();
                *out = &self.dxgi as *const DxgiDevice as *mut c_void;
            }
            return S_OK;
        }
        unsafe {
            answer_query(
                "device",
                self as *const _ as _,
                self.inner(),
                &DEVICE_IIDS,
                iid,
                out,
                || {
                    self.AddRef();
                },
            )
        }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        self.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        let left = self.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
        if left == 0 {
            log!("device {:p} released", self as *const Device);
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self as *const Device as *mut Device) });
        }
        left
    }

    unsafe fn GetImmediateContext(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { self.give_immediate(a0) }
    }

    unsafe fn GetImmediateContext1(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { self.give_immediate(a0) }
    }

    unsafe fn GetImmediateContext2(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { self.give_immediate(a0) }
    }

    unsafe fn GetImmediateContext3(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { self.give_immediate(a0) }
    }

    unsafe fn CreateVertexShader(

impl Drop for Device {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(&p) = self.adapter.get()
            && p > 1
        {
            unsafe { AdapterMethods::Release(&*(p as *const Adapter)) };
        }
    }
}

unsafe impl DxgiDeviceMethods for DxgiDevice {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe { (*self.device).QueryInterface(iid, out) }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        unsafe { (*self.device).AddRef() }
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        unsafe { (*self.device).Release() }
    }

    unsafe fn GetAdapter(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if a0.is_null() {
            return E_POINTER;
        }
        match unsafe { (*self.device).adapter() } {
            Some(adapter) => unsafe {
                adapter.AddRef();
                *a0 = adapter as *const Adapter as *mut c_void;
                S_OK
            },
            None => E_NOINTERFACE,
        }
    }

    /// The parent of a DXGI device is its adapter.
    unsafe fn GetParent(&self, a0: *const GUID, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        match unsafe { (*self.device).adapter() } {
            Some(adapter) => unsafe { adapter.QueryInterface(a0, a1) },
            None => E_NOINTERFACE,
        }
    }
}

unsafe impl ContextMethods for Context {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        let kind = if self.deferred {
            "deferred context"
        } else {
            "immediate context"
        };
        unsafe {
            answer_query(
                kind,
                self as *const _ as _,
                self.inner(),
                &CONTEXT_IIDS,
                iid,
                out,
                || {
                    self.AddRef();
                },
            )
        }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        if self.deferred {
            self.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
        } else {
            unsafe { (*self.device).AddRef() }
        }
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        if !self.deferred {
            return unsafe { (*self.device).Release() };
        }
        let left = self.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
        if left == 0 {
            let device = self.device;
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self as *const Context as *mut Context) });
            unsafe { (*device).Release() };
        }
        left
    }

    unsafe fn Draw(&self, a0: u32, a1: u32) {
        self.draw("Draw", &[a0.into(), a1.into()]);
        self.run(false, || unsafe { real_context::Draw(self.inner(), a0, a1) })
    }

    unsafe fn DrawIndexed(&self, a0: u32, a1: u32, a2: i32) {
        self.draw("DrawIndexed", &[a0.into(), a1.into(), a2.into()]);
        self.run(false, || unsafe {
            real_context::DrawIndexed(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2)
        })
    }

    unsafe fn DrawInstanced(&self, a0: u32, a1: u32, a2: u32, a3: u32) {
        self.draw("DrawInstanced", &[a0.into(), a1.into(), a2.into(), a3.into()]);
        self.run(false, || unsafe {
            real_context::DrawInstanced(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2, a3)
        })
    }

    unsafe fn DrawIndexedInstanced(&self, a0: u32, a1: u32, a2: u32, a3: i32, a4: u32) {
        self.draw(
            "DrawIndexedInstanced",
            &[a0.into(), a1.into(), a2.into(), a3.into(), a4.into()],
        );
        self.run(false, || unsafe {

        })
    }

    unsafe fn DrawAuto(&self) {
        self.draw("DrawAuto", &[]);
        self.run(false, || unsafe { real_context::DrawAuto(self.inner()) })
    }

    unsafe fn DrawInstancedIndirect(&self, a0: *mut c_void, a1: u32) {

    unsafe fn FinishCommandList(&self, a0: BOOL, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {

        if capture::armed() && hr.is_ok() && !a1.is_null() {
            capture::on_finish_list(self.id, unsafe { *a1 });

        hr
    }

    unsafe fn ExecuteCommandList(&self, a0: *mut c_void, a1: BOOL) {
        if capture::armed() {
            capture::on_execute_list(self.ctx(), a0);
        }
        unsafe { real_context::ExecuteCommandList(self.inner(), a0, a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn GetDevice(&self, a0: *mut *mut c_void) {
        if a0.is_null() {
            return;
        }
        unsafe {
            (*self.device).AddRef();
            *a0 = self.device as *mut c_void;
        }
    }
```

```rs
//! The Direct3D 11 front end: the device and its contexts, shader identity, per-stage bindings, capture and
//! overrides. Everything API-neutral (the capture format, blob store, formats, rules) is in `locum-capture`.

pub mod capture;
pub mod device;
pub mod overrides;

pub mod shaders;
pub mod stages;
```

`locum/src/d3d11/overrides.rs`:

```rs
//! Changing what the game draws, by rules in `overrides.txt` in locum's folder (the language is in
//! [`locum_capture::rules`], shared with replay). The file is read again when it changes (checked every 30 frames);
//! removing it removes the rules.
//!
//! Rules apply at the draw, on the draw's own context, and are undone after it: a replaced shader or constant buffer
//! is bound for that draw only. A constant is changed in a copy of the bound buffer made by the GPU at the draw, so
//! draws on deferred contexts get theirs when their command list runs.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, RwLock};
use std::time::SystemTime;

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::ID3DBlob;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::core::{HRESULT, Interface, PCSTR};

use locum_capture::rules::{self, Action};

use crate::d3d11::shaders::{self, Stage};
use crate::d3d11::stages::{self, CbBinding};
use crate::log::{folder, log};
use crate::system::{export, load_system_dll};

static ACTIVE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// Whether any rule is loaded: the only check on the draw path otherwise.
pub fn active() -> bool {
    ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// The shader stages by the rules' numbering.
const STAGES: [Stage; 6] = [
    Stage::Vertex,
    Stage::Hull,
    Stage::Domain,
    Stage::Geometry,
    Stage::Pixel,
    Stage::Compute,
];

/// A rule, and what applying it in the game needs.
struct Rule {
    rule: rules::Rule,
    stage: Stage,
    applied: AtomicU64,
    /// The replacement shader, made on first use (None if that failed).
    made: Mutex<Option<Option<ID3D11DeviceChild>>>,
    /// For `constant`: the 16 bytes to copy in, and scratch buffers by size.
    values: Mutex<Option<Option<ID3D11Buffer>>>,
    scratch: Mutex<HashMap<u32, ID3D11Buffer>>,
}

struct Rules {
    rules: Vec<Rule>,
    loaded: Option<SystemTime>,
}

static RULES: RwLock<Option<Arc<Rules>>> = RwLock::new(None);

fn current() -> Option<Arc<Rules>> {
    RULES.read().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone()
}

/// At each present: reads `overrides.txt` again if it changed (every 30 frames), and reports how often each rule
/// applied (every 600).
pub fn poll(frame: u64) {
    if frame.is_multiple_of(600)
        && let Some(rules) = current()
    {
        for r in &rules.rules {
            log!(
                "override {:?}: applied {} times",
                r.rule.text,
                r.applied.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
            );
        }
    }
    if !frame.is_multiple_of(30) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(dir) = folder() else { return };
    let path = dir.join("overrides.txt");
    let modified = std::fs::metadata(&path).and_then(|m| m.modified()).ok();
    let loaded = current().and_then(|r| r.loaded);
    if modified == loaded {
        return;
    }
    let rules = match (modified, std::fs::read_to_string(&path)) {
        (Some(_), Ok(text)) => load(&text, &dir),
        _ => Vec::new(),
    };
    log!("overrides: {} rules from {}", rules.len(), path.display());
    ACTIVE.store(!rules.is_empty(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    *RULES.write().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(Arc::new(Rules {
        rules,
        loaded: modified,
    }));
}

fn load(text: &str, dir: &std::path::Path) -> Vec<Rule> {
    let (parsed, errors) = rules::parse_all(text, dir, &rules::hex);
    for (line, e) in errors {
        log!("overrides.txt line {line}: {e}: ignored");
    }
    parsed
        .into_iter()
        .map(|rule| Rule {
            stage: STAGES[rule.stage],
            rule,
            applied: AtomicU64::new(0),
            made: Mutex::new(None),
            values: Mutex::new(None),
            scratch: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
        })
        .collect()
}

/// The shaders bound at a draw, hashed once each when a rule asks.
struct Bound<'a> {
    c: &'a ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    hashes: [Option<Option<u64>>; 6],
}

impl Bound<'_> {
    fn hash(&mut self, stage: Stage) -> Option<u64> {
        *self.hashes[stage as usize].get_or_insert_with(|| {
            let shader = unsafe { stages::shader(self.c, stage) }?;
            unsafe { shaders::hash_of(shader.as_raw()) }
        })
    }

    fn holds(&mut self, rule: &Rule) -> bool {
        rule.rule.holds(|stage| self.hash(STAGES[stage]))
    }
}

enum Undo {
    Shader(Stage, Option<ID3D11DeviceChild>),
    Cb(Stage, u32, CbBinding),
}

/// Runs `draw` (the real draw or dispatch on `c`) with the rules that hold for it applied, then undoes them.
pub unsafe fn around(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, compute: bool, draw: impl FnOnce()) {
    let Some(rules) = current() else { return draw() };
    let mut bound = Bound { c, hashes: [None; 6] };
    let applies = |r: &Rule| r.rule.applies(compute);
    if rules.rules.iter().any(|r| {
        matches!(r.rule.action, Action::Skip) && applies(r) && bound.holds(r) && {
            r.applied.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            true
        }
    }) {
        return;
    }
    let mut undo = Vec::new();
    let mut replaced = [false; 6];
    for r in &rules.rules {
        if matches!(r.rule.action, Action::Skip) || !applies(r) || !bound.holds(r) {
            continue;
        }
        match &r.rule.action {
            Action::Solid(_) | Action::Shader(_) if !replaced[r.stage as usize] => {
                let Some(shader) = (unsafe { replacement(c, r) }) else {
                    continue;
                };
                replaced[r.stage as usize] = true;
                undo.push(Undo::Shader(r.stage, unsafe { stages::shader(c, r.stage) }));
                unsafe { stages::set_shader(c, r.stage, Some(&shader)) };
            }
            Action::Constant { slot, index, bits } => {
                let Some(original) = (unsafe { patched(c, r, *slot, *index, bits) }) else {
                    continue;
                };
                undo.push(Undo::Cb(r.stage, *slot, original));
            }
            _ => continue,
        }
        r.applied.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    draw();
    for u in undo.into_iter().rev() {
        match u {
            Undo::Shader(stage, shader) => unsafe { stages::set_shader(c, stage, shader.as_ref()) },
            Undo::Cb(stage, slot, binding) => unsafe {
                stages::set_constant_buffer(c, stage, slot, &binding)
            },
        }
    }
}

/// The rule's replacement shader, made on the real device the first time.
unsafe fn replacement(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, r: &Rule) -> Option<ID3D11DeviceChild> {
    let mut made = r.made.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    made.get_or_insert_with(|| {
        let device = unsafe { c.GetDevice() }.ok()?;
        let code = match &r.rule.action {
            Action::Solid(colour) => solid_ps(colour)?,
            Action::Shader(code) => code.clone(),
            _ => return None,
        };
        match unsafe { stages::create_shader(&device, r.stage, &code) } {
            Ok(s) => Some(s),
            Err(e) => {
                log!("override {:?}: the shader could not be made: {e}", r.rule.text);
                None
            }
        }
    })
    .clone()
}

/// Binds a copy of the constant buffer at `slot` with one constant changed; returns the binding to restore.
unsafe fn patched(
    c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4,
    r: &Rule,
    slot: u32,
    index: u32,
    bits: &[u32; 4],
) -> Option<CbBinding> {
    let original = unsafe { stages::constant_buffers(c, r.stage) }
        .into_iter()
        .nth(slot as usize)?;
    let source = original.buffer.clone()?;
    let mut desc = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC::default();
    unsafe { source.GetDesc(&mut desc) };
    let at = (original.first + index) * 16;
    if at + 16 > desc.ByteWidth {
        return None;
    }
    let device = unsafe { c.GetDevice() }.ok()?;
    let values = r
        .values
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .get_or_insert_with(|| unsafe { buffer(&device, 16, Some(bits)) })
        .clone()?;
    let scratch = {
        let mut scratch = r.scratch.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        match scratch.get(&desc.ByteWidth) {
            Some(b) => b.clone(),
            None => {
                let b = unsafe { buffer(&device, desc.ByteWidth, None) }?;
                scratch.insert(desc.ByteWidth, b.clone());
                b
            }
        }
    };
    let whole = D3D11_BOX {
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
        front: 0,
        right: desc.ByteWidth,
        bottom: 1,
        back: 1,
    };
    let one = D3D11_BOX {
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
        front: 0,
        right: 16,
        bottom: 1,
        back: 1,
    };
    unsafe {
        c.CopySubresourceRegion(&scratch, 0, 0, 0, 0, &source, 0, Some(&whole));
        c.CopySubresourceRegion(&scratch, 0, at, 0, 0, &values, 0, Some(&one));
        let binding = CbBinding {
            buffer: Some(scratch),
            first: original.first,
            count: original.count,
        };
        stages::set_constant_buffer(c, r.stage, slot, &binding);
    }
    Some(original)
}

/// A default-usage constant buffer of `bytes`, holding `bits` if given.
unsafe fn buffer(device: &ID3D11Device, bytes: u32, bits: Option<&[u32; 4]>) -> Option<ID3D11Buffer> {
    let desc = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC {
        ByteWidth: bytes,
        Usage: D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT,
        BindFlags: D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER.0 as u32,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let init = bits.map(|b| D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA {
        pSysMem: b.as_ptr().cast(),
        ..Default::default()
    });
    let mut out = None;
    unsafe { device.CreateBuffer(&desc, init.as_ref().map(|i| i as *const _), Some(&mut out)) }.ok()?;
    out
}

type CompileFn = unsafe extern "system" fn(
    *const c_void,
    usize,
    PCSTR,
    *const c_void,
    *mut c_void,
    PCSTR,
    PCSTR,
    u32,
    u32,
    *mut *mut c_void,
    *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT;

/// A ps_5_0 shader writing `colour` to all eight targets, compiled with the system's d3dcompiler_47.dll.
fn solid_ps(colour: &[f32; 4]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let source = rules::solid_source(colour);
    let module = load_system_dll("d3dcompiler_47.dll")?;
    let compile = unsafe { export::<CompileFn>(module, c"D3DCompile") }?;
    let (mut code, mut errors) = (core::ptr::null_mut(), core::ptr::null_mut());
    let hr = unsafe {
        compile(
            source.as_ptr().cast(),
            source.len(),
            PCSTR(c"locum-solid".as_ptr().cast()),
            core::ptr::null(),
            core::ptr::null_mut(),
            PCSTR(c"main".as_ptr().cast()),
            PCSTR(c"ps_5_0".as_ptr().cast()),
            0,
            0,
            &mut code,
            &mut errors,
        )
    };
    let blob = |p: *mut c_void| (!p.is_null()).then(|| unsafe { ID3DBlob::from_raw(p) });
    let bytes = |b: &ID3DBlob| unsafe {
        core::slice::from_raw_parts(b.GetBufferPointer() as *const u8, b.GetBufferSize()).to_vec()
    };
    if let Some(e) = blob(errors) {
        log!("solid shader: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes(&e)));
    }
    let code = blob(code);
    if hr.is_err() {
        log!("solid shader did not compile: {hr:?}");
        return None;
    }
    code.map(|c| bytes(&c))
}
```
