`locum/src/d3d11/registry.rs`:

```rs
//! Every resource the game creates, from its creation to its destruction: a number, its description, the stack that
//! created it, and the hash of the data it was created with (written to the blob store with `uploads store`). Updates
//! that cover a whole subresource are hashed the same way, except, outside a capture, those of per-frame data: a
//! constant buffer, or a resource already updated in this frame or the last. Those are rewritten many times a second
//! (Sekiro: thousands of updates a frame), their bytes match no file, and a capture records its own. A capture lists
//! every live resource from here, and takes the contents of the immutable ones it uses from their upload instead of
//! reading them back.
//!
//! Nothing here holds a reference to a resource: entries are keyed by number and removed by the runtime's
//! destruction callback, so the registry never keeps a resource alive or touches a dead one.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

use locum_capture::cost::Cost;
use locum_capture::hash::key;
use locum_capture::layout::{self, Sub};
use locum_capture::{stacks, writer};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::ID3DDestructionNotifier;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::core::{GUID, Interface};

use crate::log::log;
use crate::settings::{Uploads, settings};

/// The private-data key of the number locum gives each object, with the number of the capture that last described
/// it: `[id, capture]`.
pub const ID_KEY: GUID = GUID::from_u128(0x6c6f_6375_6d00_4a5e_9d1b_7a2f_8c3e_0002);

static NEXT_ID: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);

pub fn next_id() -> u64 {
    NEXT_ID.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// What a resource is, from its description.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Dims {
    pub kind: &'static str,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub depth: u32,
    pub mips: u32,
    pub array: u32,
    pub format: u32,
    pub samples: u32,
    pub stride: u32,
    pub usage: u32,
    pub bind: u32,
    pub cpu: u32,
    pub misc: u32,
    /// The API's description struct.
    pub desc: Vec<u8>,
}

impl Dims {
    /// The subresources of its contents in the canonical layout (a multisampled texture's as resolved), or None
    /// for a format without one.
    pub fn subs(&self) -> Option<Vec<Sub>> {
        if self.kind == "buffer" {
            return Some(layout::buffer(self.width));
        }
        layout::texture(
            self.format,
            self.width,
            self.height,
            self.depth,
            self.mips,
            self.array,
        )
    }

    pub fn immutable(&self) -> bool {
        self.usage == D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE.0 as u32
    }
}

fn bytes_of<T>(t: &T) -> Vec<u8> {
    unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts((t as *const T).cast::<u8>(), size_of::<T>()) }.to_vec()
}

pub fn buffer_dims(d: &D3D11_BUFFER_DESC) -> Dims {
    Dims {
        kind: "buffer",
        width: d.ByteWidth,
        height: 1,
        depth: 1,
        mips: 1,
        array: 1,
        stride: d.StructureByteStride,
        usage: d.Usage.0 as u32,
        bind: d.BindFlags,
        cpu: d.CPUAccessFlags,
        misc: d.MiscFlags,
        desc: bytes_of(d),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

pub fn texture1d_dims(d: &D3D11_TEXTURE1D_DESC) -> Dims {
    Dims {
        kind: "texture1d",
        width: d.Width,
        height: 1,
        depth: 1,
        mips: d.MipLevels,
        array: d.ArraySize,
        format: d.Format.0 as u32,
        samples: 1,
        usage: d.Usage.0 as u32,
        bind: d.BindFlags,
        cpu: d.CPUAccessFlags,
        misc: d.MiscFlags,
        desc: bytes_of(d),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

pub fn texture2d_dims(d: &D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC) -> Dims {
    Dims {
        kind: "texture2d",
        width: d.Width,
        height: d.Height,
        depth: 1,
        mips: d.MipLevels,
        array: d.ArraySize,
        format: d.Format.0 as u32,
        samples: d.SampleDesc.Count,
        usage: d.Usage.0 as u32,
        bind: d.BindFlags,
        cpu: d.CPUAccessFlags,
        misc: d.MiscFlags,
        desc: bytes_of(d),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

pub fn texture3d_dims(d: &D3D11_TEXTURE3D_DESC) -> Dims {
    Dims {
        kind: "texture3d",
        width: d.Width,
        height: d.Height,
        depth: d.Depth,
        mips: d.MipLevels,
        array: 1,
        format: d.Format.0 as u32,
        samples: 1,
        usage: d.Usage.0 as u32,
        bind: d.BindFlags,
        cpu: d.CPUAccessFlags,
        misc: d.MiscFlags,
        desc: bytes_of(d),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

/// The description of a live resource, with a mip count of 0 resolved to the full chain the runtime made.
pub fn dims_of(resource: &ID3D11Resource) -> Option<Dims> {
    unsafe {
        if let Ok(t) = resource.cast::<ID3D11Texture2D>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC::default();
            t.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return Some(texture2d_dims(&d));
        }
        if let Ok(b) = resource.cast::<ID3D11Buffer>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_BUFFER_DESC::default();
            b.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return Some(buffer_dims(&d));
        }
        if let Ok(t) = resource.cast::<ID3D11Texture3D>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE3D_DESC::default();
            t.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return Some(texture3d_dims(&d));
        }
        if let Ok(t) = resource.cast::<ID3D11Texture1D>() {
            let mut d = D3D11_TEXTURE1D_DESC::default();
            t.GetDesc(&mut d);
            return Some(texture1d_dims(&d));
        }
    }
    None
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Entry {
    pub dims: Dims,
    /// Its subresources in the canonical layout (none for a format without one).
    pub subs: Vec<Sub>,
    pub created_frame: Option<u64>,
    pub created_stack: Vec<u64>,
    /// Key of the data it was created with, and whether that data is in the blob store.
    pub upload: Option<String>,
    pub upload_stored: bool,
    /// Key of each subresource's bytes as last uploaded whole (by creation or an update), by subresource index.
    pub sub_hashes: Vec<Option<String>>,
    pub updated_frame: Option<u64>,
    pub updated_stack: Vec<u64>,
    pub update_count: u64,
}

static ENTRIES: Mutex<Option<HashMap<u64, Entry>>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn entries() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, Option<HashMap<u64, Entry>>> {
    ENTRIES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

/// The entry of the resource numbered `id`, if it is alive.
pub fn entry(id: u64) -> Option<Entry> {
    entries().as_ref()?.get(&id).cloned()
}

/// What the resource numbered `id` is (`Dims::kind`) and its subresource `sub` (None for a format without a
/// canonical layout), without copying its entry.
pub fn sub_of(id: u64, sub: u32) -> Option<(&'static str, Option<Sub>)> {
    let entries = entries();
    let e = entries.as_ref()?.get(&id)?;
    Some((e.dims.kind, e.subs.get(sub as usize).copied()))
}

/// Every live resource's number.
pub fn live() -> Vec<u64> {
    entries()
        .as_ref()
        .map_or_else(Vec::new, |e| e.keys().copied().collect())
}

unsafe extern "system" fn destroyed(data: *mut c_void) {
    if let Some(e) = entries().as_mut() {
        e.remove(&(data as u64));
    }
}

/// The number on `object`, if it has one.
pub fn id_on(object: &ID3D11DeviceChild) -> Option<(u64, u64)> {
    let mut data = [0u64; 2];
    let mut size = 16u32;
    let ok = unsafe { object.GetPrivateData(&ID_KEY, &mut size, Some(data.as_mut_ptr().cast())) }.is_ok();
    (ok && size == 16).then_some((data[0], data[1]))
}

pub fn set_id(object: &ID3D11DeviceChild, id: u64, capture: u64) {
    let data = [id, capture];
    let _ = unsafe { object.SetPrivateData(&ID_KEY, 16, Some(data.as_ptr().cast())) };
}

/// Registers a resource: gives it a number and an entry, and watches for its destruction. `initial` is the data it
/// was created with (one per subresource), if any.
/// Resources registered (with the initial data hashed and handed to the writer), and updates seen, on the game's
/// threads.
pub static REGISTERED: Cost = Cost::new();
pub static UPDATES: Cost = Cost::new();

unsafe fn register(
    resource: &ID3D11Resource,
    dims: Dims,
    initial: *const D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA,
    created: bool,
) -> u64 {
    let child: ID3D11DeviceChild = resource.cast().expect("a resource is a device child");
    if let Some((id, _)) = id_on(&child) {
        return id;
    }
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut hashed = 0u64;
    let id = next_id();
    set_id(&child, id, 0);
    let mut entry = Entry {
        created_frame: created.then(crate::dxgi::frame),
        created_stack: if created { stacks::capture() } else { Vec::new() },
        ..Default::default()
    };
    if let Some(subs) = dims.subs() {
        entry.sub_hashes = vec![None; subs.len()];
        if !initial.is_null() && settings().uploads != Uploads::Off {
            let (bytes, hashes) = unsafe { pack_initial(&dims, &subs, initial) };
            hashed = bytes.len() as u64;
            let whole = key(&bytes);
            entry.sub_hashes = hashes.into_iter().map(Some).collect();
            entry.upload_stored = settings().uploads == Uploads::Store
                && writer::blob(&settings().blobs, whole.clone(), bytes, false);
            entry.upload = Some(whole);
        }
        entry.subs = subs;
    }
    entry.dims = dims;
    entries().get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).insert(id, entry);
    match resource.cast::<ID3DDestructionNotifier>() {
        Ok(n) => {
            let _ = unsafe { n.RegisterDestructionCallback(Some(destroyed), id as *const c_void) };
        }
        Err(e) => {
            static ONCE: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
            ONCE.call_once(|| log!("resources have no ID3DDestructionNotifier ({e}): dead ones stay listed"));
        }
    }
    REGISTERED.add(started, hashed);
    id
}

/// The canonical bytes of initial data, and each subresource's key.
unsafe fn pack_initial(
    dims: &Dims,
    subs: &[Sub],
    initial: *const D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA,
) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<String>) {
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(layout::total(subs) as usize);
    let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(subs.len());
    for (i, sub) in subs.iter().enumerate() {
        let d = unsafe { &*initial.add(i) };
        let start = bytes.len();
        let (row, slice) = if dims.kind == "buffer" || dims.kind == "texture1d" {
            (sub.row_bytes as usize, sub.slice_bytes() as usize)
        } else {
            (d.SysMemPitch as usize, d.SysMemSlicePitch as usize)
        };
        unsafe { layout::pack(sub, d.pSysMem.cast(), row, slice, &mut bytes) };
        hashes.push(key(&bytes[start..]));
    }
    (bytes, hashes)
}

/// After a `Create*` of a resource: registers it if it was made.
///
/// # Safety
/// `out` is the call's out pointer; `initial` is the call's initial data (null or one per subresource).
pub unsafe fn created(
    hr: windows::core::HRESULT,
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
    initial: *const D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA,
) {
    if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
        return;
    }
    let Some(resource) = (unsafe { ID3D11Resource::from_raw_borrowed(&*out) }) else {
        return;
    };
    // The description from the object, so a mip count of 0 is the chain the runtime made.
    if let Some(dims) = dims_of(resource) {
        unsafe { register(resource, dims, initial, true) };
    }
}

/// The number of a resource locum did not see created (a swap chain's buffers, a shared resource), registering it.
pub fn id_of(resource: &ID3D11Resource) -> u64 {
    let child: ID3D11DeviceChild = resource.cast().expect("a resource is a device child");
    if let Some((id, _)) = id_on(&child) {
        return id;
    }
    match dims_of(resource) {
        Some(dims) => unsafe { register(resource, dims, core::ptr::null(), false) },
        None => {
            let id = next_id();
            set_id(&child, id, 0);
            id
        }
    }
}

/// Extra source offset of legacy UpdateSubresource on an emulated deferred context.
/// See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/d3d11/nf-d3d11-id3d11devicecontext-updatesubresource
pub(super) fn source_offset(dims: &Dims, region: &D3D11_BOX, row: u32, depth: u32) -> Option<usize> {
    if dims.kind == "buffer" {
        return Some(region.left as usize);
    }
    let format = locum_capture::format::layout(dims.format)?;
    let x = (region.left / format.block_width) as usize * format.block_bytes as usize;
    let y = (region.top / format.block_height) as usize;
    (region.front as usize)
        .checked_mul(depth as usize)?
        .checked_add(y.checked_mul(row as usize)?)?
        .checked_add(x)
}

/// An `UpdateSubresource`: counted on the resource's entry, and hashed (and stored) when it covers a whole
/// subresource. Returns the canonical bytes of the region and their key, for a capture.
///
/// # Safety
/// `data` must hold the region `region` (or the whole subresource) with the given pitches.
pub unsafe fn updated(
    resource: &ID3D11Resource,
    sub: u32,
    region: Option<&D3D11_BOX>,
    data: *const c_void,
    row_pitch: u32,
    depth_pitch: u32,
    keep: bool,
) -> Option<(Vec<u8>, String)> {
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let (out, hashed) = unsafe { update_entry(resource, sub, region, data, row_pitch, depth_pitch, keep) };
    UPDATES.add(started, hashed);
    out
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
unsafe fn update_entry(
    resource: &ID3D11Resource,
    sub: u32,
    region: Option<&D3D11_BOX>,
    data: *const c_void,
    row_pitch: u32,
    depth_pitch: u32,
    keep: bool,
) -> (Option<(Vec<u8>, String)>, u64) {
    let id = id_of(resource);
    // Counted, and what the rest needs taken, under one lock.
    let (kind, format, whole, per_frame) = {
        let mut entries = entries();
        let Some(e) = entries.as_mut().and_then(|e| e.get_mut(&id)) else {
            return (None, 0);
        };
        let frame = crate::dxgi::frame();
        let per_frame = e.dims.bind & D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER.0 as u32 != 0
            || e.updated_frame.is_some_and(|f| f + 1 >= frame);
        e.update_count += 1;
        e.updated_frame = Some(frame);
        if per_frame && !keep {
            // Its bytes are unknown from here; a capture reads them back.
            if let Some(slot) = e.sub_hashes.get_mut(sub as usize) {
                *slot = None;
            }
            return (None, 0);
        }
        let Some(&whole) = e.subs.get(sub as usize) else {
            return (None, 0);
        };
        (e.dims.kind, e.dims.format, whole, per_frame)
    };
    let f = locum_capture::format::layout(format).unwrap_or(locum_capture::format::Layout {
        block_width: 1,
        block_height: 1,
        block_bytes: 1,
    });
    // The region as a subresource of its own.
    let part = match region {
        None => whole,
        Some(b) if kind == "buffer" => Sub {
            width: b.right.saturating_sub(b.left),
            row_bytes: b.right.saturating_sub(b.left),
            ..whole
        },
        Some(b) => {
            let (w, h, d) = (
                b.right.saturating_sub(b.left),
                b.bottom.saturating_sub(b.top),
                b.back.saturating_sub(b.front),
            );
            Sub {
                width: w,
                height: h,
                depth: d,
                row_bytes: f.row_bytes(w),
                rows: f.rows(h),
                size: u64::from(f.row_bytes(w)) * u64::from(f.rows(h)) * u64::from(d),
                ..whole
            }
        }
    };
    let covers = match region {
        None => true,
        Some(b) => {
            b.left == 0
                && b.top == 0
                && b.front == 0
                && part.row_bytes == whole.row_bytes
                && part.rows == whole.rows
                && part.depth == whole.depth
        }
    };
    let (row, slice) = if kind == "buffer" || kind == "texture1d" {
        (part.row_bytes as usize, part.slice_bytes() as usize)
    } else {
        (row_pitch as usize, depth_pitch as usize)
    };
    // Stored for the join with files: whole uploads of what is not per-frame data.
    let store = covers && !per_frame && settings().uploads == Uploads::Store;
    let hashing = covers && settings().uploads != Uploads::Off;
    let mut out = None;
    let mut new_hash = None;
    let mut hashed = 0;
    if keep || hashing {
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(part.size as usize);
        unsafe { layout::pack(&part, data.cast(), row, slice, &mut bytes) };
        hashed = bytes.len() as u64;
        let k = key(&bytes);
        if covers {
            new_hash = Some(k.clone());
        }
        if keep {
            if store {
                writer::blob(&settings().blobs, k.clone(), bytes.clone(), false);
            }
            out = Some((bytes, k));
        } else if store {
            writer::blob(&settings().blobs, k, bytes, false);
        }
    }
    // Per-frame data's updates are a capture's events, each with its own stack.
    let stack = (!per_frame).then(stacks::capture);
    if let Some(e) = entries().as_mut().and_then(|e| e.get_mut(&id)) {
        if let Some(stack) = stack {
            e.updated_stack = stack;
        }
        if let Some(slot) = e.sub_hashes.get_mut(sub as usize) {
            // A partial update leaves the subresource's bytes unknown.
            *slot = new_hash;
        }
    }
    (out, hashed)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod source_offset_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn offsets_use_bytes_blocks_and_volume_pitches() {
        let region = D3D11_BOX {
            left: 4,
            top: 8,
            front: 2,
            right: 8,
            bottom: 12,
            back: 3,
        };
        let dims = |kind, format| Dims {
            kind,
            format,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(source_offset(&dims("buffer", 0), &region, 99, 999), Some(4));
        assert_eq!(
            source_offset(&dims("texture3d", 28), &region, 64, 1024),
            Some(2576)
        );
        assert_eq!(source_offset(&dims("texture3d", 71), &region, 32, 256), Some(584));
        assert_eq!(
            source_offset(&dims("texture3d", 77), &region, 64, 512),
            Some(1168)
        );
        assert_eq!(source_offset(&dims("texture2d", 103), &region, 64, 0), None);
    }
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/shaders.rs`:

```rs
//! Shader identity. Every shader the game creates is hashed from its bytecode; the hash is stored on the real shader
//! object (`SetPrivateData`), so a draw can read it back from whatever shader is bound, and nothing goes stale when
//! the game frees a shader and its address is reused. Each distinct bytecode is written once to
//! `<LOCUM_DIR>/shaders/<hash>.<stage>.dxbc`.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::ID3D11DeviceChild;
use windows::core::{GUID, HRESULT, Interface};

use crate::log::{folder, log};

/// The private-data key under which locum stores a shader's hash on the real object.
const HASH_KEY: GUID = GUID::from_u128(0x6c6f_6375_6d00_4a5e_9d1b_7a2f_8c3e_0001);

/// FNV-1a 64 of the bytecode, from the offset basis `1469598103934665603`: the standard basis
/// `14695981039346656037` with its last digit dropped. Earlier captures of these games used this seed, so their
/// hashes and locum's match.
pub fn hash(code: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    let mut h: u64 = 1_469_598_103_934_665_603;
    for &b in code {
        h ^= u64::from(b);
        h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01b3);
    }
    h
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Stage {
    Vertex,
    Hull,
    Domain,
    Geometry,
    Pixel,
    Compute,
}

impl Stage {
    /// The stages a draw runs, in pipeline order.
    pub const GRAPHICS: [Stage; 5] = [
        Stage::Vertex,
        Stage::Hull,
        Stage::Domain,
        Stage::Geometry,
        Stage::Pixel,
    ];

    pub fn short(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Stage::Vertex => "vs",
            Stage::Hull => "hs",
            Stage::Domain => "ds",
            Stage::Geometry => "gs",
            Stage::Pixel => "ps",
            Stage::Compute => "cs",
        }
    }
}

/// After a `Create*Shader`: tags the new shader with its hash and writes its bytecode the first time it is seen.
///
/// # Safety
/// `code` must point to `len` readable bytes; `out` is the call's out pointer.
pub unsafe fn created(stage: Stage, code: *const c_void, len: usize, hr: HRESULT, out: *mut *mut c_void) {
    if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || code.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
        return;
    }
    let bytes = unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(code.cast::<u8>(), len) };
    let h = hash(bytes);
    if let Some(shader) = unsafe { ID3D11DeviceChild::from_raw_borrowed(&*out) } {
        let _ = unsafe { shader.SetPrivateData(&HASH_KEY, 8, Some((&h as *const u64).cast())) };
    }
    static CREATED: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
    static SEEN: Mutex<Option<HashSet<u64>>> = Mutex::new(None);
    let created = CREATED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;
    let new = SEEN
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .get_or_insert_with(HashSet::new)
        .insert(h);
    if new && let Ok(Some(o)) = locum_capture::dxbc::order_dependent(bytes) {
        let ops: Vec<String> = o
            .ops
            .iter()
            .map(|op| format!("{} x{}", op.name, op.count))
            .collect();
        log!(
            "shader {h:016x} ({}): what it writes depends on the order the GPU runs its threads ({})",
            stage.short(),
            ops.join(", ")
        );
        ORDER_DEPENDENT
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .get_or_insert_with(HashSet::new)
            .insert(h);
    }
    if new && let Some(dir) = folder().map(|d| d.join("shaders")) {
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        let _ = std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{h:016x}.{}.dxbc", stage.short())), bytes);
    }
    if created.is_power_of_two() || created.is_multiple_of(5000) {
        let distinct = SEEN
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .as_ref()
            .map_or(0, HashSet::len);
        log!("shaders created: {created}, distinct bytecode: {distinct}");
    }
}

/// Shaders whose writes depend on the order the GPU runs their threads (`locum_capture::dxbc`), by hash.
static ORDER_DEPENDENT: Mutex<Option<HashSet<u64>>> = Mutex::new(None);

/// Whether the shader with hash `h` writes what depends on the order the GPU runs its threads.
pub fn order_dependent(h: u64) -> bool {
    ORDER_DEPENDENT
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|s| s.contains(&h))
}

/// The hash locum stored on a shader, if it is one locum saw created.
///
/// # Safety
/// `shader` must be null or a live device child.
pub unsafe fn hash_of(shader: *mut c_void) -> Option<u64> {
    let shader = unsafe { ID3D11DeviceChild::from_raw_borrowed(&shader) }?;
    let mut h = 0u64;
    let mut size = 8u32;
    unsafe { shader.GetPrivateData(&HASH_KEY, &mut size, Some((&mut h as *mut u64).cast())) }.ok()?;
    (size == 8).then_some(h)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::hash;

    #[test]
    fn empty_input_is_the_seed() {
        assert_eq!(hash(&[]), 1_469_598_103_934_665_603);
    }

    #[test]
    fn one_byte() {
        // (seed ^ 0x61) * prime, wrapping
        let expected = (1_469_598_103_934_665_603u64 ^ 0x61).wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01b3);
        assert_eq!(hash(b"a"), expected);
    }
}
```

`locum/src/d3d11/stages.rs`:

```rs
//! A shader stage's bindings on a real context, by stage. Direct3D 11 has a copy of each getter and setter per stage
//! (`VSGetShader`, `PSGetShader`, ...); these pick the right one.

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::*;
use windows::core::{Interface, Result};

use crate::d3d11::shaders::Stage;

/// Constant-buffer slots per stage.
pub const CB_SLOTS: u32 = D3D11_COMMONSHADER_CONSTANT_BUFFER_API_SLOT_COUNT;
/// Shader resource view slots per stage.
pub const SRV_SLOTS: usize = D3D11_COMMONSHADER_INPUT_RESOURCE_SLOT_COUNT as usize;

/// Sampler slots per stage.
pub const SAMPLER_SLOTS: usize = D3D11_COMMONSHADER_SAMPLER_SLOT_COUNT as usize;

/// A constant buffer bound to a slot, with its range in constants (16 bytes each).
pub struct CbBinding {
    pub buffer: Option<ID3D11Buffer>,
    pub first: u32,
    pub count: u32,
}

macro_rules! per_stage {
    ($($stage:ident => $ty:ident, $get:ident, $set:ident, $get_cbs:ident, $set_cbs:ident, $get_srvs:ident, $get_samplers:ident, $create:ident;)*) => {
        /// The shader bound to `stage`.
        pub unsafe fn shader(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, stage: Stage) -> Option<ID3D11DeviceChild> {
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => {
                    let mut s = None;
                    unsafe { c.$get(&mut s, None, None) };
                    s.map(|s| s.cast().expect("a shader is a device child"))
                })*
            }
        }

        /// Binds `shader` (which must be a shader of `stage`) to `stage`, without class instances.
        pub unsafe fn set_shader(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, stage: Stage, shader: Option<&ID3D11DeviceChild>) {
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => {
                    let s = shader.map(|s| s.cast::<$ty>().expect("a shader of this stage"));
                    unsafe { c.$set(s.as_ref(), None) };
                })*
            }
        }

        /// The constant buffers bound to `stage` from slot 0, with their ranges.
        pub unsafe fn constant_buffers(
            c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4,
            stage: Stage,
        ) -> [CbBinding; CB_SLOTS as usize] {
            let mut buffers: [Option<ID3D11Buffer>; CB_SLOTS as usize] = Default::default();
            let mut firsts = [0u32; CB_SLOTS as usize];
            let mut counts = [0u32; CB_SLOTS as usize];
            let (b, f, n) = (buffers.as_mut_ptr(), firsts.as_mut_ptr(), counts.as_mut_ptr());
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => unsafe { c.$get_cbs(0, CB_SLOTS, Some(b), Some(f), Some(n)) },)*
            }
            let mut i = 0;
            buffers.map(|buffer| {
                let binding = CbBinding { buffer, first: firsts[i], count: counts[i] };
                i += 1;
                binding
            })
        }

        /// Binds one constant buffer to `slot` of `stage`. A range of (0, 4096) is what the runtime reports for a
        /// buffer bound whole, and binds it whole.
        pub unsafe fn set_constant_buffer(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, stage: Stage, slot: u32, binding: &CbBinding) {
            let buffers = [binding.buffer.clone()];
            let (first, count) = (binding.first, binding.count);
            let whole = first == 0 && count == D3D11_REQ_CONSTANT_BUFFER_ELEMENT_COUNT;
            let (f, n) = if whole { (None, None) } else { (Some(&first as *const u32), Some(&count as *const u32)) };
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => unsafe { c.$set_cbs(slot, 1, Some(buffers.as_ptr()), f, n) },)*
            }
        }

        /// The shader resource views bound to `stage`.
        pub unsafe fn shader_resources(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, stage: Stage) -> [Option<ID3D11ShaderResourceView>; SRV_SLOTS] {
            let mut views = [const { None }; SRV_SLOTS];
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => unsafe { c.$get_srvs(0, Some(&mut views)) },)*
            }
            views
        }

        /// The samplers bound to `stage`.
        pub unsafe fn samplers(c: &ID3D11DeviceContext4, stage: Stage) -> [Option<ID3D11SamplerState>; SAMPLER_SLOTS] {
            let mut samplers = [const { None }; SAMPLER_SLOTS];
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => unsafe { c.$get_samplers(0, Some(&mut samplers)) },)*
            }
            samplers
        }

        /// Creates a shader of `stage` from bytecode on the real device.
        pub unsafe fn create_shader(device: &ID3D11Device, stage: Stage, code: &[u8]) -> Result<ID3D11DeviceChild> {
            match stage {
                $(Stage::$stage => {
                    let mut s = None;
                    unsafe { device.$create(code, None, Some(&mut s)) }?;
                    Ok(s.expect("a created shader").cast().expect("a shader is a device child"))
                })*
            }
        }
    };
}

per_stage! {
    Vertex => ID3D11VertexShader, VSGetShader, VSSetShader, VSGetConstantBuffers1, VSSetConstantBuffers1, VSGetShaderResources, VSGetSamplers, CreateVertexShader;
    Hull => ID3D11HullShader, HSGetShader, HSSetShader, HSGetConstantBuffers1, HSSetConstantBuffers1, HSGetShaderResources, HSGetSamplers, CreateHullShader;
    Domain => ID3D11DomainShader, DSGetShader, DSSetShader, DSGetConstantBuffers1, DSSetConstantBuffers1, DSGetShaderResources, DSGetSamplers, CreateDomainShader;
    Geometry => ID3D11GeometryShader, GSGetShader, GSSetShader, GSGetConstantBuffers1, GSSetConstantBuffers1, GSGetShaderResources, GSGetSamplers, CreateGeometryShader;
    Pixel => ID3D11PixelShader, PSGetShader, PSSetShader, PSGetConstantBuffers1, PSSetConstantBuffers1, PSGetShaderResources, PSGetSamplers, CreatePixelShader;
    Compute => ID3D11ComputeShader, CSGetShader, CSSetShader, CSGetConstantBuffers1, CSSetConstantBuffers1, CSGetShaderResources, CSGetSamplers, CreateComputeShader;
}
```

`locum/src/dump.rs`:

```rs
//! A memory dump of the process at a captured frame. A process writing a dump of itself can deadlock on locks its
//! other threads hold, so another process writes it: `locum-cli dump` (settings.txt `dumper`). The game waits in
//! Present only while that process takes a snapshot of this one (a copy-on-write clone); the dump is written from the
//! snapshot afterwards, while the game runs on.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use windows::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, WAIT_OBJECT_0};
use windows::Win32::System::Threading::{CreateEventW, WaitForSingleObject};
use windows::core::HSTRING;

use crate::settings::settings;

/// What became of a dump.
pub struct Dumped {
    /// Where the dump is being written (it is `<path>.part` until complete).
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// How long the game waited for the snapshot.
    pub held: Duration,
}

/// Starts a dump of this process named `name`, in the dumps folder (settings.txt `dumps`) or `dir`, and waits until
/// the snapshot is taken.
pub fn dump(name: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<Dumped, String> {
    let dumper = settings()
        .dumper
        .clone()
        .ok_or("no dumper set (settings.txt: dumper PATH-TO-locum-cli.exe)")?;
    let dir = settings().dumps.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| dir.to_path_buf());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", dir.display()))?;
    let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.dmp"));
    let pid = std::process::id();
    let event_name = format!("Local\\locum-dump-{pid}-{name}");
    let event = unsafe { CreateEventW(None, true, false, &HSTRING::from(event_name.as_str())) }
        .map_err(|e| format!("CreateEventW: {e}"))?;
    let started = Instant::now();
    let child = Command::new(&dumper)
        .arg("dump")
        .arg("--pid")
        .arg(pid.to_string())
        .arg("--out")
        .arg(&path)
        .arg("--signal")
        .arg(&event_name)
        .spawn();
    let result = match child {
        Err(e) => Err(format!("{}: {e}", dumper.display())),
        Ok(mut child) => loop {
            if unsafe { WaitForSingleObject(event, 50) } == WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
                break Ok(Dumped {
                    path,
                    held: started.elapsed(),
                });
            }
            if let Ok(Some(status)) = child.try_wait() {
                break Err(format!("the dumper ended before its snapshot: {status}"));
            }
            if started.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(120) {
                break Err("no snapshot after 120 s".into());
            }
        },
    };
    let _ = unsafe { CloseHandle(event) };
    result
}

```

`locum/src/dxgi/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! The DXGI factory, its adapters and the swap chains it makes.
//!
//! A swap chain is created from a device: the factory gives the real DXGI the real device under our wrapper, and
//! wraps the swap chain it gets back so that `GetDevice` returns our device and every `Present` passes through
//! locum (the frame boundary).
//!
//! Adapters are wrapped so that the way from a device to its factory (`IDXGIDevice::GetAdapter`, then
//! `IDXGIAdapter::GetParent`) ends at one of our factories; a game that makes its swap chain from that factory gets
//! one of our swap chains.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::Instant;

use windows::Win32::Foundation::{HWND, LUID};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::*;
use windows::core::{GUID, HRESULT, IUnknown, Interface};

use crate::com::answer_query;
use crate::d3d11::capture;
use crate::d3d11::device::Device;
use crate::log::log;
use crate::vtables::adapter::{AdapterMethods, real as real_adapter};
use crate::vtables::factory::{FactoryMethods, real as real_factory};
use crate::vtables::swapchain::{SwapChainMethods, real as real_swapchain};

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Factory {
    vtbl: *const IDXGIFactory7_Vtbl,
    refs: AtomicU32,
    inner: IDXGIFactory7,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct SwapChain {
    vtbl: *const IDXGISwapChain4_Vtbl,
    refs: AtomicU32,
    inner: IDXGISwapChain4,
    /// Our device, with one reference, or null when the swap chain was made for a device we do not wrap.
    device: *const Device,
    /// The factory that made it, with one reference, or null.
    factory: *const Factory,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Adapter {
    vtbl: *const IDXGIAdapter4_Vtbl,
    refs: AtomicU32,
    inner: IDXGIAdapter4,
    /// Our factory, its parent, with one reference: the factory that enumerated it, or else the real parent wrapped
    /// when first asked for (0 until then, 1 if that failed).
    factory: OnceLock<usize>,
}

static FACTORY_VTBL: IDXGIFactory7_Vtbl = crate::vtables::factory::vtable::<Factory>();
static ADAPTER_VTBL: IDXGIAdapter4_Vtbl = crate::vtables::adapter::vtable::<Adapter>();
static SWAPCHAIN_VTBL: IDXGISwapChain4_Vtbl = crate::vtables::swapchain::vtable::<SwapChain>();

const ADAPTER_IIDS: [GUID; 7] = [
    IUnknown::IID,
    IDXGIObject::IID,
    IDXGIAdapter::IID,
    IDXGIAdapter1::IID,
    IDXGIAdapter2::IID,
    IDXGIAdapter3::IID,
    IDXGIAdapter4::IID,
];

const FACTORY_IIDS: [GUID; 10] = [
    IUnknown::IID,
    IDXGIObject::IID,
    IDXGIFactory::IID,
    IDXGIFactory1::IID,
    IDXGIFactory2::IID,
    IDXGIFactory3::IID,
    IDXGIFactory4::IID,
    IDXGIFactory5::IID,
    IDXGIFactory6::IID,
    IDXGIFactory7::IID,
];

const SWAPCHAIN_IIDS: [GUID; 8] = [
    IUnknown::IID,
    IDXGIObject::IID,
    IDXGIDeviceSubObject::IID,
    IDXGISwapChain::IID,
    IDXGISwapChain1::IID,
    IDXGISwapChain2::IID,
    IDXGISwapChain3::IID,
    IDXGISwapChain4::IID,
];

impl Factory {
    /// Wraps a factory the real DXGI created, taking over the caller's reference. Gives the factory back if it is
    /// not an `IDXGIFactory7`.
    pub fn wrap(factory: IUnknown) -> Result<*mut Factory, IUnknown> {
        let Ok(inner) = factory.cast::<IDXGIFactory7>() else {
            log!("factory is not an IDXGIFactory7: left unwrapped");
            return Err(factory);
        };
        let wrapper = Box::into_raw(Box::new(Factory {
            vtbl: &FACTORY_VTBL,
            refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
            inner,
        }));
        log!("wrapped factory {:p} as {wrapper:p}", factory.as_raw());
        Ok(wrapper)
    }

    /// Replaces the real swap chain the factory wrote to `out` with a wrapper bound to the device the game passed.
    unsafe fn wrap_swapchain(&self, hr: HRESULT, device: *mut c_void, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
            return hr;
        }
        let real = unsafe { IUnknown::from_raw(*out) };
        let ours = Device::from_raw(device);
        if ours.is_none() {
            log!("swap chain made for a device locum does not wrap ({device:p}): left unwrapped");
            unsafe { *out = real.into_raw() };
            return hr;
        }
        match SwapChain::wrap(real, ours, Some(self)) {
            Ok(w) => unsafe { *out = w.cast() },
            Err(real) => unsafe { *out = real.into_raw() },
        }
        hr
    }

    /// Replaces the real adapter an enumeration wrote to `out` with a wrapper whose parent is this factory.
    unsafe fn wrap_adapter(&self, hr: HRESULT, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } {
            return hr;
        }
        let real = unsafe { IUnknown::from_raw(*out) };
        match Adapter::wrap(real, Some(self)) {
            Ok(w) => unsafe { *out = w.cast() },
            Err(real) => unsafe { *out = real.into_raw() },
        }
        hr
    }
}

impl Adapter {
    /// Wraps a real adapter, taking over the caller's reference; `factory`, its parent if known, gains a reference.
    pub fn wrap(adapter: IUnknown, factory: Option<&Factory>) -> Result<*mut Adapter, IUnknown> {
        let Ok(inner) = adapter.cast::<IDXGIAdapter4>() else {
            log!("adapter is not an IDXGIAdapter4: left unwrapped");
            return Err(adapter);
        };
        let parent = OnceLock::new();
        if let Some(f) = factory {
            unsafe { f.AddRef() };
            let _ = parent.set(f as *const Factory as usize);
        }
        let wrapper = Box::into_raw(Box::new(Adapter {
            vtbl: &ADAPTER_VTBL,
            refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
            inner,
            factory: parent,
        }));
        log!("wrapped adapter {:p} as {wrapper:p}", adapter.as_raw());
        Ok(wrapper)
    }

    /// If `object` is one of our adapters, the real adapter under it; otherwise `object` unchanged.
    pub fn unwrap_raw(object: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void {
        if object.is_null() {
            return object;
        }
        let vtbl = unsafe { *(object as *const *const IDXGIAdapter4_Vtbl) };
        if core::ptr::eq(vtbl, &ADAPTER_VTBL) {
            unsafe { (*(object as *const Adapter)).inner.as_raw() }
        } else {
            object
        }
    }

    /// Our factory for this adapter's parent.
    fn factory(&self) -> Option<&Factory> {
        let p = *self.factory.get_or_init(|| {
            let real = match unsafe { self.inner.GetParent::<IDXGIFactory7>() } {
                Ok(f) => f,
                Err(e) => {
                    log!("IDXGIAdapter::GetParent on the real adapter failed: {e}");
                    return 1;
                }
            };
            match Factory::wrap(real.into()) {
                Ok(w) => w as usize,
                Err(_) => 1,
            }
        });
        (p > 1).then(|| unsafe { &*(p as *const Factory) })
    }
}

impl SwapChain {
    /// Wraps a real swap chain, taking over the caller's reference; `device` and `factory` gain a reference each.
    pub fn wrap(
        swapchain: IUnknown,
        device: Option<&Device>,
        factory: Option<&Factory>,
    ) -> Result<*mut SwapChain, IUnknown> {
        let Ok(inner) = swapchain.cast::<IDXGISwapChain4>() else {
            log!("swap chain is not an IDXGISwapChain4: left unwrapped");
            return Err(swapchain);
        };
        let device = device.map_or(core::ptr::null(), |d| {
            unsafe { crate::vtables::device::DeviceMethods::AddRef(d) };
            d as *const Device
        });
        let factory = factory.map_or(core::ptr::null(), |f| {
            unsafe { f.AddRef() };
            f as *const Factory
        });
        let wrapper = Box::into_raw(Box::new(SwapChain {
            vtbl: &SWAPCHAIN_VTBL,
            refs: AtomicU32::new(1),
            inner,
            device,
            factory,
        }));
        log!("wrapped swap chain {:p} as {wrapper:p}", swapchain.as_raw());
        Ok(wrapper)
    }
}

unsafe impl FactoryMethods for Factory {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            answer_query(
                "factory",
                self as *const _ as _,
                self.inner(),
                &FACTORY_IIDS,
                iid,
                out,
                || {
                    self.AddRef();
                },
            )
        }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        self.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        let left = self.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
        if left == 0 {
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self as *const Factory as *mut Factory) });
        }
        left
    }

    unsafe fn CreateSwapChain(
        &self,
        a0: *mut c_void,
        a1: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC,
        a2: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            let hr = real_factory::CreateSwapChain(self.inner(), Device::unwrap_raw(a0), a1, a2);
            self.wrap_swapchain(hr, a0, a2)
        }
    }

    unsafe fn CreateSwapChainForHwnd(
        &self,
        a0: *mut c_void,
        a1: HWND,
        a2: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1,
        a3: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FULLSCREEN_DESC,
        a4: *mut c_void,
        a5: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            let hr = real_factory::CreateSwapChainForHwnd(
                self.inner(),
                Device::unwrap_raw(a0),
                a1,
                a2,
                a3,
                a4,
                a5,
            );
            self.wrap_swapchain(hr, a0, a5)
        }
    }

    unsafe fn CreateSwapChainForCoreWindow(
        &self,
        a0: *mut c_void,
        a1: *mut c_void,
        a2: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1,
        a3: *mut c_void,
        a4: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            let hr = real_factory::CreateSwapChainForCoreWindow(
                self.inner(),
                Device::unwrap_raw(a0),
                a1,
                a2,
                a3,
                a4,
            );
            self.wrap_swapchain(hr, a0, a4)
        }
    }

    unsafe fn CreateSwapChainForComposition(
        &self,
        a0: *mut c_void,
        a1: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1,
        a2: *mut c_void,
        a3: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            let hr =
                real_factory::CreateSwapChainForComposition(self.inner(), Device::unwrap_raw(a0), a1, a2, a3);
            self.wrap_swapchain(hr, a0, a3)
        }
    }

    unsafe fn EnumAdapters(&self, a0: u32, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe { self.wrap_adapter(real_factory::EnumAdapters(self.inner(), a0, a1), a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn EnumAdapters1(&self, a0: u32, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe { self.wrap_adapter(real_factory::EnumAdapters1(self.inner(), a0, a1), a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn EnumAdapterByLuid(&self, a0: LUID, a1: *const GUID, a2: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe { self.wrap_adapter(real_factory::EnumAdapterByLuid(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2), a2) }
    }

    unsafe fn EnumWarpAdapter(&self, a0: *const GUID, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe { self.wrap_adapter(real_factory::EnumWarpAdapter(self.inner(), a0, a1), a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn EnumAdapterByGpuPreference(
        &self,
        a0: u32,
        a1: DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE,
        a2: *const GUID,
        a3: *mut *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            self.wrap_adapter(
                real_factory::EnumAdapterByGpuPreference(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2, a3),
                a3,
            )
        }
    }
}

unsafe impl AdapterMethods for Adapter {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            answer_query(
                "adapter",
                self as *const _ as _,
                self.inner(),
                &ADAPTER_IIDS,
                iid,
                out,
                || {
                    self.AddRef();
                },
            )
        }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        self.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        let left = self.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
        if left == 0 {
            let parent = self.factory.get().copied();
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self as *const Adapter as *mut Adapter) });
            if let Some(p) = parent
                && p > 1
            {
                unsafe { (*(p as *const Factory)).Release() };
            }
        }
        left
    }

    /// The parent of an adapter is its factory: ours.
    unsafe fn GetParent(&self, a0: *const GUID, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        match self.factory() {
            Some(factory) => unsafe { factory.QueryInterface(a0, a1) },
            None => unsafe { real_adapter::GetParent(self.inner(), a0, a1) },
        }
    }
}

unsafe impl SwapChainMethods for SwapChain {
    fn inner(&self) -> *mut c_void {
        self.inner.as_raw()
    }

    unsafe fn QueryInterface(&self, iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        unsafe {
            answer_query(
                "swap chain",
                self as *const _ as _,
                self.inner(),
                &SWAPCHAIN_IIDS,
                iid,
                out,
                || {
                    self.AddRef();
                },
            )
        }
    }

    unsafe fn AddRef(&self) -> u32 {
        self.refs.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
    }

    unsafe fn Release(&self) -> u32 {
        let left = self.refs.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) - 1;
        if left == 0 {
            let (device, factory) = (self.device, self.factory);
            drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(self as *const SwapChain as *mut SwapChain) });
            unsafe {
                if !device.is_null() {
                    crate::vtables::device::DeviceMethods::Release(&*device);
                }
                if !factory.is_null() {
                    (*factory).Release();
                }
            }
        }
        left
    }

    unsafe fn GetDevice(&self, a0: *const GUID, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if self.device.is_null() {
            return unsafe { real_swapchain::GetDevice(self.inner(), a0, a1) };
        }
        unsafe { crate::vtables::device::DeviceMethods::QueryInterface(&*self.device, a0, a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn GetParent(&self, a0: *const GUID, a1: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
        if self.factory.is_null() {
            return unsafe { real_swapchain::GetParent(self.inner(), a0, a1) };
        }
        unsafe { (*self.factory).QueryInterface(a0, a1) }
    }

    unsafe fn Present(&self, a0: u32, a1: DXGI_PRESENT) -> HRESULT {
        self.present(a1, || unsafe { real_swapchain::Present(self.inner(), a0, a1) })
    }

    unsafe fn Present1(&self, a0: u32, a1: DXGI_PRESENT, a2: *const DXGI_PRESENT_PARAMETERS) -> HRESULT {
        self.present(a1, || unsafe {
            real_swapchain::Present1(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2)
        })
    }

    // A resize needs every reference to the back buffers released; a capture holds some, so it is given up first.
    unsafe fn ResizeBuffers(
        &self,
        a0: u32,
        a1: u32,
        a2: u32,
        a3: windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_FORMAT,
        a4: u32,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        capture::abandon("the game resized its swap chain");
        unsafe { real_swapchain::ResizeBuffers(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2, a3, a4) }
    }

    unsafe fn ResizeBuffers1(
        &self,
        a0: u32,
        a1: u32,
        a2: u32,
        a3: windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_FORMAT,
        a4: u32,
        a5: *const u32,
        a6: *const *mut c_void,
    ) -> HRESULT {
        capture::abandon("the game resized its swap chain");
        unsafe { real_swapchain::ResizeBuffers1(self.inner(), a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6) }
    }
}

impl SwapChain {
    /// A present: the frame boundary for the frame counter and for captures. `TEST` presents show nothing and are
    /// passed straight through.
    fn present(&self, flags: DXGI_PRESENT, real: impl FnOnce() -> HRESULT) -> HRESULT {
        if flags.contains(DXGI_PRESENT_TEST) || self.device.is_null() {
            return real();
        }
        let frame = count_frame();
        crate::d3d11::overrides::poll(frame);
        let immediate = unsafe { (*self.device).immediate() };
        capture::end_frame(immediate.real());
        let finished = capture::before_present();
        let hr = real();
        capture::after_present(finished, immediate.real());
        hr
    }
}

static FRAMES: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

/// The frame being made: 1 until the first present, then the number of the present that will end it (captures name
/// frames the same way).
pub fn frame() -> u64 {
    FRAMES.load(Ordering::Relaxed) + 1
}

/// Counts a frame and logs the frame rate every 600.
fn count_frame() -> u64 {
    static SINCE: Mutex<Option<Instant>> = Mutex::new(None);
    let frame = FRAMES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;
    if frame == 1 || frame.is_multiple_of(600) {
        let mut since = SINCE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        let now = Instant::now();
        if let Some(t) = *since {
            let secs = now.duration_since(t).as_secs_f64();
            log!("frame {frame}: {:.2} frames/s over the last 600", 600.0 / secs);
            log!("  {}", crate::cost::line());
        } else {
            log!("first present");
        }
        *since = Some(now);
    }
    frame
}

```

`locum/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! locum: captures everything a Direct3D 11 game draws in a frame, to look at, query, change and replay. The game loads
//! locum's d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll from its own folder; they forward to this DLL, which hands every call on to the
//! real runtime and watches it go by.
//!
//! The exports below are what `d3d11.dll` and `dxgi.dll` beside the game forward to. Each calls the same function
//! in the real DLL and wraps what comes back: the device and its contexts, the DXGI factory and its swap chains.

// The exports are Direct3D's own entry points: their safety contract is Microsoft's documentation of each.
#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]

mod com;
mod cost;
mod d3d11;
mod dump;
mod dxgi;
mod log;
mod settings;
mod system;
mod vtables;

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::Once;

use windows::Win32::Foundation::{E_NOTIMPL, E_POINTER, HMODULE};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::{D3D_DRIVER_TYPE, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D11::{D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_FLAG, ID3D11Device};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC;
use windows::core::{GUID, HRESULT, IUnknown, Interface};

use crate::d3d11::device::Device;
use crate::dxgi::{Adapter, Factory, SwapChain};
use crate::log::log;
use crate::system::{caller_of_caller, export, is_system_caller, module_of, module_path, system};
use crate::vtables::device::DeviceMethods;

/// The first call into locum logs who loaded it.
fn hello() {
    static ONCE: Once = Once::new();
    ONCE.call_once(|| {
        let exe = std::env::current_exe()
            .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        log!(
            "locum {} in {exe} (pid {})",
            env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
            std::process::id()
        );
    });
}

fn caller_name(address: *const c_void) -> String {
    module_of(address)
        .map(|m| module_path(m).display().to_string())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{address:p}"))
}

type CreateDeviceFn = unsafe extern "system" fn(
    *mut c_void,
    D3D_DRIVER_TYPE,
    HMODULE,
    D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_FLAG,
    *const D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    u32,
    u32,
    *mut *mut c_void,
    *mut D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT;

type CreateDeviceAndSwapChainFn = unsafe extern "system" fn(
    *mut c_void,
    D3D_DRIVER_TYPE,
    HMODULE,
    D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_FLAG,
    *const D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    u32,
    u32,
    *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC,
    *mut *mut c_void,
    *mut *mut c_void,
    *mut D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT;

/// Hands the wrapped device and its immediate context to the caller's out pointers (either may be null). Takes over
/// `device`'s reference.
unsafe fn give_device(device: *mut c_void, device_out: *mut *mut c_void, context_out: *mut *mut c_void) {
    let real = unsafe { ID3D11Device::from_raw(device) };
    match Device::wrap(real) {
        Ok(wrapper) => unsafe {
            let w = &*wrapper;
            if !context_out.is_null() {
                w.AddRef();
                *context_out = w.immediate_raw();
            }
            if device_out.is_null() {
                w.Release();
            } else {
                *device_out = wrapper.cast();
            }
        },
        Err(real) => unsafe {
            if !context_out.is_null() {
                *context_out = real
                    .GetImmediateContext()
                    .map_or(core::ptr::null_mut(), |c| c.into_raw());
            }
            if !device_out.is_null() {
                *device_out = real.into_raw();
            }
        },
    }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn D3D11CreateDevice(
    adapter: *mut c_void,
    driver_type: D3D_DRIVER_TYPE,
    software: HMODULE,
    flags: D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_FLAG,
    levels: *const D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    level_count: u32,
    sdk_version: u32,
    device_out: *mut *mut c_void,
    level_out: *mut D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    context_out: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    hello();
    let caller = caller_of_caller();
    let Some(real) = (unsafe { export::<CreateDeviceFn>(system().d3d11, c"D3D11CreateDevice") }) else {
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    let adapter = Adapter::unwrap_raw(adapter);
    if is_system_caller(caller) {
        // The system's and the driver's own devices (overlays, NVIDIA's camera) stay real, as their factories do.
        let hr = unsafe {
            real(
                adapter,
                driver_type,
                software,
                flags,
                levels,
                level_count,
                sdk_version,
                device_out,
                level_out,
                context_out,
            )
        };
        log!(
            "D3D11CreateDevice from {} flags {:#x} -> {hr:?} (real device)",
            caller_name(caller),
            flags.0
        );
        return hr;
    }
    let mut device = core::ptr::null_mut();
    let wants = !device_out.is_null() || !context_out.is_null();
    let hr = unsafe {
        real(
            adapter,
            driver_type,
            software,
            flags,
            levels,
            level_count,
            sdk_version,
            if wants { &mut device } else { core::ptr::null_mut() },
            level_out,
            core::ptr::null_mut(),
        )
    };
    log!(
        "D3D11CreateDevice from {} flags {:#x} -> {hr:?}",
        caller_name(caller),
        flags.0
    );
    if hr.is_ok() && !device.is_null() {
        unsafe { give_device(device, device_out, context_out) };
    }
    hr
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(
    adapter: *mut c_void,
    driver_type: D3D_DRIVER_TYPE,
    software: HMODULE,
    flags: D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_FLAG,
    levels: *const D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    level_count: u32,
    sdk_version: u32,
    swapchain_desc: *const DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC,
    swapchain_out: *mut *mut c_void,
    device_out: *mut *mut c_void,
    level_out: *mut D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL,
    context_out: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> HRESULT {
    hello();
    let caller = caller_of_caller();
    let Some(real) =
        (unsafe { export::<CreateDeviceAndSwapChainFn>(system().d3d11, c"D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain") })
    else {
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    let adapter = Adapter::unwrap_raw(adapter);
    let mut device = core::ptr::null_mut();
    let mut swapchain = core::ptr::null_mut();
    let hr = unsafe {
        real(
            adapter,
            driver_type,
            software,
            flags,
            levels,
            level_count,
            sdk_version,
            swapchain_desc,
            if swapchain_out.is_null() {
                core::ptr::null_mut()
            } else {
                &mut swapchain
            },
            &mut device,
            level_out,
            core::ptr::null_mut(),
        )
    };
    log!(
        "D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain from {} flags {:#x} -> {hr:?}",
        caller_name(caller),
        flags.0
    );
    if hr.is_err() || device.is_null() {
        return hr;
    }
    // The device first, with a reference of our own until the swap chain holds one.
    let mut ours = core::ptr::null_mut();
    unsafe { give_device(device, &mut ours, context_out) };
    if !swapchain.is_null() {
        let real = unsafe { IUnknown::from_raw(swapchain) };
        let wrapped = match SwapChain::wrap(real, Device::from_raw(ours), None) {
            Ok(w) => w.cast(),
            Err(real) => real.into_raw(),
        };
        unsafe { *swapchain_out = wrapped };
    }
    unsafe {
        if device_out.is_null() {
            match Device::from_raw(ours) {
                Some(d) => {
                    d.Release();
                }
                None => {
                    IUnknown::from_raw(ours);
                }
            }
        } else {
            *device_out = ours;
        }
    }
    hr
}

type CreateFactoryFn = unsafe extern "system" fn(*const GUID, *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT;
type CreateFactory2Fn = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *const GUID, *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT;

/// A factory the real DXGI made, wrapped unless Windows or the driver asked for it (the real d3d11.dll gets its
/// factory from `CreateDXGIFactory2`, and with our dxgi.dll loaded under that name the call can land here).
unsafe fn give_factory(name: &str, caller: *const c_void, hr: HRESULT, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
    let system_caller = is_system_caller(caller);
    log!(
        "{name} from {} -> {hr:?}{}",
        caller_name(caller),
        if system_caller { " (real factory)" } else { "" }
    );
    if hr.is_err() || out.is_null() || unsafe { (*out).is_null() } || system_caller {
        return hr;
    }
    let real = unsafe { IUnknown::from_raw(*out) };
    match Factory::wrap(real) {
        Ok(w) => unsafe { *out = w.cast() },
        Err(real) => unsafe { *out = real.into_raw() },
    }
    hr
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn CreateDXGIFactory(iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
    hello();
    let caller = caller_of_caller();
    if out.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    let Some(real) = (unsafe { export::<CreateFactoryFn>(system().dxgi, c"CreateDXGIFactory") }) else {
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };
    let hr = unsafe { real(iid, out) };
    unsafe { give_factory("CreateDXGIFactory", caller, hr, out) }
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn CreateDXGIFactory1(iid: *const GUID, out: *mut *mut c_void) -> HRESULT {
    hello();
    let caller = caller_of_caller();
    if out.is_null() {
        return E_POINTER;
    }
    let Some(real) = (unsafe { export::<CreateFactoryFn>(system().dxgi, c"CreateDXGIFactory1") }) else {
        return E_NOTIMPL;
    };

    unsafe { give_factory("CreateDXGIFactory1", caller, hr, out) }
}

// D3D11CoreCreateDevice and D3D11On12CreateDevice pass through untouched: a naked stub saves the argument registers,
// asks the resolver for the real function and jumps to it with the caller's stack and registers as they were, so the
// exact signature does not matter. The devices they make are not wrapped (logged when used).

/// Returned when the real DLL lacks the export: ignores its arguments and fails.
extern "system" fn not_implemented() -> HRESULT {
    E_NOTIMPL
}

extern "system" fn resolve_core_create_device() -> usize {
    hello();
    log!("D3D11CoreCreateDevice: passed through, device not wrapped");
    type F = unsafe extern "system" fn() -> HRESULT;
    unsafe { export::<F>(system().d3d11, c"D3D11CoreCreateDevice") }
        .map_or(not_implemented as *const () as usize, |f| f as usize)
}

extern "system" fn resolve_on12_create_device() -> usize {
    hello();
    log!("D3D11On12CreateDevice: passed through, device not wrapped");
    type F = unsafe extern "system" fn() -> HRESULT;
    unsafe { export::<F>(system().d3d11, c"D3D11On12CreateDevice") }
        .map_or(not_implemented as *const () as usize, |f| f as usize)
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
#[unsafe(naked)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn D3D11CoreCreateDevice() {
    core::arch::naked_asm!(
        "push rcx",
        "push rdx",
        "push r8",
        "push r9",
        "sub rsp, 40",
        "call {resolve}",
        "add rsp, 40",
        "pop r9",
        "pop r8",
        "pop rdx",
        "pop rcx",
        "jmp rax",
        resolve = sym resolve_core_create_device,
    )
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
#[unsafe(naked)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn D3D11On12CreateDevice() {
    core::arch::naked_asm!(
        "push rcx",
        "push rdx",
        "push r8",
        "push r9",
        "sub rsp, 40",
        "call {resolve}",
        "add rsp, 40",
        "pop r9",
        "pop r8",
        "pop rdx",
        "pop rcx",
        "jmp rax",
        resolve = sym resolve_on12_create_device,
    )
}
```

`locum/src/log.rs`:

```rs
//! locum's own log: `locum.log` in the folder named by `LOCUM_DIR`, or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\locum` without it. Never the
//! game's folder.

use std::fs::File;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::Instant;

struct Log {
    start: Instant,
    file: Mutex<Option<File>>,
}

fn log_state() -> &'static Log {
    static LOG: OnceLock<Log> = OnceLock::new();
    LOG.get_or_init(|| {
        let file = folder().and_then(|dir| {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).ok()?;
            File::create(dir.join("locum.log")).ok()
        });
        Log {
            start: Instant::now(),
            file: Mutex::new(file),
        }
    })
}

/// The folder locum writes to.
pub fn folder() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    match std::env::var_os("LOCUM_DIR") {
        Some(dir) if !dir.is_empty() => Some(PathBuf::from(dir)),
        _ => std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA").map(|d| PathBuf::from(d).join("locum")),
    }
}

/// Appends one line, prefixed with the seconds since the first line.
pub fn line(text: &str) {
    let log = log_state();
    let secs = log.start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    if let Ok(mut file) = log.file.lock()
        && let Some(file) = file.as_mut()
    {
        let _ = writeln!(file, "[{secs:10.3}] {text}");
        let _ = file.flush();
    }
}

/// `log!("format", args)`: a formatted [`line`].
macro_rules! log {
    ($($arg:tt)*) => { $crate::log::line(&format!($($arg)*)) };
}
pub(crate) use log;

```

`locum/src/settings.rs`:

```rs
//! Settings for the whole session, read once from `settings.txt` in locum's folder (one per line, `#` starts a
//! comment):
//!
//! - `uploads store` (default): every resource's initial data, and every update covering a whole subresource, is
//!   hashed and written to the blob store as it is created, so the game's own textures and meshes are there without a
//!   readback; `uploads hash` keeps the hashes only; `uploads off` neither.
//! - `blobs DIR`: the blob store (default `<locum's folder>/blobs`; the `LOCUM_BLOBS` variable overrides both).
//! - `dumper EXE`: `locum-cli.exe`, started to write a memory dump of the process when a capture asks for one.
//! - `dumps DIR`: where memory dumps go (default the capture's folder).

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

use locum_capture::blobs::Blobs;

use crate::log::{folder, log};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum Uploads {
    Store,
    Hash,
    Off,
}

pub struct Settings {
    pub uploads: Uploads,
    pub blobs: Blobs,
    pub dumper: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub dumps: Option<PathBuf>,
}

pub fn settings() -> &'static Settings {
    static SETTINGS: OnceLock<Settings> = OnceLock::new();
    SETTINGS.get_or_init(|| {
        let dir = folder().unwrap_or_default();
        let mut s = Settings {
            uploads: Uploads::Store,
            blobs: Blobs::new(dir.join("blobs")),
            dumper: None,
            dumps: None,
        };
        if let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("settings.txt")) {
            for (n, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
                let line = line.split('#').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
                let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once(char::is_whitespace) else {
                    if !line.is_empty() {
                        log!("settings.txt line {}: {line:?} has no value: ignored", n + 1);
                    }
                    continue;
                };
                let value = value.trim();
                match key {
                    "uploads" => match value {
                        "store" => s.uploads = Uploads::Store,
                        "hash" => s.uploads = Uploads::Hash,
                        "off" => s.uploads = Uploads::Off,
                        other => log!("settings.txt line {}: uploads {other:?}: ignored", n + 1),
                    },
                    "blobs" => s.blobs = Blobs::new(value),
                    "dumper" => s.dumper = Some(PathBuf::from(value)),
                    "dumps" => s.dumps = Some(PathBuf::from(value)),
                    other => log!("settings.txt line {}: unknown setting {other:?}: ignored", n + 1),
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os("LOCUM_BLOBS").filter(|d| !d.is_empty()) {
            s.blobs = Blobs::new(PathBuf::from(dir));
        }
        log!(
            "settings: uploads {:?}, blobs {}, dumper {}, dumps {}",
            s.uploads,
            s.blobs.root().display(),
            s.dumper
                .as_ref()
                .map_or("none".into(), |p| p.display().to_string()),
            s.dumps
                .as_ref()
                .map_or("capture folder".into(), |p| p.display().to_string())
        );
        s
    })
}

```

`locum/src/system.rs`:

```rs
//! The real `d3d11.dll` and `dxgi.dll`, loaded from the system folder by full path: our own `d3d11.dll` and
//! `dxgi.dll` are loaded under those names first, so a bare name gives back ours.

use core::ffi::c_void;
use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

use windows::Win32::Foundation::HMODULE;
use windows::Win32::System::Diagnostics::Debug::RtlCaptureStackBackTrace;
use windows::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::{
    GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS, GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, GetModuleFileNameW,
    GetModuleHandleExW, GetProcAddress, LOAD_LIBRARY_FLAGS, LoadLibraryExW,
};
use windows::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GetSystemDirectoryW;
use windows::core::{PCSTR, PCWSTR};

use crate::log::log;

pub struct System {
    pub folder: PathBuf,
    pub d3d11: HMODULE,
    pub dxgi: HMODULE,
}

// Module handles are process-wide and immutable once loaded.
unsafe impl Send for System {}
unsafe impl Sync for System {}

pub fn system() -> &'static System {
    static SYSTEM: OnceLock<System> = OnceLock::new();
    SYSTEM.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut buf = [0u16; 260];
        let n = unsafe { GetSystemDirectoryW(Some(&mut buf)) } as usize;
        let folder = PathBuf::from(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n]));
        // Windows gives a DLL asked for by name the module already loaded under that name. A game that loads one of
        // ours only later, by name (Unreal Engine 5 delay-loads d3d11.dll), would be given the real one loaded below,
        // and its device would never reach locum: so ours beside locum.dll go in first.
        if let Some(own) = module_of(system as *const c_void).map(module_path)
            && let Some(own) = own.parent()
        {
            for name in ["d3d11.dll", "dxgi.dll"] {
                if own.join(name).is_file() && !same_folder(own, &folder) {
                    load(own, name);
                }
            }
        }
        let d3d11 = load(&folder, "d3d11.dll").unwrap_or_default();
        let dxgi = load(&folder, "dxgi.dll").unwrap_or_default();
        System { folder, d3d11, dxgi }
    })
}

/// Whether two folders are the same (Windows paths compare without case).
fn same_folder(a: &std::path::Path, b: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    a.to_string_lossy().eq_ignore_ascii_case(&b.to_string_lossy())
}

/// Loads `name` from `folder` by full path.
fn load(folder: &std::path::Path, name: &str) -> Option<HMODULE> {
    let path = folder.join(name);
    let wide: Vec<u16> = path.as_os_str().encode_wide().chain(Some(0)).collect();
    match unsafe { LoadLibraryExW(PCWSTR(wide.as_ptr()), None, LOAD_LIBRARY_FLAGS(0)) } {
        Ok(h) => {
            log!("loaded {} at {:p}", path.display(), h.0);
            Some(h)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            log!("FAILED to load {}: {e}", path.display());
            None
        }
    }
}

/// Loads a DLL from the system folder (once; later calls give the same module).
pub fn load_system_dll(name: &'static str) -> Option<HMODULE> {
    static LOADED: std::sync::Mutex<Vec<(&'static str, usize)>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new());
    let mut loaded = LOADED.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if let Some(&(_, h)) = loaded.iter().find(|(n, _)| *n == name) {
        return Some(HMODULE(h as *mut c_void));
    }
    let h = load(&system().folder, name)?;
    loaded.push((name, h.0 as usize));
    Some(h)
}

/// The address of `name` in `module`, as the function type `F`.
///
/// # Safety
/// `F` must be the export's real function pointer type.
pub unsafe fn export<F: Copy>(module: HMODULE, name: &'static core::ffi::CStr) -> Option<F> {
    assert_eq!(size_of::<F>(), size_of::<usize>());
    let f = unsafe { GetProcAddress(module, PCSTR(name.as_ptr().cast())) }?;
    Some(unsafe { core::mem::transmute_copy(&f) })
}

/// The address the function calling this one will return to, i.e. its caller's code.
#[inline(never)]
pub fn caller_of_caller() -> *const c_void {
    let mut frames = [core::ptr::null_mut::<c_void>(); 1];
    // Frame 0 is this function, 1 the export that called it, 2 that export's caller.
    let n = unsafe { RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(2, &mut frames, None) };
    if n == 1 { frames[0] } else { core::ptr::null() }
}

/// The module containing `address` (no reference taken), if any.
pub fn module_of(address: *const c_void) -> Option<HMODULE> {
    let mut module = HMODULE::default();
    let flags = GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT;
    unsafe { GetModuleHandleExW(flags, PCWSTR(address.cast()), &mut module) }.ok()?;
    Some(module)
}

pub fn module_path(module: HMODULE) -> PathBuf {
    let mut buf = [0u16; 1024];
    let n = unsafe { GetModuleFileNameW(Some(module), &mut buf) } as usize;
    PathBuf::from(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n]))
}

/// Whether code at `address` belongs to Windows or the graphics driver rather than the game: such callers (the
/// real d3d11.dll asking dxgi for a factory, for one) get the real objects, unwrapped.
pub fn is_system_caller(address: *const c_void) -> bool {
    let Some(module) = module_of(address) else {
        return false;
    };
    let path = module_path(module).to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
    let system = system().folder.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
    path.starts_with(&system) || path.contains("\\driverstore\\")
}
```

```rs
    this: *mut c_void,
```

```rs
unsafe extern "system" fn QueryInterface<T: FactoryMethods>(
    this: *mut c_void,
    iid: *const windows::core::GUID,
    out: *mut *mut c_void,
) -> windows::core::HRESULT {
    unsafe { (*(this as *const T)).QueryInterface(iid, out) }
}
unsafe extern "system" fn AddRef<T: FactoryMethods>(this: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
    unsafe { (*(this as *const T)).AddRef() }
}
unsafe extern "system" fn Release<T: FactoryMethods>(this: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
    unsafe { (*(this as *const T)).Release() }
}
unsafe extern "system" fn SetPrivateData<T: FactoryMethods>(
    this: *mut c_void,
    a0: *const windows::core::GUID,
    a1: u32,
    a2: *const core::ffi::c_void,
) -> windows::core::HRESULT {
```

`shims/forward.rs`:

```rs
// Shared by the shims' build scripts (`include!`d): makes the DLL's export table one of forwarders to locum.dll.
//
// The forwarders are written as a module-definition file and turned into an export file (`.exp`) by `lib.exe`,
// which the link then takes as an input. A forwarder given straight to the linker (`/DEF` with `name=locum.name`,
// or `/EXPORT:name=locum.name`) fails with LNK2001 "unresolved external symbol name"; the `.exp` route works.

fn forward(dll: &str, exports: &[(&str, u32)]) {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OUT_DIR").expect("OUT_DIR"));
    let def = out.join(format!("{dll}.def"));
    let mut text = format!("LIBRARY {dll}\nEXPORTS\n");
    for (name, ordinal) in exports {
        text.push_str(&format!("    {name}=locum.{name} @{ordinal}\n"));
    }
    std::fs::write(&def, text).expect("write the .def");
    let target = std::env::var("TARGET").expect("TARGET");
    let mut lib = find_msvc_tools::find(&target, "lib.exe").expect("lib.exe (MSVC build tools)");
    let status = lib
        .arg("/nologo")
        .arg(format!("/def:{}", def.display()))
        .arg(format!("/out:{}", out.join(format!("{dll}-forward.lib")).display()))
        .arg("/machine:x64")
        .status()
        .expect("run lib.exe");
    assert!(status.success(), "lib.exe failed");
    println!("cargo:rustc-cdylib-link-arg={}", out.join(format!("{dll}-forward.exp")).display());
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=../forward.rs");
}
```
