```ts
  98: "BC7_UNORM", 99: "BC7_UNORM_SRGB", 100: "AYUV", 101: "Y410", 102: "Y416", 103: "NV12", 104: "P010",
  105: "P016", 106: "420_OPAQUE", 107: "YUY2", 108: "Y210", 109: "Y216", 110: "NV11", 111: "AI44", 112: "IA44",
  113: "P8", 114: "A8P8", 115: "B4G4R4A4_UNORM", 130: "P208", 131: "V208", 132: "V408", 189: "A4B4G4R4_UNORM",
  190: "A4R4G4B4_UNORM",
};

export function formatName(format: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (format == null) return "-";
  return NAMES[format] ?? `UNKNOWN_FORMAT(${format})`;
}

export function formatNames(): Record<number, string> {
  return NAMES;
}

export interface Layout {
  blockWidth: number;
  blockHeight: number;
  blockBytes: number;
}

const plainLayout = (bytes: number): Layout => ({ blockWidth: 1, blockHeight: 1, blockBytes: bytes });
const blocks = (w: number, h: number, bytes: number): Layout => ({ blockWidth: w, blockHeight: h, blockBytes: bytes });

/** The layout of a format (capture/src/format.rs `layout`), or null when it is not one plane of blocks. */
export function layout(f: number): Layout | null {
  if (f >= 1 && f <= 4) return plainLayout(16);
  if (f >= 5 && f <= 8) return plainLayout(12);
  if (f >= 9 && f <= 22) return plainLayout(8);
  if (f >= 23 && f <= 47) return plainLayout(4);
  if (f >= 48 && f <= 59) return plainLayout(2);
  if (f >= 60 && f <= 65) return plainLayout(1);
  if (f === 66) return blocks(8, 1, 1);
  if (f === 67) return plainLayout(4);
  if (f === 68 || f === 69) return blocks(2, 1, 4);
  if ((f >= 70 && f <= 72) || (f >= 79 && f <= 81)) return blocks(4, 4, 8);
  if ((f >= 73 && f <= 78) || (f >= 82 && f <= 84) || (f >= 94 && f <= 99)) return blocks(4, 4, 16);
  if ([85, 86, 115, 189, 190].includes(f)) return plainLayout(2);
  if ((f >= 87 && f <= 93) || f === 100 || f === 101) return plainLayout(4);
  if (f === 102) return plainLayout(8);
  if (f === 107) return blocks(2, 1, 4);
  if (f === 108 || f === 109) return blocks(2, 1, 8);
  if (f >= 111 && f <= 113) return plainLayout(1);
  if (f === 114) return plainLayout(2);
  return null;
}

export function isCompressed(f: number): boolean {
  return (f >= 70 && f <= 84) || (f >= 94 && f <= 99);
}

/** Typeless and depth formats as the plain format of the same bits (capture/src/format.rs `readable`). */
export function readable(f: number): number {
  const map: Record<number, number> = {
    1: 2, 5: 6, 9: 10, 15: 16, 19: 21, 20: 21, 23: 24, 27: 28, 33: 34, 39: 41, 40: 41, 44: 46, 45: 46, 48: 49,
    53: 56, 55: 56, 60: 61, 70: 71, 73: 74, 76: 77, 79: 80, 82: 83, 90: 87, 92: 88, 94: 95, 97: 98,
  };
  return map[f] ?? f;
}

/** One subresource in the canonical layout (capture/src/layout.rs `Sub`). */
export interface Sub {
  index: number;
  mip: number;
  slice: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  depth: number;
  rowBytes: number;
  rows: number;
  offset: number;
  size: number;
}

export function textureSubs(format: number, width: number, height: number, depth: number, mips: number,
  array: number): Sub[] | null {
  const l = layout(format);
  if (!l) return null;
  const out: Sub[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  mips = Math.max(mips, 1);
  for (let slice = 0; slice < Math.max(array, 1); slice++) {
    for (let mip = 0; mip < mips; mip++) {
      const w = Math.max(width >> mip, 1), h = Math.max(height >> mip, 1), d = Math.max(depth >> mip, 1);
      const rowBytes = Math.ceil(w / l.blockWidth) * l.blockBytes, rows = Math.ceil(h / l.blockHeight);
      const size = rowBytes * rows * d;
      out.push({ index: mip + slice * mips, mip, slice, width: w, height: h, depth: d, rowBytes, rows, offset, size });
      offset += size;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function f16(bits: number): number {
  const sign = bits & 0x8000 ? -1 : 1;
  const exp = (bits >> 10) & 31, mant = bits & 0x3ff;
  if (exp === 0) return sign * mant * 2 ** -24;
  if (exp === 31) return mant === 0 ? sign * Infinity : NaN;
  return sign * (1 + mant / 1024) * 2 ** (exp - 15);
}

function smallFloat(bits: number, mantissa: number): number {
  const exp = (bits >>> mantissa) & 31;
  const mant = (bits & ((1 << mantissa) - 1)) / (1 << mantissa);
  if (exp === 0) return mant * 2 ** -14;
  if (exp === 31) return mant === 0 ? Infinity : NaN;
  return (1 + mant) * 2 ** (exp - 15);
}

type Kind = "float" | "unorm" | "snorm" | "uint" | "sint";

function plain(f: number): [number, number, Kind] | null {
  const t: Record<number, [number, number, Kind]> = {
    2: [4, 32, "float"], 3: [4, 32, "uint"], 4: [4, 32, "sint"], 6: [3, 32, "float"], 7: [3, 32, "uint"],
    8: [3, 32, "sint"], 10: [4, 16, "float"], 11: [4, 16, "unorm"], 12: [4, 16, "uint"], 13: [4, 16, "snorm"],
    14: [4, 16, "sint"], 16: [2, 32, "float"], 17: [2, 32, "uint"], 18: [2, 32, "sint"], 28: [4, 8, "unorm"],
    29: [4, 8, "unorm"], 30: [4, 8, "uint"], 31: [4, 8, "snorm"], 32: [4, 8, "sint"], 34: [2, 16, "float"],
    35: [2, 16, "unorm"], 36: [2, 16, "uint"], 37: [2, 16, "snorm"], 38: [2, 16, "sint"], 41: [1, 32, "float"],
    42: [1, 32, "uint"], 43: [1, 32, "sint"], 49: [2, 8, "unorm"], 50: [2, 8, "uint"], 51: [2, 8, "snorm"],
    52: [2, 8, "sint"], 54: [1, 16, "float"], 56: [1, 16, "unorm"], 57: [1, 16, "uint"], 58: [1, 16, "snorm"],
    59: [1, 16, "sint"], 61: [1, 8, "unorm"], 62: [1, 8, "uint"], 63: [1, 8, "snorm"], 64: [1, 8, "sint"],
  };
  return t[f] ?? null;
}

function channel(v: DataView, at: number, bits: number, kind: Kind): number {
  if (bits === 32) {
    if (kind === "float") return v.getFloat32(at, true);
    if (kind === "uint") return v.getUint32(at, true);
    return v.getInt32(at, true);
  }
  if (bits === 16) {
    const u = v.getUint16(at, true);
    switch (kind) {
      case "float": return f16(u);
      case "unorm": return u / 65535;
      case "snorm": return Math.max(v.getInt16(at, true) / 32767, -1);
      case "uint": return u;
      case "sint": return v.getInt16(at, true);
    }
  }
  const u = v.getUint8(at);
  switch (kind) {
    case "unorm": case "float": return u / 255;
    case "snorm": return Math.max(v.getInt8(at) / 127, -1);
    case "uint": return u;
    case "sint": return v.getInt8(at);
  }
}

export interface Texel {
  /** The channel names and their values as the format reads them. */
  channels: [string, number][];
  /** The texel's (or for block-compressed formats, its block's) bytes, hex. */
  raw: string;
  /** Integer formats hold integers; the rest are normalized or float. */
  kind: string;
  note?: string;
}

const RGBA = ["r", "g", "b", "a"];

/**
 * Reads the texel at (x, y) of a subresource whose bytes are `bytes` (canonical layout: tight rows of blocks), in
 * `format`. Block-compressed formats return the block's bytes only; their decoded value comes from the picture.
 */
export function readTexel(format: number, width: number, bytes: Uint8Array, x: number, y: number): Texel | null {
  const f = readable(format);
  const l = layout(f);
  if (!l) return null;
  const rowBytes = Math.ceil(width / l.blockWidth) * l.blockBytes;
  const at = Math.floor(y / l.blockHeight) * rowBytes + Math.floor(x / l.blockWidth) * l.blockBytes;
  if (at + l.blockBytes > bytes.length) return null;
  const raw = [...bytes.subarray(at, at + l.blockBytes)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ");
  const v = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + at, l.blockBytes);
  if (isCompressed(f)) return { channels: [], raw, kind: "block", note: `${l.blockWidth}x${l.blockHeight} block` };
  const p = plain(f);
  if (p) {
    const [n, bits, kind] = p;
    const channels: [string, number][] = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) channels.push([RGBA[c]!, channel(v, (c * bits) / 8, bits, kind)]);
    return { channels, raw, kind };
  }
  const word = l.blockBytes >= 4 ? v.getUint32(0, true) : 0;
  const half = l.blockBytes >= 2 ? v.getUint16(0, true) : 0;
  switch (f) {
    case 24: case 25: {
      const c = [word & 1023, (word >>> 10) & 1023, (word >>> 20) & 1023, word >>> 30];
      const scale = f === 24 ? [1023, 1023, 1023, 3] : [1, 1, 1, 1];
      return { channels: c.map((x, i) => [RGBA[i]!, x / scale[i]!]), raw, kind: f === 24 ? "unorm" : "uint" };
    }
    case 26:
      return {
        channels: [["r", smallFloat(word & 0x7ff, 6)], ["g", smallFloat((word >>> 11) & 0x7ff, 6)],
          ["b", smallFloat(word >>> 22, 5)]], raw, kind: "float",
      };
    case 21: case 22:
      return {
        channels: [["depth", v.getFloat32(0, true)], ["stencil", v.getUint8(4)]], raw, kind: "float",
      };
    case 46: case 47:
      return { channels: [["depth", (word & 0xffffff) / 16777215], ["stencil", word >>> 24]], raw, kind: "unorm" };
    case 65:
      return { channels: [["a", v.getUint8(0) / 255]], raw, kind: "unorm" };
    case 67: {
      const scale = 2 ** ((word >>> 27) - 15 - 9);
      return {
        channels: [["r", (word & 511) * scale], ["g", ((word >>> 9) & 511) * scale], ["b", ((word >>> 18) & 511) * scale]],
        raw, kind: "float",
      };
    }
    case 85:
      return { channels: [["r", (half >> 11) / 31], ["g", ((half >> 5) & 63) / 63], ["b", (half & 31) / 31]], raw, kind: "unorm" };
    case 86:
      return {
        channels: [["r", ((half >> 10) & 31) / 31], ["g", ((half >> 5) & 31) / 31], ["b", (half & 31) / 31], ["a", half >> 15]],
        raw, kind: "unorm",
      };
    case 115:
      return { channels: [8, 4, 0, 12].map((s, i) => [RGBA[i]!, ((half >> s) & 15) / 15]), raw, kind: "unorm" };
    case 87: case 88: case 91: case 93: {
      const [b, g, r, a] = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(k => v.getUint8(k) / 255);
      const ch: [string, number][] = [["r", r!], ["g", g!], ["b", b!]];
      if (f === 87 || f === 91) ch.push(["a", a!]);
      return { channels: ch, raw, kind: "unorm" };
    }
  }
  return { channels: [], raw, kind: "raw", note: `${formatName(f)} is shown as bytes` };
}

```

`viewer/server/main.ts`:

```ts
// The locum viewer's server: a JSON API over captures (capture.db read-only, plus the blob store) and the built
// front end. Pictures are decoded by locum-cli and cached under viewer/.cache.
//
//   bun run viewer [--db PATH] [--blobs DIR] [--dir DIR] [--port N] [--host H] [--cli PATH]
//   bun run dev    (the same, with vite serving the front end with hot reload)

import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, renameSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { Capture, listCaptures, summarize, type Source } from "./capture";
import { Cli, cacheRoot, findCli } from "./cli";
import { CHANNELS, decodePng, encodePng, selectChannels, type Channels } from "./png";
import { formatNames } from "./format";

const { values: args } = parseArgs({
  args: Bun.argv.slice(2),
  options: {
    db: { type: "string" },
    blobs: { type: "string" },
    dir: { type: "string" },
    port: { type: "string" },
    host: { type: "string" },
    cli: { type: "string" },
    dev: { type: "boolean" },
    help: { type: "boolean", short: "h" },
  },
});

if (args.help) {
  console.log(`locum viewer: browse a locum capture in the browser

  bun run viewer [--db PATH] [options]

  --db PATH     a capture.db (or a folder holding one) to open at start
  --blobs DIR   the blob store (default: LOCUM_BLOBS, else the one the capture names)
  --dir DIR     the folder listed for captures (default: the --db's captures folder, LOCUM_DIR, or %LOCALAPPDATA%/locum)
  --port N      default 5170 (the next free one if taken)
  --host H      default 127.0.0.1; the API reads any capture.db the server can see, so keep it local
  --cli PATH    locum-cli (default: LOCUM_CLI, PATH, ../target/release)`);
  process.exit(0);
}

const viewerRoot = resolve(import.meta.dir, "..");
const dist = join(viewerRoot, "dist");
const cli = new Cli(findCli(args.cli));
const registryPath = join(cacheRoot, "captures.json");

interface Entry {
  path: string;
  blobs: string | null;
  label: string;
  uploaded?: boolean;
}

mkdirSync(cacheRoot, { recursive: true });
let registry: Record<string, Entry> = {};
try {
  registry = JSON.parse(readFileSync(registryPath, "utf8"));
} catch {}
const open = new Map<string, Capture>();

function saveRegistry() {
  writeFileSync(registryPath, JSON.stringify(registry, null, 1));
}

/** The capture.db a path names: the file, or the capture.db in the folder. */
function dbPath(given: string): string {
  const p = resolve(given);
  if (existsSync(p) && statSync(p).isFile()) return p;
  if (existsSync(join(p, "capture.db"))) return join(p, "capture.db");
  throw new HttpError(404, `${given} is not a capture.db or a folder holding one`);
}

/** The blob store for a capture: given, LOCUM_BLOBS, the one it names, or `blobs` beside its captures folder. */
function blobRoot(path: string, given: string | null): string {
  if (given) return resolve(given);
  if (args.blobs) return resolve(args.blobs);
  if (process.env.LOCUM_BLOBS) return resolve(process.env.LOCUM_BLOBS);
  let named: string | null = null;
  try {
    const db = new Database(path, { readonly: true });
    named = (db.query("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'blobs'").get() as any)?.value ?? null;
    db.close();
  } catch {}
  if (named && existsSync(named)) return resolve(named);
  const beside = resolve(dirname(path), "../../blobs");
  if (existsSync(beside)) return beside;
  return named ? resolve(named) : beside;
}

function idFor(text: string): string {
  return Bun.hash(text.toLowerCase()).toString(16).padStart(16, "0").slice(0, 12);
}

function openPath(given: string, blobs: string | null): Capture {
  const path = dbPath(given);
  const id = idFor(path);
  const existing = open.get(id);
  const root = blobRoot(path, blobs);
  if (existing && existing.blobs === root) return existing;
  existing?.close();
  return register(id, { path, blobs: blobs ? resolve(blobs) : null, label: labelOf(path) });
}

function labelOf(path: string): string {
  const s = summarize(path) as any;
  return s.name ?? path.split(/[\\/]/).slice(-2, -1)[0] ?? "capture";
}

function register(id: string, entry: Entry): Capture {
  const c = new Capture(id, entry.path, blobRoot(entry.path, entry.blobs), entry.label);
  open.set(id, c);
  registry[id] = entry;
  saveRegistry();
  return c;
}

function capture(id: string): Capture {
  let c = open.get(id);
  if (c) return c;
  const entry = registry[id];
  if (!entry || !existsSync(entry.path)) throw new HttpError(404, `capture ${id} is not open (open it again)`);
  c = new Capture(id, entry.path, blobRoot(entry.path, entry.blobs), entry.label);
  open.set(id, c);
  return c;
}

/** Stores a capture.db sent by the browser (drag and drop, or the File System Access API) and opens it. */
async function upload(req: Request, name: string, blobs: string | null): Promise<Capture> {
  if (!req.body) throw new HttpError(400, "no file");
  const dir = join(cacheRoot, "uploads");
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const tmp = join(dir, `.upload-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}.part`);
  const hasher = new Bun.CryptoHasher("sha256");
  const sink = Bun.file(tmp).writer();
  let size = 0;
  try {
    for await (const chunk of req.body as any as AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>) {
      hasher.update(chunk);
      sink.write(chunk);
      size += chunk.length;
    }
    await sink.end();
  } catch (e) {
    rmSync(tmp, { force: true });
    throw e;
  }
  const hash = hasher.digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
  const folder = join(dir, hash);
  const path = join(folder, "capture.db");
  mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true });
  if (existsSync(path)) rmSync(tmp, { force: true });
  else renameSync(tmp, path);
  const header = new Uint8Array(await Bun.file(path).slice(0, 16).arrayBuffer());
  if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "SQLite format 3\0") throw new HttpError(400, `${name} is not an SQLite file`);
  const id = `u${hash.slice(0, 11)}`;
  open.get(id)?.close();
  open.delete(id);
  const label = (summarize(path) as any).name ?? name.replace(/\.db$/, "");
  console.log(`opened ${name} from the browser (${(size / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB) as ${id}`);
  return register(id, { path, blobs, label, uploaded: true });
}

class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
  }
}

function jsonResponse(body: unknown, req: Request, status = 200): Response {
  const text = JSON.stringify(body);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", "cache-control": "no-store" };
  if (text.length > 64 * 1024 && (req.headers.get("accept-encoding") ?? "").includes("gzip")) {
    headers["content-encoding"] = "gzip";
    return new Response(Bun.gzipSync(text, { level: 4 }), { status, headers });
  }
  return new Response(text, { status, headers });
}

/** `target:DRAW:NAME`, `resource:ID:SUB[:Z]` or `upload:ID:SUB[:Z]`. */
function parseSource(text: string | null): Source {
  const parts = (text ?? "").split(":");
  const n = (i: number) => {
    const v = Number(parts[i] ?? 0);
    if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 0) throw new HttpError(400, `bad source ${text}`);
    return v;
  };
  if (parts[0] === "target" && /^(rt[0-7]|depth)$/.test(parts[2] ?? "")) return { kind: "target", draw: n(1), name: parts[2]! };
  if (parts[0] === "resource" || parts[0] === "upload") return { kind: parts[0], id: n(1), sub: n(2), z: n(3) };
  throw new HttpError(400, `bad source ${text}`);
}

/** Where outputs of locum-cli for a capture are kept: a new capture file or a rebuilt locum-cli starts afresh. */
function cacheDir(c: Capture): string {
  const st = statSync(c.path);
  const exe = cli.exe && existsSync(cli.exe) ? statSync(cli.exe) : null;
  const tool = exe ? `${Math.round(exe.mtimeMs).toString(36)}${exe.size.toString(36)}` : "none";
  return join(cacheRoot, "img", `${c.id}-${Math.round(st.mtimeMs)}-${st.size}-${tool}`);
}

const RANGE = /^(auto|clamp|tonemap|-?[0-9.eE+-]+:-?[0-9.eE+-]+)$/;

/** A PNG of a source, made by locum-cli, then reduced to `channels` (see selectChannels). */
async function image(c: Capture, src: Source, range: string, channels: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!RANGE.test(range)) throw new HttpError(400, `bad range ${range}`);
  if (!(CHANNELS as readonly string[]).includes(channels)) throw new HttpError(400, `bad channels ${channels}`);
  const tag = range.replace(/[^a-z0-9.+-]/gi, "_");
  const common = ["--blobs", c.blobs, "--range", range];
  let full: string;
  if (src.kind === "target") {
    const out = join(cacheDir(c), `target-${src.draw}-${src.name}-${tag}.png`);
    full = await cli.cached(out, tmp => cli.run(["target", c.path, String(src.draw), src.name, "-o", tmp, ...common]).then(() => {}));
  } else {
    const out = join(cacheDir(c), `${src.kind}-${src.id}-${src.sub}-${src.z ?? 0}-${tag}.png`);
    full = await cli.cached(out, tmp => cli.run(["export", c.path, String(src.id), "-o", tmp, "--sub", String(src.sub),
      "--z", String(src.z ?? 0), ...(src.kind === "upload" ? ["--upload"] : []), ...common]).then(() => {}));
  }
  if (channels === "rgba") return full;
  return cli.cached(full.replace(/\.png$/, `-${channels}.png`), async tmp => {
    const p = decodePng(new Uint8Array(await Bun.file(full).arrayBuffer()));
    await Bun.write(tmp, encodePng(p.width, p.height, selectChannels(p.rgba, channels as Channels)));
  });
}

const HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8,64}$/i;

async function api(req: Request, url: URL): Promise<Response> {
  const path = url.pathname.slice("/api/".length).split("/").map(decodeURIComponent);
  const q = url.searchParams;
  const json = (body: unknown) => jsonResponse(body, req);

  if (path[0] === "status") {
    return json({
      cli: cli.exe,
      defaultDir: defaultDir(),
      initial: initial?.id ?? null,
      recent: Object.entries(registry).map(([id, e]) => ({ id, ...e })).filter(e => existsSync(e.path)),
      formats: formatNames(),
    });
  }
  if (path[0] === "captures") {
    const dir = resolve(q.get("dir") || defaultDir());
    const list = await listCaptures(dir);
    return json({ dir, captures: list.map(l => ({ ...l, ...summarize(l.path) })) });
  }
  if (path[0] === "open" && req.method === "POST") {
    const body = (await req.json()) as { path?: string; blobs?: string };
    if (!body.path) throw new HttpError(400, "no path");
    return json(openPath(body.path, body.blobs || null).info());
  }
  if (path[0] === "upload" && req.method === "POST") {
    const c = await upload(req, q.get("name") ?? "capture.db", q.get("blobs") || null);
    return json(c.info());
  }
  if (path[0] !== "c" || !path[1]) throw new HttpError(404, "no such API");

  const c = capture(path[1]);
  const what = path[2];
  const n = (i: number) => {
    const v = Number(path[i]);
    if (!Number.isInteger(v)) throw new HttpError(400, `bad number ${path[i]}`);
    return v;
  };
  const found = <T>(v: T | null, what: string): T => {
    if (v == null) throw new HttpError(404, `no ${what}`);
    return v;
  };

  switch (what) {
    case "info":
      return json(c.info());
    case "timeline":
      return json(c.timeline());
    case "event":
      return json(found(c.event(n(3)), `event ${path[3]}`));
    case "draw":
      return json(found(c.draw(n(3)), `draw ${path[3]}`));
    case "resources":
      return json(c.resources());
    case "resource":
      return json(found(c.resource(n(3)), `resource ${path[3]}`));
    case "shaders":
      return json(c.shaders());
    case "shader": {
      const hash = path[3] ?? "";
      if (!HEX.test(hash)) throw new HttpError(400, "bad hash");
      if (path[4] === "disasm") {
        const out = join(cacheDir(c), `shader-${hash}.txt`);
        return new Response(await cli.cachedText(out, ["shader", c.path, hash, "-d", "--blobs", c.blobs]),
          { headers: { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" } });
      }
      return json(found(c.shader(hash), `shader ${hash}`));
    }
    case "stack":
      return json(c.stack(n(3)));
    case "blob": {
      const key = path[3] ?? "";
      if (!HEX.test(key)) throw new HttpError(400, "bad key");
      if (!c.hasBlob(key)) throw new HttpError(404, `blob ${key} is not in ${c.blobs}`);
      const offset = Number(q.get("offset") ?? 0), size = Math.min(Number(q.get("size") ?? 65536), 16 << 20);
      return new Response(c.readBlob(key, offset, size), { headers: { "content-type": "application/octet-stream",
        "x-blob-size": String(statSync(c.blobPath(key)).size) } });
    }
    case "image": {
      const file = await image(c, parseSource(q.get("src")), q.get("range") || "auto", q.get("channels") || "rgb");
      return new Response(Bun.file(file), { headers: { "content-type": "image/png", "cache-control": "max-age=3600" } });
    }
    case "texel": {
      const x = Number(q.get("x")), y = Number(q.get("y"));
      return json(c.texel(parseSource(q.get("src")), x, y));
    }
    case "diff": {
      const d = c.diff(parseSource(q.get("a")), parseSource(q.get("b")));
      if (typeof d === "string") throw new HttpError(422, d);
      return new Response(encodePng(d.width, d.height, d.rgba), { headers: { "content-type": "image/png",
        "x-changed": String(d.changed), "x-total": String(d.total), "access-control-expose-headers": "x-changed, x-total" } });
    }
    case "sql": {
      const body = (await req.json()) as { sql?: string; limit?: number };
      try {
        return json(c.sql(body.sql ?? "", Math.min(body.limit ?? 2000, 100000)));
      } catch (e) {
        throw new HttpError(400, String((e as Error).message ?? e));
      }
    }
    case "verify": {
      const out = join(cacheDir(c), "verify.txt");
      if (req.method !== "POST") {
        return json({ text: existsSync(out) ? readFileSync(out, "utf8") : null });
      }
      if (q.get("again")) rmSync(out, { force: true });
      // Verify's report matters most when targets differ, which it reports with a failing exit code.
      await cli.cached(out, async tmp => {
        const r = await cli.runAll(["verify", c.path, "--blobs", c.blobs], 30 * 60_000);
        await Bun.write(tmp, `${r.stdout}${r.stderr ? `
${r.stderr}` : ""}
(locum-cli verify exited with ${r.code})
`);
      });
      return json({ text: readFileSync(out, "utf8") });
    }
  }
  throw new HttpError(404, "no such API");
}

function defaultDir(): string {
  if (args.dir) return resolve(args.dir);
  if (args.db) return resolve(dirname(dbPath(args.db)), "..");
  if (process.env.LOCUM_DIR) return resolve(process.env.LOCUM_DIR);
  return join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA ?? join(process.env.HOME ?? ".", ".local/share"), "locum");
}

async function serveStatic(url: URL): Promise<Response> {
  if (!existsSync(join(dist, "index.html"))) {
    return new Response("The front end is not built: run `bun run viewer` (it builds first) or `bun run dev`.", { status: 503 });
  }
  const rel = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname).replace(/^\/+/, "");
  const file = resolve(dist, rel || "index.html");
  if (file.startsWith(dist) && existsSync(file) && statSync(file).isFile()) {
    return new Response(Bun.file(file), {
      headers: rel.startsWith("assets/") ? { "cache-control": "max-age=31536000, immutable" } : {},
    });
  }
  return new Response(Bun.file(join(dist, "index.html")));
}

let initial: Capture | null = null;
if (args.db) {
  initial = openPath(args.db, args.blobs ?? null);
  const info = initial.info();
  console.log(`capture ${info.label}: ${info.timeline.events} events, ${info.timeline.draws} draws, blobs ${info.blobs}`);
  for (const m of info.missing) console.log(`  missing: ${m}`);
}
if (!cli.exe) console.warn("locum-cli not found: pictures and disassembly are off (pass --cli or set LOCUM_CLI)");

const host = args.host ?? "127.0.0.1";
const wanted = Number(args.port ?? (args.dev ? 5171 : 5170));

function serve(port: number) {
  return Bun.serve({
    hostname: host,
    port,
    idleTimeout: 255,
    async fetch(req) {
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) return serveStatic(url);
      try {
        return await api(req, url);
      } catch (e) {
        const status = e instanceof HttpError ? e.status : 500;
        if (status === 500) console.error(e);
        return jsonResponse({ error: String((e as Error).message ?? e) }, req, status);
      }
    },
  });
}

let server: ReturnType<typeof serve> | null = null;
for (let port = wanted; port < wanted + 20 && !server; port++) {
  try {
    server = serve(port);
  } catch (e) {
    if (!String(e).includes("EADDRINUSE") && !String(e).toLowerCase().includes("in use")) throw e;
  }
}
if (!server) throw new Error(`no free port from ${wanted}`);
const apiUrl = `http://${host === "0.0.0.0" ? "localhost" : host}:${server.port}`;
const hash = initial ? `#/c/${initial.id}` : "";

if (args.dev) {
  const vite = Bun.spawn([process.execPath, "x", "vite", "--port", "5173", "--strictPort", "false"], {
    cwd: viewerRoot, env: { ...process.env, LOCUM_VIEWER_API: apiUrl }, stdout: "inherit", stderr: "inherit",
  });
  process.on("SIGINT", () => { vite.kill(); process.exit(0); });
  console.log(`API on ${apiUrl}; vite prints the page's URL (open it with ${hash || "#/"})`);
} else {
  console.log(`locum viewer: ${apiUrl}/${hash}`);
}
```

`viewer/server/png.ts`:

```ts
// A minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGBA, no filtering) for pictures the viewer makes itself, like target diffs, and a
// reader for the 8-bit pictures locum-cli writes, so a picture can be shown one channel at a time or without alpha.

import { deflateSync, inflateSync } from "node:zlib";

const CRC = new Uint32Array(256).map((_, n) => {
  let c = n;
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
  return c >>> 0;
});

function crc32(parts: Uint8Array[]): number {
  let c = 0xffffffff;
  for (const p of parts) for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) c = CRC[(c ^ p[i]!) & 0xff]! ^ (c >>> 8);
  return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function chunk(type: string, data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(12 + data.length);
  const v = new DataView(out.buffer);
  v.setUint32(0, data.length);
  const t = new TextEncoder().encode(type);
  out.set(t, 4);
  out.set(data, 8);
  v.setUint32(8 + data.length, crc32([t, data]));
  return out;
}

export function encodePng(width: number, height: number, rgba: Uint8Array): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const raw = new Uint8Array((width * 4 + 1) * height);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) raw.set(rgba.subarray(y * width * 4, (y + 1) * width * 4), y * (width * 4 + 1) + 1);
  const ihdr = new Uint8Array(13);
  const v = new DataView(ihdr.buffer);
  v.setUint32(0, width);
  v.setUint32(4, height);
  ihdr.set([8, 6, 0, 0, 0], 8);
  const parts = [
    new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]),
    chunk("IHDR", ihdr),
    chunk("IDAT", new Uint8Array(deflateSync(raw, { level: 3 }))),
    chunk("IEND", new Uint8Array()),
  ];
  const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0));
  let at = 0;
  for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, at); at += p.length; }
  return out;
}

/** The pixels of an 8-bit, non-interlaced greyscale, grey+alpha, RGB or RGBA PNG, as RGBA. */
export function decodePng(png: Uint8Array): { width: number; height: number; rgba: Uint8Array } {
  const v = new DataView(png.buffer, png.byteOffset, png.byteLength);
  if (v.getUint32(0) !== 0x89504e47) throw new Error("not a PNG");
  let width = 0, height = 0, type = 0;
  const idat: Uint8Array[] = [];
  for (let at = 8; at + 8 <= png.length;) {
    const len = v.getUint32(at);
    const t = String.fromCharCode(...png.subarray(at + 4, at + 8));
    const data = png.subarray(at + 8, at + 8 + len);
    if (t === "IHDR") {
      width = v.getUint32(at + 8);
      height = v.getUint32(at + 12);
      type = data[9]!;
      if (data[8] !== 8 || data[12] !== 0) throw new Error(`PNG with bit depth ${data[8]}, interlace ${data[12]}: not read`);
    } else if (t === "IDAT") idat.push(data);
    else if (t === "IEND") break;
    at += 12 + len;
  }
  const bpp = ({ 0: 1, 2: 3, 4: 2, 6: 4 } as Record<number, number>)[type];
  if (!bpp) throw new Error(`PNG colour type ${type}: not read`);
  const raw = inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat));
  const stride = width * bpp;
  const px = new Uint8Array(stride * height);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    const f = raw[y * (stride + 1)]!;
    const row = raw.subarray(y * (stride + 1) + 1, (y + 1) * (stride + 1));
    const o = y * stride;
    for (let i = 0; i < stride; i++) {
      const a = i >= bpp ? px[o + i - bpp]! : 0, b = y ? px[o - stride + i]! : 0, c = y && i >= bpp ? px[o - stride + i - bpp]! : 0;
      let p = row[i]!;
      if (f === 1) p += a;
      else if (f === 2) p += b;
      else if (f === 3) p += (a + b) >> 1;
      else if (f === 4) {
        const q = a + b - c, pa = Math.abs(q - a), pb = Math.abs(q - b), pc = Math.abs(q - c);
        p += pa <= pb && pa <= pc ? a : pb <= pc ? b : c;
      }
      px[o + i] = p;
    }
  }
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < width * height; i++, j += bpp) {
    const g = px[j]!;
    if (bpp === 1) rgba.set([g, g, g, 255], i * 4);
    else if (bpp === 2) rgba.set([g, g, g, px[j + 1]!], i * 4);
    else if (bpp === 3) rgba.set([g, px[j + 1]!, px[j + 2]!, 255], i * 4);
    else rgba.set(px.subarray(j, j + 4), i * 4);
  }
  return { width, height, rgba };
}

export const CHANNELS = ["rgb", "rgba", "r", "g", "b", "a"] as const;
export type Channels = (typeof CHANNELS)[number];

/**
 * Picks what to show of an RGBA picture: rgb drops alpha (a target's alpha is rarely coverage, and a 0 there would
 * hide the colour), one channel shows it as grey, rgba is the picture as it is.
 */
export function selectChannels(rgba: Uint8Array, channels: Channels): Uint8Array {
  if (channels === "rgba") return rgba;
  const out = new Uint8Array(rgba.length);
  const c = "rgba".indexOf(channels);
  for (let i = 0; i < rgba.length; i += 4) {
    if (channels === "rgb") out.set(rgba.subarray(i, i + 3), i);
    else out[i] = out[i + 1] = out[i + 2] = rgba[i + c]!;
    out[i + 3] = 255;
  }
  return out;
}
```

`viewer/server/rdef.ts`:

```ts
// Shader reflection from a DXBC container's RDEF chunk: each constant buffer's name, register and variables, so a
// constant shows as `cbTexScroll.uvScale.x`. A port of capture/src/rdef.rs.

export interface Type {
  /** D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS: 0 scalar, 1 vector, 2 row-major matrix, 3 column-major matrix, 4 object, 5 struct. */
  class: number;
  /** D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_TYPE: 1 bool, 2 int, 3 float, 19 uint, ... */
  base: number;
  rows: number;
  columns: number;
  /** Array length, 0 when not an array. */
  elements: number;
  members: { name: string; offset: number; ty: Type }[];
}

export interface Variable {
  name: string;
  offset: number;
  size: number;
  /** Whether the shader reads it. */
  used: boolean;
  ty: Type;
  type: string;
}

export interface ConstantBuffer {
  name: string;
  /** The register (`b<slot>`), when the shader binds it. */
  slot: number | null;
  space: number;
  size: number;
  variables: Variable[];
}

/** A DXBC container's chunk with the four-character code `code`. */
export function chunk(dxbc: Uint8Array, code: string): Uint8Array | null {
  const v = new DataView(dxbc.buffer, dxbc.byteOffset, dxbc.byteLength);
  if (dxbc.length < 32 || text(dxbc, 0, 4) !== "DXBC") return null;
  const count = v.getUint32(28, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const at = 32 + i * 4;
    if (at + 4 > dxbc.length) return null;
    const offset = v.getUint32(at, true);
    if (offset + 8 > dxbc.length) return null;
    if (text(dxbc, offset, 4) === code) {
      const size = v.getUint32(offset + 4, true);
      return dxbc.subarray(offset + 8, Math.min(offset + 8 + size, dxbc.length));
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function text(b: Uint8Array, at: number, n: number): string {
  return String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(at, at + n));
}

class Reader {
  v: DataView;
  constructor(public b: Uint8Array) {
    this.v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
  }
  u32(at: number): number {
    if (at + 4 > this.b.length) throw new RangeError("RDEF out of range");
    return this.v.getUint32(at, true);
  }
  u16(at: number): number {
    if (at + 2 > this.b.length) throw new RangeError("RDEF out of range");
    return this.v.getUint16(at, true);
  }
  str(at: number): string {
    const end = this.b.indexOf(0, at);
    if (at >= this.b.length || end < 0) throw new RangeError("RDEF string out of range");
    return new TextDecoder().decode(this.b.subarray(at, end));
  }
}

/** HLSL spelling, like `float4`, `float4x4` or `uint`. */
export function typeName(t: Type): string {
  const bases: Record<number, string> = {
    0: "void", 1: "bool", 2: "int", 3: "float", 19: "uint", 20: "uint8", 39: "double", 54: "min8float",
    55: "min10float", 56: "min16float", 57: "min12int", 58: "min16int", 59: "min16uint",
  };
  const base = bases[t.base] ?? "?";
  let shape = base;
  if (t.class === 1) shape = `${base}${t.columns}`;
  else if (t.class === 2 || t.class === 3) shape = `${base}${t.rows}x${t.columns}`;
  else if (t.class === 5) shape = "struct";
  return t.elements > 0 ? `${shape}[${t.elements}]` : shape;
}

function readType(r: Reader, at: number, depth: number): Type {
  const t: Type = {
    class: r.u16(at), base: r.u16(at + 2), rows: r.u16(at + 4), columns: r.u16(at + 6), elements: r.u16(at + 8),
    members: [],
  };
  const members = r.u16(at + 10), membersAt = r.u32(at + 12);
  if (depth < 8) {
    for (let i = 0; i < members; i++) {
      const m = membersAt + i * 12;
      t.members.push({ name: r.str(r.u32(m)), ty: readType(r, r.u32(m + 4), depth + 1), offset: r.u32(m + 8) });
    }
  }
  return t;
}

/** The constant buffers a shader declares, from its DXBC bytecode, or null without reflection. */
export function constantBuffers(dxbc: Uint8Array): ConstantBuffer[] | null {
  const rdef = chunk(dxbc, "RDEF");
  if (!rdef) return null;
  try {
    const r = new Reader(rdef);
    const cbCount = r.u32(0), cbAt = r.u32(4), bindCount = r.u32(8), bindAt = r.u32(12);
    const major = rdef[17] ?? 0;
    // Shader model 5 adds an "RD11" header giving the record sizes; before it, variables are 24 bytes and bindings 32.
    const rd11 = major >= 5 && text(rdef, 28, 4) === "RD11";
    const [cbSize, bindSize, varSize] = rd11 ? [r.u32(36), r.u32(40), r.u32(44)] : [24, 32, 24];
    const registers: [string, number, number][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < bindCount; i++) {
      const b = bindAt + i * bindSize;
      const name = r.str(r.u32(b));
      if (r.u32(b + 4) === 0) registers.push([name, r.u32(b + 20), bindSize >= 40 ? r.u32(b + 32) : 0]);
    }
    const out: ConstantBuffer[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cbCount; i++) {
      const c = cbAt + i * cbSize;
      const name = r.str(r.u32(c));
      const varCount = r.u32(c + 4), varAt = r.u32(c + 8), size = r.u32(c + 12);
      const variables: Variable[] = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < varCount; k++) {
        const at = varAt + k * varSize;
        const ty = readType(r, r.u32(at + 16), 0);
        variables.push({
          name: r.str(r.u32(at)), offset: r.u32(at + 4), size: r.u32(at + 8), used: (r.u32(at + 12) & 2) !== 0, ty,
          type: typeName(ty),
        });
      }
      const reg = registers.find(([n]) => n === name);
      out.push({ name, slot: reg ? reg[1] : null, space: reg ? reg[2] : 0, size, variables });
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const COMPONENTS = ["x", "y", "z", "w"];

/** The bytes one array element of `ty` takes in a constant buffer (every element but the last starts a register). */
function elementStride(ty: Type): number {
  let bytes: number;
  if (ty.class === 5) {
    bytes = ty.members.length
      ? Math.max(...ty.members.map(m => m.offset + elementStride(m.ty) * Math.max(m.ty.elements, 1)))
      : 16;
  } else if (ty.class === 2) bytes = ty.rows * 16;
  else if (ty.class === 3) bytes = ty.columns * 16;
  else bytes = Math.max(ty.columns, 1) * 4;
  return Math.ceil(bytes / 16) * 16;
}

/** The name of the 4-byte value at `offset` in a variable of type `ty` called `name`, and its base type. */
function nameIn(name: string, ty: Type, offset: number): [string, number] {
  if (ty.elements > 0) {
    const element = { ...ty, elements: 0 };
    const stride = elementStride(element);
    const i = Math.min(Math.floor(offset / stride), ty.elements - 1);
    return nameIn(`${name}[${i}]`, element, offset - i * stride);
  }
  switch (ty.class) {
    case 5: {
      const m = [...ty.members].reverse().find(m => m.offset <= offset);
      return m ? nameIn(`${name}.${m.name}`, m.ty, offset - m.offset) : [name, ty.base];
    }
    case 2: case 3: {
      const major = Math.floor(offset / 16), minor = Math.floor((offset % 16) / 4);
      const [r, c] = ty.class === 2 ? [major, minor] : [minor, major];
      return [`${name}[${r}][${c}]`, ty.base];
    }
    case 1:
      return [`${name}.${COMPONENTS[Math.floor(offset / 4) % 4]}`, ty.base];
    default:
      return [name, ty.base];
  }
}

/** The name of the 4-byte value at `offset` bytes into the buffer and its base type, if a variable covers it. */
export function nameAt(cb: ConstantBuffer, offset: number): { name: string; base: number; used: boolean } | null {
  const v = cb.variables.find(v => offset >= v.offset && offset < v.offset + v.size);
  if (!v) return null;
  const [name, base] = nameIn(v.name, v.ty, offset - v.offset);
  return { name, base, used: v.used };
}
```

`viewer/src/api.ts`:

```ts
// The server's API, typed as the front end uses it.

export interface Info {
  id: string;
  path: string;
  label: string;
  blobs: string;
  storeExists: boolean;
  targetEvents: boolean;
  meta: Record<string, any>;
  timeline: { events: number; kinds: [string, number][]; draws: number; passes: number };
  lists: { spliced: number; recordedBefore: number; unrecorded: number };
  constants: { distinct: number; failures: number };
  resources: { live: number; used: number; written: number; contents: number; contentBytes: number; sources: [string, number][] };
  uploads: { total: number; stored: number; hashOnly: number; none: number };
  targets: { count: number; bytes: number; skipped: number };
  shaders: { count: number; withBytecode: number };

  blobsAbsent: number;

}

export interface Row {

  kind: string;
  call: string;
  context: number;
  deferred: number;
  list: number | null;
  draw: number | null;
  pass: number | null;
  group: number;
  args: string;
  data: string | null;
  vs: string | null;
  hs: string | null;
  ds: string | null;
  gs: string | null;

  cs: string | null;
}

export interface Group {

  count: number;
}

export interface ResourceRef {

  height?: number;
}

export interface Register {

  words: number[];

  bases: (number | null)[];
  used: boolean;
}

export interface Constants {
  content: string | null;
  size?: number;
  note?: string;

  registers: Register[];
}

export interface Binding {

  kind: string;
  slot: number;
  space: number;
  view: { id: number; kind: string; format: number; formatName: string; dimension: number; json: any } | null;
  resource: (ResourceRef & { content: string | null; contentSource: string | null; contentNote: string | null;
    upload: string | null; uploadStored: boolean; lastWrite: number | null }) | null;
  state: { id: number; json: any } | null;

export interface Target {
  draw: number;
  name: string;
  view: number;
  resource: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  format: number;
  formatName: string;
  sub: number;
  blob: string | null;
  event: number | null;
  before: { source: SourceObj; label: string } | null;
  writesBetween: number;
}

export type SourceObj = { kind: "target"; draw: number; name: string } | { kind: "resource" | "upload"; id: number; sub: number; z?: number };

export function sourceText(s: SourceObj): string {
  return s.kind === "target" ? `target:${s.draw}:${s.name}` : `${s.kind}:${s.id}:${s.sub}:${s.z ?? 0}`;
}

/** What an order-dependent draw or dispatch wrote through a UAV, as the game's GPU wrote it. */
export interface ResultOut {
  resource: ResourceRef;
  content: string;
  /** Bytes in the blob store, or null when it is not there. */
  size: number | null;
  stride: number;
}

export interface Draw {
  n: number;
  event: number;
  call: string;
  args: any;
  pass: number | null;
  eventRow: any;
  shaders: Record<string, string | null>;
  topology: number;
  layout: { id: number; json: any; signature: string | null } | null;
  rasterizer: { id: number; json: any } | null;
  blend: { id: number; json: any } | null;
  depthStencil: { id: number; json: any } | null;
  blendFactor: number[] | null;
  sampleMask: number | null;
  stencilRef: number | null;
  predicate: number | null;
  predicateValue: number | null;
  viewports: any[];
  scissors: any[];
  bindings: Binding[];
  passRange: { n: number; first: number; last: number } | null;
  targets: Target[];
  results: ResultOut[];
  prev: { n: number; event: number } | null;
  next: { n: number; event: number } | null;
}

export interface EventDetail {
  seq: number;
  kind: string;
  call: string;
  context: number;
  deferred: number;
  list: number | null;
  draw: number | null;
  args: any;
  data: string | null;
  stack: number | null;
  pass: number | null;
  group: number | null;
  reads: ResourceRef[];
  writes: ResourceRef[];
  stackFrames: string[];
  dataBlob: { key: string; size: number | null } | null;
  results: ResultOut[];
  view: { id: number; kind: string; resource: number; format: string; json: any } | null;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {}

async function check(r: Response): Promise<Response> {
  if (!r.ok) {
    let msg = `${r.status} ${r.statusText}`;
    try {
      const j = await r.json();
      if (j?.error) msg = j.error;
    } catch {}
    throw new ApiError(msg);
  }
  return r;
}

export async function get<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  return (await check(await fetch(`/api/${path}`))).json();
}

export async function post<T>(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
  return (await check(await fetch(`/api/${path}`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body),
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } }))).json();
}

export async function text(path: string): Promise<string> {
  return (await check(await fetch(`/api/${path}`))).text();
}

export async function bytes(path: string): Promise<{ data: Uint8Array; total: number }> {
  const r = await check(await fetch(`/api/${path}`));
  return { data: new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()), total: Number(r.headers.get("x-blob-size") ?? 0) };
}

/** Sends a capture.db the browser holds to the server, which keeps a copy in its cache and opens it. */
export async function upload(file: Blob, name: string, blobs: string): Promise<Info> {
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ name });
  if (blobs) q.set("blobs", blobs);
  return (await check(await fetch(`/api/upload?${q}`, { method: "POST", body: file }))).json();
}

const memo = new Map<string, Promise<any>>();

/** `get`, remembered for the page's life (captures do not change while open). */
export function cached<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  let p = memo.get(path);
  if (!p) {
    p = get<T>(path);
    p.catch(() => memo.delete(path));
    memo.set(path, p);
  }
  return p;
}
```

`viewer/src/image.tsx`:

```tsx
// Pictures of targets and textures: zoom, pan, and a pixel picker showing both the picture's 8-bit value and the
// texel's raw value as the capture holds it. Before/after/diff for a pass's targets.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { get, sourceText, type SourceObj } from "./api";
import { float } from "./util";

export interface Picture {
  id: string;
  src: SourceObj;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  title: string;
  /** What the same texels looked like before (a pass's target before the pass). */
  before?: { src: SourceObj; label: string; writesBetween?: number } | null;
}

/** rgb drops alpha: a target's alpha is rarely coverage, and where it is 0 the colour would not show. */
export type Channels = "rgb" | "rgba" | "r" | "g" | "b" | "a";

export function imageUrl(id: string, src: SourceObj, range = "auto", channels: Channels = "rgb"): string {
  return `/api/c/${id}/image?${new URLSearchParams({ src: sourceText(src), range, channels })}`;
}

interface Texel {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  format?: string;
  channels?: [string, number][];
  raw?: string;
  kind?: string;
  note?: string;
  error?: string;
}

function loadImage(url: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  return new Promise((ok, fail) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => ok(img);
    img.onerror = async () => {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(url);
        const j = await r.json();
        fail(new Error(j.error ?? `${r.status}`));
      } catch {
        fail(new Error("the picture could not be made"));
      }
    };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

type Mode = "after" | "before" | "diff";

/** A thumbnail that opens the full viewer. */
export function Thumb({ pic, open, size = 160 }: { pic: Picture; open: (p: Picture) => void; size?: number }) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <figure class="thumb" style={{ width: `${size}px` }} onClick={() => open(pic)} title="open (zoom, pick pixels)">
      {failed ? <div class="thumb-fail" style={{ height: `${size * 0.6}px` }}>{failed}</div> : (
        <img src={imageUrl(pic.id, pic.src)} loading="lazy" style={{ maxWidth: `${size}px`, maxHeight: `${size}px` }}
          onError={async () => {
            try {
              const r = await fetch(imageUrl(pic.id, pic.src));
              setFailed((await r.json()).error ?? "failed");
            } catch {
              setFailed("failed");
            }
          }} />
      )}
      <figcaption>{pic.title}</figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}

export function Viewer({ pic, onClose }: { pic: Picture; onClose?: () => void }) {
  const [range, setRange] = useState("auto");
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState("0:1");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("after");
  const [channels, setChannels] = useState<Channels>("rgb");
  const [img, setImg] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [diffInfo, setDiffInfo] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState({ zoom: 0, x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ x: number; y: number; rgba: number[] } | null>(null);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Texel | null>(null);
  const [hoverTexel, setHoverTexel] = useState<Texel | null>(null);
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pixels = useRef<ImageData | null>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number; moved: boolean } | null>(null);
  const hoverReq = useRef(0);

  const src = mode === "before" && pic.before ? pic.before.src : pic.src;
  const effectiveRange = range === "custom" ? custom : range;

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setError(null);
    setDiffInfo(null);
    let url: string;
    if (mode === "diff" && pic.before) {
      url = `/api/c/${pic.id}/diff?${new URLSearchParams({ a: sourceText(pic.before.src), b: sourceText(pic.src) })}`;
      fetch(url).then(async r => {
        if (!live) return;
        if (!r.ok) {
          setError((await r.json()).error);
          return;
        }
        const changed = Number(r.headers.get("x-changed")), total = Number(r.headers.get("x-total"));
        setDiffInfo(`${changed.toLocaleString()} of ${total.toLocaleString()} texels changed (${(100 * changed / total).toFixed(2)}%): magenta`);
        const blob = await r.blob();
        const i = await loadImage(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
        if (live) setImg(i);
      }, e => live && setError(String(e)));
    } else {
      url = imageUrl(pic.id, src, effectiveRange, channels);
      loadImage(url).then(i => live && setImg(i), e => live && setError(String(e.message ?? e)));
    }
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [pic.id, sourceText(src), effectiveRange, mode, channels]);

  // Keep the picture's pixels for the hover readout.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!img) return;
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = img.naturalWidth;
    c.height = img.naturalHeight;
    const g = c.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true })!;
    g.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    pixels.current = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  }, [img]);

  // Fit on first load.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (img && view.zoom === 0) fit();
  }, [img]);

  function fit() {
    const w = wrap.current;
    if (!w) return;
    const zoom = Math.min(w.clientWidth / pic.width, w.clientHeight / pic.height);
    setView({ zoom, x: (w.clientWidth - pic.width * zoom) / 2, y: (w.clientHeight - pic.height * zoom) / 2 });
  }

  function actual() {
    const w = wrap.current;
    if (!w) return;
    setView({ zoom: 1, x: (w.clientWidth - pic.width) / 2, y: (w.clientHeight - pic.height) / 2 });
  }

  // Draw.
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = canvas.current, w = wrap.current;
    if (!c || !w || !img) return;
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    c.width = w.clientWidth * dpr;
    c.height = w.clientHeight * dpr;
    c.style.width = `${w.clientWidth}px`;
    c.style.height = `${w.clientHeight}px`;
    const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    g.imageSmoothingEnabled = view.zoom < 1;
    // A checkerboard behind, so transparency shows.
    g.fillStyle = "#222";
    g.fillRect(view.x, view.y, pic.width * view.zoom, pic.height * view.zoom);
    g.drawImage(img, view.x, view.y, pic.width * view.zoom, pic.height * view.zoom);
    if (view.zoom >= 24) {
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(128,128,128,0.35)";
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(-view.x / view.zoom)), x1 = Math.min(pic.width, Math.ceil((w.clientWidth - view.x) / view.zoom));
      const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(-view.y / view.zoom)), y1 = Math.min(pic.height, Math.ceil((w.clientHeight - view.y) / view.zoom));
      g.beginPath();
      for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) { g.moveTo(view.x + x * view.zoom + 0.5, view.y + y0 * view.zoom); g.lineTo(view.x + x * view.zoom + 0.5, view.y + y1 * view.zoom); }
      for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) { g.moveTo(view.x + x0 * view.zoom, view.y + y * view.zoom + 0.5); g.lineTo(view.x + x1 * view.zoom, view.y + y * view.zoom + 0.5); }
      g.stroke();
    }
    if (picked) {
      const z = Math.max(view.zoom, 1);
      g.strokeStyle = "#ff0";
      g.lineWidth = 2;
      g.strokeRect(view.x + picked.x * view.zoom - 1, view.y + picked.y * view.zoom - 1, z + 2, z + 2);
    }
  }, [img, view, picked]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setView(v => ({ ...v })));
    if (wrap.current) ro.observe(wrap.current);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || e.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose?.();
      else if (e.key === "f") fit();
      else if (e.key === "1") actual();
      else if (e.key === "b" && pic.before) setMode(m => (m === "before" ? "after" : "before"));
      else if (e.key === "d" && pic.before) setMode(m => (m === "diff" ? "after" : "diff"));
      else return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
    };
    addEventListener("keydown", k, true);
    return () => removeEventListener("keydown", k, true);
  }, [pic, onClose]);

  function texelAt(e: MouseEvent): { x: number; y: number } | null {
    const r = canvas.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = Math.floor((e.clientX - r.left - view.x) / view.zoom), y = Math.floor((e.clientY - r.top - view.y) / view.zoom);
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= pic.width || y >= pic.height) return null;
    return { x, y };
  }

  async function fetchTexel(x: number, y: number): Promise<Texel> {
    const s = mode === "diff" ? pic.src : src;
    return get<Texel>(`c/${pic.id}/texel?${new URLSearchParams({ src: sourceText(s), x: String(x), y: String(y) })}`);
  }

  function onMove(e: MouseEvent) {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (d) {
      if (Math.abs(e.clientX - d.x) + Math.abs(e.clientY - d.y) > 3) d.moved = true;
      setView(v => ({ ...v, x: d.vx + e.clientX - d.x, y: d.vy + e.clientY - d.y }));
      return;
    }
    const t = texelAt(e);
    if (!t) {
      setHover(null);
      return;
    }
    const p = pixels.current;
    let rgba = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    if (p && p.width === pic.width) {
      const o = (t.y * p.width + t.x) * 4;
      rgba = [p.data[o]!, p.data[o + 1]!, p.data[o + 2]!, p.data[o + 3]!];
    }
    setHover({ ...t, rgba });
    const req = ++hoverReq.current;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (req !== hoverReq.current) return;
      fetchTexel(t.x, t.y).then(r => req === hoverReq.current && setHoverTexel(r), () => {});
    }, 40);
  }

  function onWheel(e: WheelEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = canvas.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top;
    setView(v => {
      const zoom = Math.min(256, Math.max(0.02, v.zoom * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.25 : 0.8)));
      return { zoom, x: mx - ((mx - v.x) * zoom) / v.zoom, y: my - ((my - v.y) * zoom) / v.zoom };
    });
  }

  const readout = (t: Texel | null, label: string) => {
    if (!t) return null;
    if (t.error) return <div class="texel"><b>{label}</b> <span class="error-inline">{t.error}</span></div>;
    return (
      <div class="texel">
        <b>{label}</b> ({t.x}, {t.y}) <span class="muted">{t.format}</span>
        {t.channels?.map(([n, v]) => <span class="ch"> {n} <code>{t.kind === "uint" || t.kind === "sint" || n === "stencil" ? v : float(v)}</code></span>)}
        <span class="muted"> raw </span><code>{t.raw}</code>
        {t.note ? <span class="muted"> ({t.note})</span> : null}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div class="viewer">
      <div class="viewer-bar">
        <b>{pic.title}</b>
        <span class="muted">{pic.width}x{pic.height}</span>
        {pic.before ? (
          <span class="seg">
            {(["before", "after", "diff"] as Mode[]).map(m => (
              <button class={mode === m ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setMode(m)} title={m === "before" ? pic.before!.label : m === "diff" ? "texels whose bytes changed (d)" : "(b toggles)"}>{m}</button>
            ))}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        <label>range <select value={range} onChange={e => setRange((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)} disabled={mode === "diff"}>
          <option value="auto">auto</option><option value="clamp">clamp</option><option value="tonemap">tonemap</option><option value="custom">lo:hi</option>
        </select></label>
        {range === "custom" ? <input class="small" value={custom} onChange={e => setCustom((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} /> : null}
        <label title="rgb ignores alpha; one channel shows as grey">channels <select value={channels} onChange={e => setChannels((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as Channels)} disabled={mode === "diff"}>
          {(["rgb", "rgba", "r", "g", "b", "a"] as Channels[]).map(c => <option value={c}>{c}</option>)}
        </select></label>
        <button onClick={fit} title="f">fit</button>
        <button onClick={actual} title="1">1:1</button>
        <span class="muted">{view.zoom ? `${(view.zoom * 100).toFixed(view.zoom < 0.1 ? 1 : 0)}%` : ""}</span>
        <a href={imageUrl(pic.id, src, effectiveRange, channels)} target="_blank">png</a>
        {onClose ? <button class="close" onClick={onClose} title="Esc">close</button> : null}
      </div>
      {mode === "before" && pic.before ? <div class="note">before: {pic.before.label}{pic.before.writesBetween ? `; ${pic.before.writesBetween} event(s) wrote it in between (a clear or copy), which this picture does not show` : ""}</div> : null}
      {diffInfo && mode === "diff" ? <div class="note">{diffInfo}</div> : null}
      <div class="viewer-canvas" ref={wrap}
        onWheel={onWheel}
        onMouseDown={e => { drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, vx: view.x, vy: view.y, moved: false }; }}
        onMouseUp={async e => {
          const d = drag.current;
          drag.current = null;
          if (d && !d.moved) {
            const t = texelAt(e);
            if (t) setPicked(await fetchTexel(t.x, t.y));
          }
        }}
        onMouseLeave={() => { drag.current = null; setHover(null); }}
        onMouseMove={onMove}>
        {error ? <div class="error pad">{error}</div> : !img ? <div class="muted pad">decoding…</div> : null}
        <canvas ref={canvas} />
      </div>
      <div class="viewer-readout">
        {hover ? (
          <div class="texel"><b>hover</b> ({hover.x}, {hover.y}) <span class="muted">picture</span> <code>{hover.rgba.join(" ")}</code>
            {hoverTexel && hoverTexel.x === hover.x && hoverTexel.y === hover.y ? readout(hoverTexel, "") : null}</div>
        ) : <div class="texel muted">hover for values; click to pin a texel; wheel zooms, drag pans; f fit, 1 actual size{pic.before ? ", b before, d diff" : ""}</div>}
        {readout(picked, "pinned")}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The full viewer over the page. */
export function Lightbox({ pic, onClose }: { pic: Picture | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  if (!pic) return null;
  return (
    <div class="lightbox" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <div class="lightbox-inner"><Viewer key={sourceText(pic.src)} pic={pic} onClose={onClose} /></div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// What a capture holds and what it lacks (as `locum-cli info` says it), its meta, and verify.

import { useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { get, post, type Info } from "./api";
import { KV, Section, useCtx } from "./parts";
import { mib, useAsync } from "./util";

export function InfoPage({ info }: { info: Info }) {
  const m = info.meta;
  return (
    <div class="page">
      <h2>capture {info.label}</h2>
      <KV rows={[
        ["database", <code>{info.path}</code>],
        ["frame", `${m.frame ?? "?"} of ${m.exe ?? "?"} (pid ${m.pid ?? "?"}), ${m.api ?? "?"}, locum ${m.locum ?? "?"}${m.time ? `, ${new Date(Number(m.time) * 1000).toLocaleString()}` : ""}`],
        ["request", <code>{JSON.stringify(m.request)}</code>],
        ["blob store", <span><code>{info.blobs}</code>{info.storeExists ? "" : <span class="warn"> does not exist</span>}</span>],
      ]} />
      <div class="stats">
        <Stat label="events" value={info.timeline.events} sub={info.timeline.kinds.map(([k, n]) => `${k} ${n}`).join(", ")} />
        <Stat label="draws and dispatches" value={info.timeline.draws} sub={`in ${info.timeline.passes} passes`} />
        <Stat label="command lists spliced" value={info.lists.spliced} sub={`${info.lists.recordedBefore} recorded the frame before, ${info.lists.unrecorded} executed without a recording`} />
        <Stat label="constant buffer contents" value={info.constants.distinct} sub={`${info.constants.failures} copies failed`} />
        <Stat label="resources live" value={info.resources.live} sub={`${info.resources.used} used (${info.resources.written} written); contents for ${info.resources.contents} (${mib(info.resources.contentBytes)}): ${info.resources.sources.map(([s, n]) => `${s} ${n}`).join(", ")}`} />
        <Stat label="uploads" value={info.uploads.total} sub={`${info.uploads.stored} stored, ${info.uploads.hashOnly} hash only; ${info.uploads.none} have no upload hash`} />
        <Stat label="targets read back" value={info.targets.count} sub={`${mib(info.targets.bytes)}, ${info.targets.skipped} skipped`} />
        <Stat label="shaders" value={info.shaders.count} sub={`${info.shaders.withBytecode} with bytecode`} />
        <Stat label="blobs referenced" value={info.blobsReferenced} sub={`${info.blobsAbsent} not in the store`} />
      </div>
      {info.memory ? <KV rows={[["memory dump", info.memory]]} /> : null}
      <h3>missing</h3>
      {info.missing.length ? <ul class="missing">{info.missing.map(x => <li>{x}</li>)}</ul> : <div class="ok">nothing</div>}
      <Verify />
      <Section title="meta" open={false}>
        <table class="kv"><tbody>{Object.entries(m).map(([k, v]) => <tr><th>{k}</th><td><code class="wrap">{typeof v === "string" ? v : JSON.stringify(v)}</code></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, sub }: { label: string; value: number; sub: string }) {
  return <div class="stat"><div class="stat-value">{value.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="stat-label">{label}</div><div class="stat-sub">{sub}</div></div>;
}

/** `locum-cli verify`: replays the frame and compares every target read back with the game's. */
function Verify() {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const [run, setRun] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const prior = useAsync(() => get<{ text: string | null }>(`c/${id}/verify`), [id, run]);
  async function start(again = false) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await post(`c/${id}/verify${again ? "?again=1" : ""}`, {});
    } catch (e) {
      setError(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setRun(run + 1);
    }
  }
  return (
    <Section title="verify (replay the frame and compare every target)" open={!!prior.data?.text}>
      {prior.data?.text ? <pre class="verify">{prior.data.text}</pre> : null}
      <div>
        <button onClick={() => start(!!prior.data?.text)} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? "replaying… (this runs the whole frame on the GPU)" : prior.data?.text ? "run it again" : "run locum-cli verify"}
        </button>
        {error ? <pre class="error">{error}</pre> : null}
      </div>
    </Section>
  );
}
```

`viewer/src/main.tsx`:

```tsx
import { render } from "preact";
import { useEffect, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { cached, type Info } from "./api";
import { Lightbox, type Picture } from "./image";
import { InfoPage } from "./info";
import { OpenPage, openFile } from "./open";
import { CaptureCtx } from "./parts";
import { Pipeline } from "./pipeline";
import { Resources } from "./resources";
import { Shaders } from "./shaders";
import { Sql } from "./sql";
import { href, Loading, useAsync, useRoute, type ValueMode } from "./util";
import "./style.css";

const TABS: [string, string][] = [["info", "info"], ["pipeline", "pipeline"], ["resources", "resources"], ["shaders", "shaders"], ["sql", "sql"]];

function App() {
  const route = useRoute();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [blobs, setBlobs] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem("locum-blobs") ?? "");
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => localStorage.setItem("locum-blobs", blobs), [blobs]);

  // A capture.db dropped anywhere opens it.
  useEffect(() => {
    const over = (e: DragEvent) => {
      if (!e.dataTransfer?.types.includes("Files")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      setDragging(true);
    };
    const leave = (e: DragEvent) => { if (!e.relatedTarget) setDragging(false); };
    const drop = async (e: DragEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDragging(false);
      const f = e.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];
      if (!f) return;
      setError(null);
      try {
        await openFile(f, blobs, setBusy);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(String((err as Error).message ?? err));
      }
    };
    addEventListener("dragover", over);
    addEventListener("dragleave", leave);
    addEventListener("drop", drop);
    return () => {
      removeEventListener("dragover", over);
      removeEventListener("dragleave", leave);
      removeEventListener("drop", drop);
    };
  }, [blobs]);

  // Start on the capture the server was started with.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.hash !== "" && location.hash !== "#") return;
    fetch("/api/status").then(r => r.json()).then(s => { if (s.initial) location.hash = href(s.initial, "info"); });
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      {dragging ? <div class="dropzone">drop a capture.db to open it</div> : null}
      {busy && route.id ? <div class="busy">{busy}</div> : null}
      {error ? <div class="error top" onClick={() => setError(null)}>{error}</div> : null}
      {route.id ? <CaptureApp key={route.id} id={route.id} tab={route.tab} item={route.item} />
        : <><Header /><OpenPage busy={busy} setBusy={setBusy} blobs={blobs} setBlobs={setBlobs} /></>}
    </>
  );
}

function Header({ info, tab }: { info?: Info; tab?: string }) {
  return (
    <header>
      <a class="brand" href="#/">locum</a>
      {info ? <>
        <span class="cap" title={info.path}>{info.label} <span class="muted">frame {info.meta.frame}</span></span>
        <nav>{TABS.map(([t, label]) => <a class={t === tab ? "on" : ""} href={href(info.id, t)}>{label}</a>)}</nav>
      </> : null}
      <span class="spacer" />
      <a class="muted" href="#/">open…</a>
    </header>
  );
}

function CaptureApp({ id, tab, item }: { id: string; tab: string; item: string | null }) {
  const info = useAsync(() => cached<Info>(`c/${id}/info`), [id]);
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<ValueMode>(() => (localStorage.getItem("locum-mode") as ValueMode) ?? "auto");
  const [picture, setPicture] = useState<Picture | null>(null);
  const setMode = (m: ValueMode) => { setModeState(m); localStorage.setItem("locum-mode", m); };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (info.data) document.title = `${info.data.label} · locum`;
  }, [info.data]);
  return (
    <CaptureCtx.Provider value={{ id, mode, setMode, openPicture: setPicture }}>
      <Header info={info.data} tab={tab} />
      <main>
        <Loading state={info}>{() => {
          switch (tab) {
            case "pipeline": return <Pipeline seq={item != null ? Number(item) : null} />;
            case "resources": return <Resources item={item} />;
            case "shaders": return <Shaders item={item} />;
            case "sql": return <Sql />;
            default: return <InfoPage info={info.data!} />;
          }
        }}</Loading>
      </main>
      <Lightbox pic={picture} onClose={() => setPicture(null)} />
    </CaptureCtx.Provider>
  );
}

render(<App />, document.getElementById("app")!);
```

`viewer/src/open.tsx`:

```tsx
// Opening a capture: by path on the server's disk, from a list of captures under a folder, or a capture.db the
// browser holds (drag and drop, or the File System Access API picker), which the server keeps a copy of.

import { useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { get, post, upload, type Info } from "./api";
import { go, href, mib, useAsync } from "./util";

interface Status {
  cli: string | null;
  defaultDir: string;
  initial: string | null;
  recent: { id: string; path: string; label: string; blobs: string | null; uploaded?: boolean }[];
}

interface Listed {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  mtime: number;
  frame?: number;
  exe?: string;
  draws?: number;
  events?: number;
  error?: string;
}

export async function openFile(file: File, blobs: string, setBusy: (s: string | null) => void): Promise<void> {
  setBusy(`sending ${file.name} (${mib(file.size)}) to the server…`);
  try {
    const info = await upload(file, file.name, blobs);
    go(href(info.id, "info"));
  } finally {
    setBusy(null);
  }
}

/** Picks a capture.db with the File System Access API where there is one (Chromium, secure contexts), else an input. */
export async function pickFile(): Promise<File | null> {
  const w = window as any;
  if (typeof w.showOpenFilePicker === "function") {
    try {
      const [handle] = await w.showOpenFilePicker({
        id: "locum-capture",
        types: [{ description: "locum capture", accept: { "application/vnd.sqlite3": [".db"] } }],
      });
      return handle ? await handle.getFile() : null;
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error).name === "AbortError") return null;
      throw e;
    }
  }
  return new Promise(ok => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = ".db";
    input.onchange = () => ok(input.files?.[0] ?? null);
    input.click();
  });
}

export function OpenPage({ busy, setBusy, blobs, setBlobs }: { busy: string | null; setBusy: (s: string | null) => void; blobs: string; setBlobs: (s: string) => void }) {
  const status = useAsync(() => get<Status>("status"), []);
  const [path, setPath] = useState("");
  const [dir, setDir] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const folder = dir ?? status.data?.defaultDir ?? null;
  const list = useAsync(() => (folder ? get<{ dir: string; captures: Listed[] }>(`captures?dir=${encodeURIComponent(folder)}`) : null), [folder]);
  const fsa = typeof (window as any).showOpenFilePicker === "function";

  async function openPath(p: string) {
    setError(null);
    setBusy(`opening ${p}…`);
    try {
      const info = await post<Info>("open", { path: p, blobs: blobs || undefined });
      go(href(info.id, "info"));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div class="page open">
      <h2>open a capture</h2>
      {busy ? <div class="note">{busy}</div> : null}
      {error ? <div class="error">{error}</div> : null}
      <div class="open-grid">
        <div class="card">
          <h3>from this browser</h3>
          <p>Drop a <code>capture.db</code> anywhere on the page, or choose one. The server keeps a copy in its cache (read-only) and reads
            pictures from the blob store the capture names, or the one below.</p>
          <button onClick={async () => {
            setError(null);
            try {
              const f = await pickFile();
              if (f) await openFile(f, blobs, setBusy);
            } catch (e) {
              setError(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
            }
          }}>choose capture.db…</button>
          <div class="muted small">{fsa ? "File System Access API available" : `File System Access API not available here${window.isSecureContext ? "" : " (not a secure context: use http://localhost)"}; using a file input`}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <h3>from the server's disk</h3>
          <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); if (path.trim()) openPath(path.trim()); }}>
            <input class="wide" placeholder="path to capture.db, or its folder" value={path} onInput={e => setPath((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} />
            <button type="submit">open</button>
          </form>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <h3>blob store</h3>
          <input class="wide" placeholder="default: the capture's own (meta blobs), LOCUM_BLOBS or --blobs" value={blobs} onInput={e => setBlobs((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} />
          <div class="muted small">only needed when the store has moved</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {status.data?.recent.length ? (
        <>
          <h3>opened before</h3>
          <table class="grid">
            <thead><tr><th>capture</th><th>database</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{status.data.recent.map(r => <tr><td><a href={href(r.id, "info")}>{r.label}</a></td><td class="mono small">{r.uploaded ? "(from the browser) " : ""}{r.path}</td><td /></tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </>
      ) : null}
      <h3>captures under <input class="wide inline" value={folder ?? ""} onChange={e => setDir((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} /></h3>
      {list.error ? <div class="error">{list.error}</div> : list.data ? (
        list.data.captures.length ? (
          <table class="grid">
            <thead><tr><th>name</th><th>frame</th><th>game</th><th>draws</th><th>events</th><th>size</th><th>modified</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{list.data.captures.map(c => (
              <tr class="clickable" onClick={() => openPath(c.path)} title={c.path}>
                <td><a href="javascript:void 0">{c.name}</a></td><td>{c.frame ?? ""}</td><td>{c.exe ?? c.error ?? ""}</td><td>{c.draws ?? ""}</td>
                <td>{c.events ?? ""}</td><td>{mib(c.size)}</td><td>{new Date(c.mtime).toLocaleString()}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </table>
        ) : <div class="muted">no capture.db under {list.data.dir}</div>
      ) : <div class="muted">looking…</div>}
      {status.data && !status.data.cli ? <div class="warn">locum-cli was not found: pictures and disassembly are off (start the server with --cli or LOCUM_CLI)</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
