`viewer/src/parts.tsx`:

```tsx
// Pieces several pages share: links, a bytes view, constant buffers by register, stacks.

import type { ComponentChildren } from "preact";
import { createContext } from "preact";
import { useContext, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { bytes, type Constants, type ResourceRef } from "./api";
import { bitsToFloat, float, hex, href, useAsync, word, type ValueMode } from "./util";
import { f16 } from "../server/format";

/** The open capture's id, and what the page shares: how constants are shown, and the picture viewer. */
export interface Ctx {
  id: string;
  mode: ValueMode;
  setMode: (m: ValueMode) => void;
  openPicture: (p: import("./image").Picture) => void;
}

export const CaptureCtx = createContext<Ctx>(null as any);
export const useCtx = () => useContext(CaptureCtx);

export function ResLink({ r, children }: { r: ResourceRef | number; children?: ComponentChildren }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const rid = typeof r === "number" ? r : r.id;
  return <a href={href(id, "resources", rid)} title={typeof r === "number" ? undefined : r.text}>{children ?? (typeof r === "number" ? `#${r}` : r.text)}</a>;
}

export function EventLink({ seq, children }: { seq: number; children?: ComponentChildren }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  return <a href={href(id, "pipeline", seq)}>{children ?? `event ${seq}`}</a>;
}

export function ShaderLink({ hash }: { hash: string | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  if (!hash) return <span class="muted">-</span>;
  return <a class="mono" href={href(id, "shaders", hash)}>{hash}</a>;
}

export function ModeSelect() {
  const { mode, setMode } = useCtx();
  return (
    <span class="seg" title="how 4-byte values are shown (auto: by the shader's reflected type, else float)">
      {(["auto", "float", "int", "uint", "hex"] as ValueMode[]).map(m => (
        <button class={mode === m ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setMode(m)}>{m}</button>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export function Section({ title, open = true, children, extra }: { title: ComponentChildren; open?: boolean; children: ComponentChildren; extra?: ComponentChildren }) {
  return (
    <details class="section" open={open}>
      <summary><span class="section-title">{title}</span>{extra ? <span class="section-extra" onClick={e => e.preventDefault()}>{extra}</span> : null}</summary>
      <div class="section-body">{children}</div>
    </details>
  );
}

export function Stack({ frames }: { frames: string[] }) {
  if (!frames.length) return <span class="muted">no stack recorded</span>;
  return <ol class="stack">{frames.map(f => <li><code>{f}</code></li>)}</ol>;
}

/** A constant buffer register by register: c#, the four values, and their names from the shader's reflection. */
export function ConstantsTable({ title, constants }: { title: ComponentChildren; constants: Constants }) {
  const { mode } = useCtx();
  const [all, setAll] = useState(false);
  if (!constants.content || constants.note) return <div class="cb"><div class="cb-title">{title}: <span class="muted">{constants.note}</span></div></div>;
  const regs = all || !constants.reflection ? constants.registers : constants.registers.filter(r => r.used);
  const hidden = constants.registers.length - regs.length;
  return (
    <div class="cb">
      <div class="cb-title">
        {title} <span class="muted">({constants.reflection ? constants.reflection.name : "no reflection"}, {constants.size} bytes, contents {constants.content.slice(0, 12)})</span>
        {constants.reflection ? <label class="small-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={all} onChange={() => setAll(!all)} /> unused registers{hidden ? ` (${hidden})` : ""}</label> : null}
      </div>
      <table class="regs">
        <tbody>
          {regs.map(r => (
            <tr class={r.used ? "" : "dim"}>
              <td class="reg">c{r.c}</td>
              {r.words.map((w, i) => <td class="val" title={`${hex(w)}  float ${float(bitsToFloat(w))}  int ${w | 0}`}>{word(w, r.bases[i] ?? null, mode)}</td>)}
              <td class="names">{registerName(r.names)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One name for a register when its components belong to one variable (`world[2]`), else each component's. */
function registerName(names: (string | null)[]): string {
  if (names.every(n => n == null)) return "";
  const stem = (n: string) => n.replace(/(\.[xyzw]|\[\d+\])$/, "");
  const first = names.find(n => n != null)!;
  if (names.every(n => n == null || stem(n) === stem(first)) && names.filter(n => n).length > 1) {
    const parts = names.map(n => (n ? n.slice(stem(n).length) : "_"));
    return `${stem(first)}${parts.every(p => /^\.[xyzw]$/.test(p)) ? "." + parts.map(p => p.slice(1)).join("") : `{${parts.join(" ")}}`}`;
  }
  return names.map(n => n ?? "_").join(", ");
}

type BytesMode = "auto" | "f32" | "u32" | "i32" | "f16" | "u16" | "u8" | "hex";

/** A blob's bytes, a page at a time, as hex or as numbers. */
export function BytesView({ blob, total, stride: initialStride }: { blob: string; total?: number | null; stride?: number }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<BytesMode>("auto");
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);
  const [stride, setStride] = useState(initialStride && initialStride > 0 && initialStride <= 256 ? initialStride : 16);
  const page = 4096;
  const data = useAsync(() => bytes(`c/${id}/blob/${blob}?offset=${offset}&size=${page}`), [id, blob, offset]);
  const size = data.data?.total ?? total ?? 0;
  const rows: { at: number; cells: string[]; hex: string }[] = [];
  if (data.data) {
    const b = data.data.data;
    const v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
    for (let at = 0; at < b.length; at += stride) {
      const cells: string[] = [];
      const end = Math.min(at + stride, b.length);
      const w = mode === "hex" || mode === "u8" ? 1 : mode === "f16" || mode === "u16" ? 2 : 4;
      if (mode !== "hex") for (let k = at; k + w <= end; k += w) {
        cells.push(mode === "auto" ? word(v.getUint32(k, true), null, "auto") : mode === "f32" ? float(v.getFloat32(k, true)) : mode === "u32" ? String(v.getUint32(k, true))
          : mode === "i32" ? String(v.getInt32(k, true)) : mode === "f16" ? float(f16(v.getUint16(k, true)))
          : mode === "u16" ? String(v.getUint16(k, true)) : String(v.getUint8(k)));
      }
      rows.push({ at: offset + at, cells, hex: [...b.subarray(at, end)].map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ") });
    }
  }
  return (
    <div class="bytes">
      <div class="bytes-bar">
        <span class="seg">{(["auto", "f32", "u32", "i32", "f16", "u16", "u8", "hex"] as BytesMode[]).map(m => <button class={mode === m ? "on" : ""} title={m === "auto" ? "4-byte words as floats; ones that look like integers or packed bits (denormal, NaN) as hex" : undefined} onClick={() => setMode(m)}>{m}</button>)}</span>
        <label>row <input class="small" type="number" min={4} max={256} step={4} value={stride} onChange={e => setStride(Math.max(4, Math.min(256, Number((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || 16)))} /> bytes</label>
        <button disabled={offset === 0} onClick={() => setOffset(Math.max(0, offset - page))}>prev</button>
        <span class="muted">{offset.toLocaleString()}–{Math.min(offset + page, size).toLocaleString()} of {size.toLocaleString()} bytes</span>
        <button disabled={offset + page >= size} onClick={() => setOffset(offset + page)}>next</button>
        <label>at <input class="small" placeholder="offset" onKeyDown={e => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") {
            const t = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value.trim();
            const n = t.startsWith("0x") ? parseInt(t, 16) : Number(t);
            if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0) setOffset(Math.floor(n / page) * page);
          }
        }} /></label>
        <a href={`/api/c/${id}/blob/${blob}?size=${16 << 20}`} target="_blank" download={blob}>raw</a>
      </div>
      {data.error ? <div class="error">{data.error}</div> : (
        <div class="bytes-rows">
          {rows.map(r => (
            <div class="bytes-row">
              <span class="off">{r.at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}</span>
              {mode === "hex" ? <span class="hex">{r.hex}</span> : <span class="nums">{r.cells.map(c => <span class="num">{c}</span>)}</span>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function KV({ rows }: { rows: [ComponentChildren, ComponentChildren][] }) {
  return (
    <table class="kv"><tbody>{rows.filter(r => r[1] !== undefined).map(([k, v]) => <tr><th>{k}</th><td>{v}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
  );
}
```

`viewer/src/pipeline.tsx`:

```tsx
// The pipeline: the timeline of every event in GPU order, grouped by pass, and an inspector for the selected one.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { cached, get, type Binding, type Draw, type EventDetail, type Group, type ResultOut, type Row } from "./api";
import { Thumb, type Picture } from "./image";
import { BytesView, ConstantsTable, EventLink, KV, ModeSelect, ResLink, Section, ShaderLink, Stack, useCtx } from "./parts";
import {
  ADDRESS, BLEND, BLEND_OP, COMPARISON, CULL, FILL, STENCIL_OP, compact, filterName, go, href, Loading, short,
  topologyName, useAsync, writeMask,
} from "./util";
import { formatName } from "../server/format";

const ROW = 20;
const KINDS = ["draw", "dispatch", "clear", "copy", "update", "map", "map_read", "resolve", "mips"];

interface Filter {
  kinds: string[] | null;
  shader: string;
  pass: string;
  resource: string;
  text: string;
}

const EMPTY: Filter = { kinds: null, shader: "", pass: "", resource: "", text: "" };

function loadFilter(): Filter {
  try {
    return { ...EMPTY, ...JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("locum-filter") ?? "{}") };
  } catch {
    return EMPTY;
  }
}

/** A one-line summary of what an event did. */
function summary(r: Row): string {
  let a: any = r.args;
  try {
    a = JSON.parse(r.args);
  } catch {}
  switch (r.kind) {
    case "draw":
      return `#${r.draw} ${Array.isArray(a) ? `[${a.join(",")}]` : r.args}  vs ${short(r.vs, 8)} ps ${short(r.ps, 8)}`;
    case "dispatch":
      return `#${r.draw} ${Array.isArray(a) ? `[${a.join(",")}]` : r.args}  cs ${short(r.cs, 8)}`;
    case "update":
      return `→ #${a?.dst} sub ${a?.sub}${a?.box ? ` box ${compact(a.box)}` : ""}`;
    case "map":
    case "map_read":
      return `#${a?.resource} sub ${a?.sub}${a?.ranges ? ` ${a.ranges.map((x: number[]) => `${x[0]}..${x[1]}`).join(" ")}` : ""}`;
    case "copy":
      return `#${a?.src} → #${a?.dst}${a?.dst_sub != null ? ` sub ${a.dst_sub}` : ""}`;
    case "clear":
      return `view #${a?.view}${a?.color ? ` ${compact(a.color)}` : a?.depth != null ? ` depth ${a.depth} stencil ${a.stencil}` : a?.values ? ` ${compact(a.values)}` : ""}`;
  }
  return typeof a === "string" ? a : compact(a);
}

export function Pipeline({ seq }: { seq: number | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const timeline = useAsync(() => cached<{ rows: Row[]; groups: Group[] }>(`c/${id}/timeline`), [id]);
  return (
    <div class="pipeline">
      <Loading state={timeline}>{() => <Timeline rows={timeline.data!.rows} groups={timeline.data!.groups} seq={seq} />}</Loading>
      <div class="inspector">
        {seq == null ? <div class="muted pad">Select an event (j/k step through them, J/K draws, [ ] passes).</div>
          : <Inspector seq={seq} rows={timeline.data?.rows ?? null} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type Item = { group: number } | { row: Row; index: number };

function Timeline({ rows, groups, seq }: { rows: Row[]; groups: Group[]; seq: number | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const [filter, setFilterState] = useState<Filter>(loadFilter);
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [scroll, setScroll] = useState(0);
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(600);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const setFilter = (f: Filter) => {
    setFilterState(f);
    sessionStorage.setItem("locum-filter", JSON.stringify(f));
  };

  const resourceId = /^\s*#?\d+\s*$/.test(filter.resource) ? Number(filter.resource.replace("#", "")) : null;
  const touching = useAsync(() => resourceId == null ? null
    : get<{ events: { seq: number; access: string }[] }>(`c/${id}/resource/${resourceId}`), [id, resourceId]);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const kinds = filter.kinds ? new Set(filter.kinds) : null;
    const shader = filter.shader.trim().toLowerCase();
    const passes = filter.pass.trim() ? new Set(filter.pass.split(/[ ,]+/).filter(Boolean).flatMap(p => {
      const m = p.match(/^(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?$/);
      if (!m) return [];
      const a = Number(m[1]), b = m[2] ? Number(m[2]) : a;
      return Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, Math.min(b - a + 1, 10000)) }, (_, i) => a + i);
    })) : null;
    const text = filter.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    const seqs = resourceId != null && touching.data ? new Set(touching.data.events.map(e => e.seq)) : null;
    return rows.filter(r =>
      (!kinds || kinds.has(r.kind)) &&
      (!shader || [r.vs, r.hs, r.ds, r.gs, r.ps, r.cs].some(s => s?.startsWith(shader))) &&
      (!passes || (r.pass != null && passes.has(r.pass))) &&
      (!seqs || seqs.has(r.seq)) &&
      (!text || r.call.toLowerCase().includes(text) || r.args.toLowerCase().includes(text) || (r.data ?? "").startsWith(text)));
  }, [rows, filter, touching.data]);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Item[] = [];
    let last = -1;
    visible.forEach((row, index) => {
      if (row.group !== last) {
        out.push({ group: row.group });
        last = row.group;
      }
      if (!collapsed.has(row.group)) out.push({ row, index });
    });
    return out;
  }, [visible, collapsed]);

  const position = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<number, number>();
    items.forEach((it, i) => "row" in it && m.set(it.row.seq, i));
    return m;
  }, [items]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = list.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setHeight(el.clientHeight));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  // Keep the selection in view.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = list.current;
    if (seq == null || !el) return;
    const i = position.get(seq);
    if (i == null) return;
    const top = i * ROW;
    if (top < el.scrollTop + ROW) el.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top - ROW * 3);
    else if (top > el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight - ROW * 2) el.scrollTop = top - el.clientHeight + ROW * 4;
  }, [seq, position]);

  // Keyboard stepping through what the filter shows.
  useEffect(() => {
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (t instanceof HTMLInputElement || t instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || t instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || document.querySelector(".lightbox")) return;
      const at = seq == null ? -1 : visible.findIndex(r => r.seq === seq);
      let next: Row | undefined;
      const find = (from: number, step: number, ok: (r: Row) => boolean) => {
        for (let i = from + step; i >= 0 && i < visible.length; i += step) if (ok(visible[i]!)) return visible[i];
        return undefined;
      };
      const cur = at >= 0 ? visible[at] : undefined;
      switch (e.key) {
        case "j": case "ArrowDown": next = visible[Math.min(at + 1, visible.length - 1)]; break;
        case "k": case "ArrowUp": next = visible[Math.max(at - 1, 0)]; break;
        case "J": next = find(at, 1, r => r.draw != null); break;
        case "K": next = find(at, -1, r => r.draw != null); break;
        case "]": next = find(at, 1, r => r.group !== cur?.group); break;
        case "[": {
          const first = find(at, -1, r => r.group !== cur?.group);
          next = first ? visible.find(r => r.group === first.group) : undefined;
          break;
        }
        case "Home": next = visible[0]; break;
        case "End": next = visible[visible.length - 1]; break;
        case "PageDown": next = visible[Math.min(at + 20, visible.length - 1)]; break;
        case "PageUp": next = visible[Math.max(at - 20, 0)]; break;
        default: return;
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      if (next) go(href(id, "pipeline", next.seq), true);
    };
    addEventListener("keydown", k);
    return () => removeEventListener("keydown", k);
  }, [visible, seq, id]);

  const first = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scroll / ROW) - 10);
  const last = Math.min(items.length, Math.ceil((scroll + height) / ROW) + 10);
  const kinds = filter.kinds ?? KINDS;
  const present = useMemo(() => new Set(rows.map(r => r.kind)), [rows]);

  return (
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="filters">
        <div class="kinds">
          {KINDS.filter(k => present.has(k)).map(k => (
            <label class={`kind k-${k}`}><input type="checkbox" checked={kinds.includes(k)} onChange={() => {
              const s = new Set(kinds);
              s.has(k) ? s.delete(k) : s.add(k);
              setFilter({ ...filter, kinds: s.size === KINDS.length ? null : [...s] });
            }} />{k}</label>
          ))}
          <button class="link" onClick={() => setFilter({ ...filter, kinds: ["draw", "dispatch"] })}>draws only</button>
          <button class="link" onClick={() => setFilter({ ...filter, kinds: null })}>all</button>
        </div>
        <div class="filter-fields">
          <input placeholder="shader hash" value={filter.shader} onInput={e => setFilter({ ...filter, shader: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value })} />
          <input placeholder="pass (3, 5-9)" value={filter.pass} onInput={e => setFilter({ ...filter, pass: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value })} />
          <input placeholder="resource #" value={filter.resource} onInput={e => setFilter({ ...filter, resource: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value })} />
          <input placeholder="call / args / data" value={filter.text} onInput={e => setFilter({ ...filter, text: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value })} />
          {JSON.stringify(filter) !== JSON.stringify(EMPTY) ? <button class="link" onClick={() => setFilter(EMPTY)}>clear</button> : null}
        </div>
        <div class="muted small">
          {visible.length.toLocaleString()} of {rows.length.toLocaleString()} events
          {touching.loading && resourceId != null ? " (finding the events touching it…)" : ""}
          {" · "}<button class="link" onClick={() => setCollapsed(new Set(groups.map((_, i) => i)))}>collapse</button>
          {" "}<button class="link" onClick={() => setCollapsed(new Set())}>expand</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="rows" ref={list} onScroll={e => setScroll((e.target as HTMLDivElement).scrollTop)}>
        <div style={{ height: `${items.length * ROW}px`, position: "relative" }}>
          {items.slice(first, last).map((it, i) => {
            const top = (first + i) * ROW;
            if ("group" in it) {
              const g = groups[it.group]!;
              const shown = visible.filter(r => r.group === it.group).length;
              return (
                <div class="row group" style={{ top: `${top}px` }} title={g.label} onClick={() => {
                  const s = new Set(collapsed);
                  s.has(it.group) ? s.delete(it.group) : s.add(it.group);
                  setCollapsed(s);
                }}>
                  <span class="twisty">{collapsed.has(it.group) ? "▸" : "▾"}</span> {g.label} <span class="muted">({shown})</span>
                </div>
              );
            }
            const r = it.row;
            return (
              <a class={`row k-${r.kind}${r.seq === seq ? " sel" : ""}`} style={{ top: `${top}px` }} href={href(id, "pipeline", r.seq)}>
                <span class="seq">{r.seq}</span>
                <span class="call">{r.call}</span>
                <span class="sum">{summary(r)}</span>
                {r.deferred ? <span class="ctx" title={`recorded on context ${r.context}, command list ${r.list}`}>L{r.list}</span> : null}
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Inspector({ seq, rows }: { seq: number; rows: Row[] | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const row = rows?.find(r => r.seq === seq);
  const ev = useAsync(() => get<EventDetail>(`c/${id}/event/${seq}`), [id, seq]);
  const drawN = row?.draw ?? ev.data?.draw ?? null;
  const index = rows ? rows.findIndex(r => r.seq === seq) : -1;
  const prev = index > 0 ? rows![index - 1] : null, next = rows && index >= 0 && index < rows.length - 1 ? rows[index + 1] : null;
  return (
    <div>
      <div class="insp-nav">
        {prev ? <a href={href(id, "pipeline", prev.seq)}>← event {prev.seq}</a> : <span />}
        <span class="muted">event {seq}{row?.pass != null ? `, pass ${row.pass}` : ""}</span>
        {next ? <a href={href(id, "pipeline", next.seq)}>event {next.seq} →</a> : <span />}
      </div>
      {drawN != null ? <DrawView n={drawN} /> : <Loading state={ev}>{() => <EventView e={ev.data!} />}</Loading>}
    </div>
  );
}

function EventView({ e }: { e: EventDetail }) {
  return (
    <div class="detail">
      <h2>{e.call} <span class="muted">{e.kind}, event {e.seq}</span></h2>
      <KV rows={[
        ["context", e.deferred ? `deferred context ${e.context}, command list ${e.list} (placed where it was executed)` : `immediate (${e.context})`],
        ["pass", e.pass ?? "-"],
        ["arguments", <code class="wrap">{typeof e.args === "string" ? e.args : JSON.stringify(e.args, null, 1)}</code>],
        ...(e.view ? [["view", <span>#{e.view.id} {e.view.kind} {e.view.format} of <ResLink r={e.view.resource} /></span>] as [string, any]] : []),
        ["read", e.reads.length ? e.reads.map(r => <div><ResLink r={r} /></div>) : <span class="muted">nothing</span>],
        ["wrote", e.writes.length ? e.writes.map(r => <div><ResLink r={r} /></div>) : <span class="muted">nothing</span>],
      ]} />
      {e.dataBlob ? (
        <Section title={`bytes written (${e.dataBlob.size?.toLocaleString() ?? "missing from the store"} bytes, ${short(e.dataBlob.key)})`}>
          {e.dataBlob.size != null ? <BytesView blob={e.dataBlob.key} total={e.dataBlob.size} /> : <div class="muted">not in the blob store</div>}
        </Section>
      ) : null}
      <Results results={e.results} />
      <Section title="call stack" open={false}><Stack frames={e.stackFrames} /></Section>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Output of a shader whose writes depend on the GPU's thread order (atomics), recorded right after the event. */
function Results({ results }: { results: ResultOut[] }) {
  if (!results.length) return null;
  return (
    <Section title={`order-dependent: output recorded for ${results.map(r => `#${r.resource.id}`).join(", ")}`}>
      <div class="muted small">its shader's writes depend on the order the GPU runs threads in, so the capture keeps what
        the game's GPU wrote; replay says how its own output compared (identical, the same records in another order, or
        different in more than order) and then puts these bytes in place and goes on from them</div>
      {results.map(r => (
        <div class="result-out">
          <div><ResLink r={r.resource} /> <span class="muted">contents right after it, {short(r.content, 16)}{r.size == null ? ", not in the blob store" : `, ${r.size.toLocaleString()} bytes`}</span></div>
          {r.size != null ? <BytesView blob={r.content} total={r.size} stride={r.stride || 16} /> : null}
        </div>
      ))}
    </Section>
  );
}

const STAGES = ["vs", "hs", "ds", "gs", "ps", "cs"];

export function DrawView({ n }: { n: number }) {
  const { id, openPicture } = useCtx();
  const d = useAsync(() => get<Draw>(`c/${id}/draw/${n}`), [id, n]);
  return (
    <Loading state={d}>{() => {
      const draw = d.data!;
      const byStage = new Map<string, Binding[]>();
      for (const b of draw.bindings) byStage.set(b.stage, [...(byStage.get(b.stage) ?? []), b]);
      const isCompute = !!draw.shaders.cs;
      const textures = draw.bindings.filter(b => (b.kind === "srv" || b.kind === "uav") && b.resource?.kind && b.resource.kind !== "buffer" && b.resource.content);
      const pics: Picture[] = draw.targets.map(t => ({
        id, src: { kind: "target", draw: t.draw, name: t.name }, width: t.width, height: t.height,
        title: `${t.name} after pass ${draw.pass ?? ""} (draw ${t.draw}): #${t.resource} ${t.formatName}`,
        before: t.before ? { src: t.before.source, label: t.before.label, writesBetween: t.writesBetween } : null,
      }));
      return (
        <div class="detail">
          <h2>
            {isCompute ? "dispatch" : "draw"} {draw.n} <span class="muted">{draw.call} {compact(draw.args)}</span>
          </h2>
          <div class="insp-nav">
            {draw.prev ? <a href={href(id, "pipeline", draw.prev.event)}>← draw {draw.prev.n}</a> : <span />}
            <span class="muted">
              event <EventLink seq={draw.event}>{draw.event}</EventLink>
              {draw.passRange ? <>, pass {draw.passRange.n} (draws {draw.passRange.first}–{draw.passRange.last}{draw.passRange.last === draw.n ? ", its last" : ""})</> : null}
              {draw.eventRow?.deferred ? `, command list ${draw.eventRow.list} (recorded on context ${draw.eventRow.context})` : ", immediate context"}
            </span>
            {draw.next ? <a href={href(id, "pipeline", draw.next.event)}>draw {draw.next.n} →</a> : <span />}
          </div>

          <Section title="shaders">
            <KV rows={STAGES.filter(s => draw.shaders[s]).map(s => [s, <ShaderLink hash={draw.shaders[s]!} />])} />
          </Section>

          {!isCompute ? <PipelineState draw={draw} /> : null}

          <Section title={`bindings (${draw.bindings.length})`}>
            <table class="bindings">
              <thead><tr><th>stage</th><th>slot</th><th>view</th><th>resource</th><th>contents</th><th>last written</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {[...byStage].flatMap(([stage, bs]) => bs.map((b, i) => <BindingRow b={b} first={i === 0} stage={stage} />))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </Section>

          <Section title="constants" extra={<ModeSelect />}>
            {draw.bindings.filter(b => b.kind === "cb").map(b => (
              <ConstantsTable title={<span><b>{b.stage} b{b.slot}</b>{b.resource ? <> <ResLink r={b.resource}>#{b.resource.id}</ResLink></> : null}{b.offset ? ` @${b.offset}` : ""}</span>} constants={b.constants!} />
            ))}
            {!draw.bindings.some(b => b.kind === "cb") ? <div class="muted">no constant buffers bound</div> : null}
          </Section>

          <Section title={pics.length ? `targets read back after the pass (draw ${draw.targets[0]?.draw})` : "targets"}>
            {pics.length ? <div class="thumbs">{pics.map(p => <Thumb pic={p} open={openPicture} size={220} />)}</div>
              : <div class="muted">{draw.passRange ? "none were read back for this pass" : "a dispatch has no targets; see its UAVs above"}</div>}
          </Section>

          {textures.length ? (
            <Section title={`textures it reads (${textures.length}), contents as the frame began`}>
              <div class="thumbs">
                {textures.map(b => {
                  const r = b.resource!;
                  const mip = Number(b.view?.json?.range?.first_mip ?? b.view?.json?.range?.mip ?? 0) || 0;
                  const w = Math.max(1, (r.width ?? 1) >> mip), h = Math.max(1, (r.height ?? 1) >> mip);
                  return <Thumb open={openPicture} size={120} pic={{
                    id, src: { kind: "resource", id: r.id, sub: mip }, width: w, height: h,
                    title: `${b.stage} ${b.kind}${b.slot} #${r.id} ${b.view?.formatName ?? ""}${mip ? ` mip ${mip}` : ""}`,
                  }} />;
                })}
              </div>
            </Section>
          ) : null}

          <Results results={draw.results} />

          <Section title="call stack" open={false}><Stack frames={draw.eventRow?.stackFrames ?? []} /></Section>
        </div>
      );
    }}</Loading>
  );
}

function BindingRow({ b, first, stage }: { b: Binding; first: boolean; stage: string }) {
  const r = b.resource;
  let view = "";
  if (b.view) view = `#${b.view.id} ${b.view.json?.dimension ?? ""} ${b.view.formatName} ${b.view.json?.range ? compact(b.view.json.range) : ""}`;
  else if (b.kind === "vb") view = `offset ${b.offset} stride ${b.stride}`;
  else if (b.kind === "ib") view = `${b.formatName} offset ${b.offset}`;
  else if (b.kind === "cb") view = `offset ${b.offset ?? 0} size ${b.size}`;
  else if (b.kind === "so") view = `offset ${b.offset}`;
  return (
    <tr class={first ? "stage-first" : ""}>
      <td class="stage">{first ? stage : ""}</td>
      <td class="slot">{b.kind}{b.slot}{b.space ? ` space${b.space}` : ""}</td>
      <td>{b.kind === "sampler" && b.state ? <SamplerText s={b.state.json} /> : view}</td>
      <td>{r ? <ResLink r={r} /> : b.kind === "sampler" ? <span class="muted">#{b.state?.id}</span> : <span class="muted">-</span>}</td>
      <td>{r ? (r.content ? <span title={r.contentNote ?? ""}>{short(r.content)} <span class="muted">({r.contentSource})</span>{r.contentNote ? " ⚠" : ""}</span>
        : <span class="muted">{r.contentNote ?? "not captured"}</span>) : null}</td>
      <td>{r?.lastWrite != null ? <EventLink seq={r.lastWrite}>{r.lastWrite}</EventLink> : <span class="muted">{r ? "not this frame" : ""}</span>}</td>
    </tr>
  );
}

function SamplerText({ s }: { s: any }) {
  if (!s) return null;
  return <span title={compact(s)}>{filterName(s.filter)}; {s.address?.map((a: number) => ADDRESS[a] ?? a).join("/")}{s.compare && s.filter & 0x80 ? `; compare ${COMPARISON[s.compare]}` : ""}{s.max_anisotropy > 1 ? `; aniso ${s.max_anisotropy}` : ""}{s.mip_lod_bias ? `; bias ${s.mip_lod_bias}` : ""}</span>;
}

function PipelineState({ draw }: { draw: Draw }) {
  const rs = draw.rasterizer?.json, bl = draw.blend?.json, ds = draw.depthStencil?.json, layout = draw.layout?.json;
  return (
    <Section title="pipeline state">
      <div class="state-grid">
        <div>
          <h4>input assembly</h4>
          <KV rows={[["topology", `${topologyName(draw.topology)} (${draw.topology})`], ["layout", draw.layout ? `#${draw.layout.id}` : "none"]]} />
          {Array.isArray(layout) && layout.length ? (
            <table class="small-table">
              <thead><tr><th>semantic</th><th>format</th><th>slot</th><th>offset</th><th>rate</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{layout.map((e: any) => <tr><td>{e.semantic}{e.index ? e.index : ""}</td><td>{formatName(e.format)}</td><td>{e.slot}</td><td>{e.offset}</td><td>{e.per_instance ? `instance/${e.step}` : "vertex"}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
            </table>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4>rasterizer</h4>
          {rs ? <KV rows={[
            ["fill / cull", `${FILL[rs.fill] ?? rs.fill} / ${CULL[rs.cull] ?? rs.cull}${rs.front_ccw ? ", front ccw" : ""}`],
            ["depth bias", `${rs.depth_bias}, clamp ${rs.depth_bias_clamp}, slope ${rs.slope_scaled_depth_bias}`],
            ["depth clip / scissor", `${rs.depth_clip} / ${rs.scissor}`],
            ["msaa / aa lines", `${rs.multisample} / ${rs.antialiased_line}`],
          ]} /> : <span class="muted">default</span>}
          <h4>viewports</h4>
          {draw.viewports.map(v => <div class="mono small">{v.i}: {v.x},{v.y} {v.width}x{v.height} depth {v.min_depth}..{v.max_depth}</div>)}
          {draw.scissors.length ? <><h4>scissors</h4>{draw.scissors.map(s => <div class="mono small">{s.i}: ({s.left}, {s.top})-({s.right}, {s.bottom})</div>)}</> : null}
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4>depth-stencil</h4>
          {ds ? <KV rows={[
            ["depth", ds.depth ? `test ${COMPARISON[ds.func] ?? ds.func}, write ${ds.write}` : "off"],
            ["stencil", ds.stencil ? `ref ${draw.stencilRef}, read ${ds.read_mask} write ${ds.write_mask}` : "off"],
            ...(ds.stencil ? [
              ["front", `${COMPARISON[ds.front.func]}: pass ${STENCIL_OP[ds.front.pass]}, fail ${STENCIL_OP[ds.front.fail]}, depth fail ${STENCIL_OP[ds.front.depth_fail]}`],
              ["back", `${COMPARISON[ds.back.func]}: pass ${STENCIL_OP[ds.back.pass]}, fail ${STENCIL_OP[ds.back.fail]}, depth fail ${STENCIL_OP[ds.back.depth_fail]}`],
            ] as [string, string][] : []),
          ]} /> : <span class="muted">default</span>}
          <h4>blend</h4>
          <KV rows={[["factor / sample mask", `${compact(draw.blendFactor)} / 0x${((draw.sampleMask ?? 0xffffffff) >>> 0).toString(16)}`],
            ["alpha to coverage / independent", bl ? `${bl.alpha_to_coverage} / ${bl.independent}` : "-"]]} />
          {bl ? (
            <table class="small-table">
              <thead><tr><th>rt</th><th>colour</th><th>alpha</th><th>write</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{(bl.independent ? bl.targets : bl.targets.slice(0, 1)).map((t: any, i: number) => (
                <tr><td>{bl.independent ? i : "all"}</td>
                  <td>{t.blend ? `${BLEND[t.src]} ${BLEND_OP[t.op]} ${BLEND[t.dst]}` : "off"}</td>
                  <td>{t.blend ? `${BLEND[t.src_alpha]} ${BLEND_OP[t.op_alpha]} ${BLEND[t.dst_alpha]}` : ""}</td>
                  <td>{writeMask(t.write_mask)}</td></tr>
              ))}</tbody>
            </table>
          ) : null}
          {draw.predicate != null ? <KV rows={[["predicate", `#${draw.predicate} = ${draw.predicateValue}`]]} /> : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Section>
  );
}

```

`viewer/src/resources.tsx`:

```tsx
// Resources: every resource alive at the capture, and one in detail: description, creation stack, what the frame
// did with it, and its contents.

import { useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from "preact/hooks";
import { cached, get } from "./api";
import { Thumb, Viewer, type Picture } from "./image";
import { BytesView, EventLink, KV, Section, Stack, useCtx } from "./parts";
import { href, Loading, mib, short, useAsync, compact } from "./util";
import { formatName } from "../server/format";

type ResRow = [number, string, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, string | null, number, number, number];

const ROW = 20;

function shapeText(r: ResRow): string {
  const [, kind, w, h, d, mips, array, format, samples, , stride, , , misc] = r;
  if (kind === "buffer") return `${w} bytes${stride ? ` stride ${stride}` : ""}`;
  let t = `${w}`;
  if (kind !== "texture1d") t += `x${h}`;
  if (kind === "texture3d") t += `x${d}`;
  t += ` ${formatName(format)}`;
  if (mips > 1) t += ` ${mips} mips`;
  if (misc & 4) t += " cube";
  else if (array > 1) t += ` [${array}]`;
  if (samples > 1) t += ` ${samples}x`;
  return t;
}

export function Resources({ item }: { item: string | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const list = useAsync(() => cached<ResRow[]>(`c/${id}/resources`), [id]);
  return (
    <div class="split">
      <Loading state={list}>{() => <ResourceList rows={list.data!} selected={item ? Number(item) : null} />}</Loading>
      <div class="inspector">{item ? <ResourceView rid={Number(item)} /> : <div class="muted pad">Select a resource.</div>}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ResourceList({ rows, selected }: { rows: ResRow[]; selected: number | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const [used, setUsed] = useState(true);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [scroll, setScroll] = useState(0);
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(600);
  const el = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const shown = useMemo(() => {
    const t = text.trim().toLowerCase();
    return rows.filter(r => (!used || r[14]) && (!kind || r[1] === kind) &&
      (!t || `#${r[0]}`.includes(t) || shapeText(r).toLowerCase().includes(t)));
  }, [rows, used, kind, text]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const e = el.current;
    if (!e) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setHeight(e.clientHeight));
    ro.observe(e);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const e = el.current;
    if (selected == null || !e) return;
    const i = shown.findIndex(r => r[0] === selected);
    if (i >= 0 && (i * ROW < e.scrollTop || i * ROW > e.scrollTop + e.clientHeight - ROW)) e.scrollTop = Math.max(0, i * ROW - 100);
  }, [selected, shown]);
  const first = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scroll / ROW) - 10), last = Math.min(shown.length, Math.ceil((scroll + height) / ROW) + 10);
  return (
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="filters">
        <div class="filter-fields">
          <label><input type="checkbox" checked={used} onChange={() => setUsed(!used)} /> used by the frame</label>
          <select value={kind} onChange={e => setKind((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)}>
            <option value="">every kind</option>
            {["buffer", "texture1d", "texture2d", "texture3d"].map(k => <option value={k}>{k}</option>)}
          </select>
          <input placeholder="#id, size or format" value={text} onInput={e => setText((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} />
        </div>
        <div class="muted small">{shown.length.toLocaleString()} of {rows.length.toLocaleString()} resources</div>
      </div>
      <div class="rows" ref={el} onScroll={e => setScroll((e.target as HTMLDivElement).scrollTop)}>
        <div style={{ height: `${shown.length * ROW}px`, position: "relative" }}>
          {shown.slice(first, last).map((r, i) => (
            <a class={`row${r[0] === selected ? " sel" : ""}`} style={{ top: `${(first + i) * ROW}px` }} href={href(id, "resources", r[0])}>
              <span class="seq">#{r[0]}</span>
              <span class="call">{r[1]}</span>
              <span class="sum">{shapeText(r)}</span>
              <span class="ctx" title="w: written by the frame; c: contents captured">{r[15] ? "w" : ""}{r[17] ? "c" : ""}</span>
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ResourceView({ rid }: { rid: number }) {
  const { id, openPicture } = useCtx();
  const r = useAsync(() => get<any>(`c/${id}/resource/${rid}`), [id, rid]);
  const [sub, setSub] = useState(0);
  const [z, setZ] = useState(0);
  const [which, setWhich] = useState<"resource" | "upload">("resource");
  useEffect(() => { setSub(0); setZ(0); setWhich("resource"); }, [rid]);
  return (
    <Loading state={r}>{() => {
      const x = r.data!;
      const subs: any[] = x.subresources;
      const s = subs[sub];
      const hasPicture = x.kind !== "buffer" && (x.content || (x.upload && x.upload_stored));
      const src = which === "upload" || !x.content ? "upload" : "resource";
      const pic: Picture | null = hasPicture && s ? {
        id, src: { kind: src, id: rid, sub, z }, width: s.width, height: s.height,
        title: `#${rid} ${src === "upload" ? "upload" : "contents as the frame began"}, sub ${sub} (mip ${s.mip}, slice ${s.slice}${s.depth > 1 ? `, z ${z}` : ""})`,
      } : null;
      return (
        <div class="detail">
          <h2>{x.text}</h2>
          <KV rows={[
            ["usage / bind", `${x.usageName} / ${x.bindNames.join(", ") || "none"}${x.cpu ? `, cpu 0x${x.cpu.toString(16)}` : ""}${x.misc ? `, misc 0x${x.misc.toString(16)}` : ""}`],
            ["size", `${mib(x.bytes)} (${x.bytes.toLocaleString()} bytes in the canonical layout)`],
            ["created", `frame ${x.created_frame ?? "?"}`],
            ["this frame", `${x.used ? "used" : "not used"}${x.written ? ", written" : ""}`],
            ["contents", x.content ? <span>{short(x.content, 32)} <span class="muted">({x.content_source}{x.contentPresent ? "" : ", not in the store"})</span>{x.content_note ? <div class="warn">{x.content_note}</div> : null}</span>
              : <span class="muted">{x.content_note ?? "not captured"}</span>],
            ["upload", x.upload ? <span>{short(x.upload, 32)} <span class="muted">({x.upload_stored ? "stored" : "hash only"})</span></span> : <span class="muted">none</span>],
            ["updated", x.update_count ? `${x.update_count} times, last in frame ${x.updated_frame}` : "never"],
          ]} />
          {pic ? (
            <Section title="picture" extra={
              <span class="pic-controls">
                {x.content && x.upload_stored && x.upload !== x.content ? (
                  <span class="seg"><button class={which === "resource" ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setWhich("resource")}>contents</button><button class={which === "upload" ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setWhich("upload")}>upload</button></span>
                ) : null}
                {subs.length > 1 ? <select value={sub} onChange={e => setSub(Number((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value))}>
                  {subs.map(u => <option value={u.sub}>sub {u.sub}: mip {u.mip} slice {u.slice} {u.width}x{u.height}{u.depth > 1 ? `x${u.depth}` : ""}</option>)}
                </select> : null}
                {s && s.depth > 1 ? <input class="small" type="number" min={0} max={s.depth - 1} value={z} onChange={e => setZ(Number((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value))} /> : null}
              </span>
            }>
              <div class="inline-viewer"><Viewer key={`${rid}-${src}-${sub}-${z}`} pic={pic} /></div>
            </Section>
          ) : null}
          {x.kind === "buffer" && (x.content || x.upload_stored) ? (
            <Section title="contents">
              <BytesView blob={x.content && x.contentPresent ? x.content : x.upload} total={x.bytes} stride={x.stride || 16} />
            </Section>
          ) : null}
          <Section title={`events that touched it (${x.events.length})`}>
            {x.events.length ? (
              <table class="small-table">
                <thead><tr><th>event</th><th>access</th><th>call</th><th>draw</th><th>pass</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{x.events.map((e: any) => <tr><td><EventLink seq={e.seq}>{e.seq}</EventLink></td><td>{e.access}</td><td>{e.call}</td><td>{e.draw ?? ""}</td><td>{e.pass ?? ""}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
              </table>
            ) : <div class="muted">none</div>}
          </Section>
          <Section title={`bound to draws (${x.bindings.length})`} open={x.bindings.length < 50}>
            <BindingsOf rows={x.bindings} />
          </Section>
          {x.targets.length ? (
            <Section title={`read back after passes (${x.targets.length})`}>
              <div class="thumbs">{x.targets.map((t: any) => <Thumb open={openPicture} size={160} pic={{
                id, src: { kind: "target", draw: t.draw, name: t.target }, width: t.width, height: t.height,
                title: `${t.target} after draw ${t.draw}`,
              }} />)}</div>
            </Section>
          ) : null}
          <Section title={`views (${x.views.length})`} open={false}>
            <table class="small-table"><tbody>{x.views.map((v: any) => <tr><td>#{v.id}</td><td>{v.kind}</td><td>{v.formatName}</td><td class="mono small">{compact(v.json)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
          </Section>
          <Section title="created at"><Stack frames={x.createdStackFrames} /></Section>
          {x.updatedStackFrames.length ? <Section title="last updated at" open={false}><Stack frames={x.updatedStackFrames} /></Section> : null}
          <Section title={`subresources (${subs.length})`} open={false}>
            <table class="small-table"><thead><tr><th>sub</th><th>mip</th><th>slice</th><th>size</th><th>offset</th><th>bytes</th><th>hash</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{subs.map(u => <tr><td>{u.sub}</td><td>{u.mip}</td><td>{u.slice}</td><td>{u.width}x{u.height}{u.depth > 1 ? `x${u.depth}` : ""}</td><td>{u.offset}</td><td>{u.size}</td><td class="mono">{short(u.hash, 16)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
          </Section>
        </div>
      );
    }}</Loading>
  );
}

function BindingsOf({ rows }: { rows: any[] }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const timeline = useAsync(() => cached<{ rows: { seq: number; draw: number | null }[] }>(`c/${id}/timeline`), [id]);
  const seqOf = useMemo(() => new Map((timeline.data?.rows ?? []).filter(r => r.draw != null).map(r => [r.draw!, r.seq])), [timeline.data]);
  if (!rows.length) return <div class="muted">none</div>;
  return (
    <div class="chips">
      {rows.map(b => {
        const seq = seqOf.get(b.draw);
        const label = `${b.draw} ${b.stage} ${b.kind}${b.slot}`;
        return seq != null ? <a class="chip" href={href(id, "pipeline", seq)}>{label}</a> : <span class="chip">{label}</span>;
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`viewer/src/shaders.tsx`:

```tsx
// Shaders: the ones the frame used, each with its reflection, the draws that ran it, and its disassembly.

import { useMemo, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { cached, get, text } from "./api";
import { KV, Section, useCtx } from "./parts";
import { href, Loading, mib, useAsync } from "./util";

interface ShaderRow {
  hash: string;
  stage: string;
  size: number;
  has_blob: number;
  draws: number;
}

export function Shaders({ item }: { item: string | null }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const list = useAsync(() => cached<ShaderRow[]>(`c/${id}/shaders`), [id]);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState("");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const shown = useMemo(() => (list.data ?? []).filter(s => (!stage || s.stage === stage) && s.hash.startsWith(q.trim().toLowerCase())), [list.data, stage, q]);
  return (
    <div class="split">
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="filters">
          <div class="filter-fields">
            <select value={stage} onChange={e => setStage((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)}>
              <option value="">every stage</option>{["vs", "hs", "ds", "gs", "ps", "cs"].map(s => <option value={s}>{s}</option>)}
            </select>
            <input placeholder="hash" value={q} onInput={e => setQ((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)} />
          </div>
          <div class="muted small">{shown.length} shaders</div>
        </div>
        <div class="rows plain">
          <Loading state={list}>{() => shown.map(s => (
            <a class={`row static${s.hash === item ? " sel" : ""}`} href={href(id, "shaders", s.hash)}>
              <span class="call">{s.stage}</span><span class="seq mono">{s.hash}</span><span class="sum">{s.draws} draws</span>
            </a>
          ))}</Loading>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="inspector">{item ? <ShaderView hash={item} /> : <div class="muted pad">Select a shader.</div>}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ShaderView({ hash }: { hash: string }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const s = useAsync(() => get<any>(`c/${id}/shader/${hash}`), [id, hash]);
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const timeline = useAsync(() => cached<{ rows: { seq: number; draw: number | null }[] }>(`c/${id}/timeline`), [id]);
  const seqOf = useMemo(() => new Map((timeline.data?.rows ?? []).filter(r => r.draw != null).map(r => [r.draw!, r.seq])), [timeline.data]);
  return (
    <Loading state={s}>{() => {
      const x = s.data!;
      return (
        <div class="detail">
          <h2>{x.stage} {x.hash}</h2>
          <KV rows={[["bytecode", x.blob ? `${mib(x.size ?? 0)}, blob ${x.blob}${x.blobPresent ? "" : " (not in the store)"}` : "not captured"],
            ["draws", `${x.draws.length}`]]} />
          <Section title={`draws that ran it (${x.draws.length})`} open={x.draws.length <= 200}>
            <div class="chips">{x.draws.map((n: number) => seqOf.has(n) ? <a class="chip" href={href(id, "pipeline", seqOf.get(n)!)}>{n}</a> : <span class="chip">{n}</span>)}</div>
          </Section>
          <Section title="constant buffers (reflection)">
            {x.reflection ? x.reflection.map((cb: any) => (
              <div class="cb">
                <div class="cb-title"><b>{cb.name}</b> <span class="muted">{cb.slot != null ? `b${cb.slot}${cb.space ? ` space${cb.space}` : ""}` : "not bound"}, {cb.size} bytes</span></div>
                <table class="small-table">
                  <thead><tr><th>offset</th><th>size</th><th>type</th><th>name</th><th>used</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{cb.variables.map((v: any) => <tr class={v.used ? "" : "dim"}><td>{v.offset}</td><td>{v.size}</td><td>{v.type}</td><td>{v.name}</td><td>{v.used ? "yes" : ""}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )) : <div class="muted">no reflection (the bytecode has no RDEF chunk, or it was stripped)</div>}
          </Section>
          <Section title="disassembly" extra={!show ? <button onClick={() => setShow(true)}>disassemble</button> : null}>
            {show ? <Disassembly hash={hash} /> : <div class="muted">locum-cli disassembles it on request</div>}
          </Section>
        </div>
      );
    }}</Loading>
  );
}

function Disassembly({ hash }: { hash: string }) {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const d = useAsync(() => text(`c/${id}/shader/${hash}/disasm`), [id, hash]);
  return <Loading state={d}>{() => <pre class="disasm">{d.data}</pre>}</Loading>;
}
```

`viewer/src/sql.tsx`:

```tsx
// A read-only SQL console over the capture.db, with the schema beside it.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import { post } from "./api";
import { href, useAsync } from "./util";
import { useCtx } from "./parts";

interface Result {
  columns: string[];
  rows: any[][];
  truncated: boolean;
  ms: number;
}

const EXAMPLES: [string, string][] = [
  ["draws per pass", "SELECT pass, count(*) AS draws, min(n) AS first, max(n) AS last FROM draws GROUP BY pass ORDER BY pass"],
  ["most used pixel shaders", "SELECT ps, count(*) AS draws FROM draws WHERE ps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ps ORDER BY draws DESC LIMIT 50"],
  ["largest textures used", "SELECT id, width, height, mips, format, bytes FROM resources WHERE used = 1 AND kind != 'buffer' ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50"],
  ["what wrote a resource", "SELECT e.seq, e.kind, e.call, e.draw FROM event_resources er JOIN events e ON e.seq = er.event WHERE er.resource = 1 AND er.access = 'write'"],
  ["textures each draw reads", "SELECT b.draw, b.stage, b.slot, b.resource, r.width, r.height, r.format FROM bindings b JOIN resources r ON r.id = b.resource WHERE b.kind = 'srv' AND r.kind != 'buffer' LIMIT 200"],
  ["gaps", "SELECT * FROM gaps"],
];

export function Sql() {
  const { id } = useCtx();
  const [sql, setSql] = useState(() => sessionStorage.getItem("locum-sql") ?? EXAMPLES[0]![1]);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<Result | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const area = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const schema = useAsync(() => post<Result>(`c/${id}/sql`, { sql: "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name" }), [id]);

  async function run(text = sql) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    sessionStorage.setItem("locum-sql", text);
    try {
      setResult(await post<Result>(`c/${id}/sql`, { sql: text }));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
      setResult(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { area.current?.focus(); }, []);

  return (
    <div class="sql">
      <div class="sql-main">
        <textarea ref={area} value={sql} spellcheck={false} onInput={e => setSql((e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).value)}
          onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault(); run(); } }} />
        <div class="sql-bar">
          <button onClick={() => run()} disabled={busy}>run (Ctrl+Enter)</button>
          <span class="muted">the database is opened read-only; at most 2,000 rows are shown</span>
          {result ? <span class="muted">{result.rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows{result.truncated ? " (truncated)" : ""} in {result.ms} ms</span> : null}
        </div>
        {error ? <div class="error">{error}</div> : null}
        {result ? <ResultTable r={result} id={id} /> : null}
      </div>
      <div class="sql-side">
        <h4>examples</h4>
        {EXAMPLES.map(([name, q]) => <div><button class="link" onClick={() => { setSql(q); run(q); }}>{name}</button></div>)}
        <h4>tables</h4>
        {schema.data?.rows.map(([name, def]) => (
          <details><summary><button class="link" onClick={e => { e.preventDefault(); const q = `SELECT * FROM ${name} LIMIT 100`; setSql(q); run(q); }}>{name}</button></summary><pre class="schema">{def}</pre></details>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Links for columns whose values name something the viewer can show. */
function cell(col: string, v: any, id: string) {
  if (v && typeof v === "object" && "blob" in v) return <span class="muted" title={v.hex}>blob {v.blob} B</span>;
  if (v == null) return <span class="muted">NULL</span>;
  const c = col.toLowerCase();
  if (typeof v === "number" && ["resource", "dst", "src", "resource_id"].includes(c)) return <a href={href(id, "resources", v)}>{v}</a>;
  if (typeof v === "number" && ["seq", "event"].includes(c)) return <a href={href(id, "pipeline", v)}>{v}</a>;
  if (typeof v === "string" && /^(vs|hs|ds|gs|ps|cs|hash)$/.test(c) && /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/.test(v)) return <a href={href(id, "shaders", v)}>{v}</a>;
  return String(v);
}

function ResultTable({ r, id }: { r: Result; id: string }) {
  return (
    <div class="result">
      <table class="grid">
        <thead><tr>{r.columns.map(c => <th>{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
        <tbody>{r.rows.map(row => <tr>{row.map((v, i) => <td>{cell(r.columns[i]!, v, id)}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "preact/hooks";
import type { ComponentChildren } from "preact";

// ---- routing: everything the page shows is in the hash, so links, reloads and back work ----------------------------

export interface Route {
  /** The capture's id, or null on the open page. */
  id: string | null;
  /** info, pipeline, resources, shaders, sql */
  tab: string;
  /** The selected item: an event's seq, a resource id, a shader hash. */
  item: string | null;
  params: URLSearchParams;
}

export function parseRoute(hash: string): Route {
  const [path = "", query = ""] = hash.replace(/^#\/?/, "").split("?");
  const parts = path.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(decodeURIComponent);
  const params = new URLSearchParams(query);
  if (parts[0] !== "c" || !parts[1]) return { id: null, tab: "open", item: null, params };
  return { id: parts[1], tab: parts[2] ?? "info", item: parts[3] ?? null, params };
}

export function href(id: string, tab: string, item?: string | number | null, params?: Record<string, string>): string {
  let h = `#/c/${id}/${tab}`;
  if (item != null) h += `/${encodeURIComponent(String(item))}`;
  if (params && Object.keys(params).length) h += `?${new URLSearchParams(params)}`;
  return h;
}

export function useRoute(): Route {
  const [hash, setHash] = useState(location.hash);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = () => setHash(location.hash);
    addEventListener("hashchange", f);
    return () => removeEventListener("hashchange", f);
  }, []);
  return parseRoute(hash);
}

export function go(h: string, replace = false) {
  if (replace) history.replaceState(null, "", h);
  else location.hash = h;
  if (replace) dispatchEvent(new HashChangeEvent("hashchange"));
}

// ---- loading ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type Async<T> = { data: T | undefined; error: string | null; loading: boolean };

export function useAsync<T>(f: () => Promise<T> | null, deps: unknown[]): Async<T> {
  const [state, setState] = useState<Async<T>>({ data: undefined, error: null, loading: true });
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const p = f();
    if (!p) {
      setState({ data: undefined, error: null, loading: false });
      return;
    }
    setState(s => ({ data: s.data, error: null, loading: true }));
    p.then(
      data => live && setState({ data, error: null, loading: false }),
      e => live && setState({ data: undefined, error: String(e?.message ?? e), loading: false }),
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, deps);
  return state;
}

export function Loading({ state, children }: { state: Async<any>; children: () => ComponentChildren }) {
  if (state.error) return <div class="error">{state.error}</div>;
  if (state.data === undefined) return <div class="muted pad">loading…</div>;
  return <>{children()}</>;
}

// ---- values -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const f32 = new Float32Array(1);
const u32 = new Uint32Array(f32.buffer);
const i32 = new Int32Array(f32.buffer);

export function bitsToFloat(bits: number): number {
  u32[0] = bits >>> 0;
  return f32[0]!;
}

export function bitsToInt(bits: number): number {
  u32[0] = bits >>> 0;
  return i32[0]!;
}

export function hex(bits: number, width = 8): string {
  return `0x${(bits >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0")}`;
}

/** A float in at most 12 characters. */
export function float(f: number): string {
  if (Number.isNaN(f)) return "NaN";
  if (!Number.isFinite(f)) return f > 0 ? "inf" : "-inf";
  if (f === 0) return Object.is(f, -0) ? "-0" : "0";
  const plain = String(Number(f.toPrecision(8)));
  if (plain.length <= 12) return plain;
  return f.toExponential(4);
}

export type ValueMode = "auto" | "float" | "int" | "uint" | "hex";

/** A 4-byte constant shown as `mode` says; auto uses the reflected type, else float with hex for odd bits. */
export function word(bits: number, base: number | null, mode: ValueMode): string {
  switch (mode) {
    case "float": return float(bitsToFloat(bits));
    case "int": return String(bitsToInt(bits));
    case "uint": return String(bits >>> 0);
    case "hex": return hex(bits);
  }
  if (base === 1) return bits !== 0 ? "true" : "false";
  if (base === 2) return String(bitsToInt(bits));
  if (base === 19 || base === 20) return String(bits >>> 0);
  const f = bitsToFloat(bits);
  const e = (bits >>> 23) & 0xff;
  // Denormals and NaNs are rarely meant as floats: integers and packed bits look like that.
  if ((e === 0 && bits !== 0 && bits !== 0x80000000) || e === 0xff) return hex(bits);
  return float(f);
}

export function mib(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB`;
  return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB`;
}

export function short(hash: string | null | undefined, n = 12): string {
  return hash ? hash.slice(0, n) : "-";
}

/** JSON on one line, compact. */
export function compact(v: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(v, (_, x) => (typeof x === "number" && !Number.isInteger(x) ? Number(x.toPrecision(7)) : x))
    ?.replace(/,"/g, ", \"") ?? "";
}

// ---- Direct3D enums, for reading state descriptions ----------------------------------------------------------------

export const TOPOLOGY: Record<number, string> = {
  0: "undefined", 1: "point list", 2: "line list", 3: "line strip", 4: "triangle list", 5: "triangle strip",
  10: "line list adj", 11: "line strip adj", 12: "triangle list adj", 13: "triangle strip adj",
};
export function topologyName(t: number): string {
  if (t >= 33 && t <= 64) return `${t - 32} control point patch list`;
  return TOPOLOGY[t] ?? String(t);
}

export const CULL: Record<number, string> = { 1: "none", 2: "front", 3: "back" };
export const FILL: Record<number, string> = { 2: "wireframe", 3: "solid" };
export const COMPARISON: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "never", 2: "less", 3: "equal", 4: "less_equal", 5: "greater", 6: "not_equal", 7: "greater_equal", 8: "always",
};
export const BLEND: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "zero", 2: "one", 3: "src_color", 4: "inv_src_color", 5: "src_alpha", 6: "inv_src_alpha", 7: "dest_alpha",
  8: "inv_dest_alpha", 9: "dest_color", 10: "inv_dest_color", 11: "src_alpha_sat", 14: "blend_factor",
  15: "inv_blend_factor", 16: "src1_color", 17: "inv_src1_color", 18: "src1_alpha", 19: "inv_src1_alpha",
};
export const BLEND_OP: Record<number, string> = { 1: "add", 2: "subtract", 3: "rev_subtract", 4: "min", 5: "max" };
export const STENCIL_OP: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "keep", 2: "zero", 3: "replace", 4: "incr_sat", 5: "decr_sat", 6: "invert", 7: "incr", 8: "decr",
};
export const ADDRESS: Record<number, string> = { 1: "wrap", 2: "mirror", 3: "clamp", 4: "border", 5: "mirror_once" };

export function filterName(f: number): string {
  const kinds = ["", "comparison", "minimum", "maximum"];
  const reduction = kinds[(f >> 7) & 3] ?? "";
  if (f & 0x40) return `${reduction ? reduction + " " : ""}anisotropic`;
  const pt = (s: number) => ((f >> s) & 1 ? "linear" : "point");
  return `${reduction ? reduction + " " : ""}min ${pt(4)}, mag ${pt(2)}, mip ${pt(0)}`;
}

export function writeMask(m: number): string {
  if (m === 0) return "none";
  return ["r", "g", "b", "a"].filter((_, i) => m & (1 << i)).join("");
}
```

`viewer/test/cdp.ts`:

```ts
// A small headless-Chrome driver over the DevTools protocol, for checking the viewer in a real browser without a
// window. Its profile and screenshots go under viewer/.cache (screenshots of game captures are private).
//
//   const b = await Browser.launch();  const p = await b.page("http://localhost:5170/");
//   await p.eval("document.title");  await p.screenshot("x.png");  await b.close();

import { existsSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";

const CHROMES = [
  process.env.CHROME,
  "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe",
  "C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe",
  "/usr/bin/google-chrome",
  "/usr/bin/chromium",
];

export const shots = resolve(import.meta.dir, "../.cache/shots");

export class Page {
  private next = 1;
  private waiting = new Map<number, { ok: (v: any) => void; fail: (e: Error) => void }>();
  readonly console: string[] = [];

  constructor(private ws: WebSocket) {
    ws.addEventListener("message", ev => {
      const m = JSON.parse(String(ev.data));
      if (m.id && this.waiting.has(m.id)) {
        const w = this.waiting.get(m.id)!;
        this.waiting.delete(m.id);
        m.error ? w.fail(new Error(m.error.message)) : w.ok(m.result);
      } else if (m.method === "Runtime.consoleAPICalled") {
        this.console.push(`${m.params.type}: ${m.params.args.map((a: any) => a.value ?? a.description).join(" ")}`);
      } else if (m.method === "Runtime.exceptionThrown") {
        this.console.push(`exception: ${m.params.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? m.params.exceptionDetails.text}`);
      }
    });
  }

  send(method: string, params: object = {}): Promise<any> {
    const id = this.next++;
    return new Promise((ok, fail) => {
      this.waiting.set(id, { ok, fail });
      this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
    });
  }

  async eval<T = any>(expression: string): Promise<T> {
    const r = await this.send("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true });
    if (r.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(r.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? r.exceptionDetails.text);
    return r.result.value;
  }

  /** Waits until `expression` is truthy. */
  async until(expression: string, timeoutMs = 20000): Promise<any> {
    const end = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const v = await this.eval(expression).catch(() => null);
      if (v) return v;
      if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out waiting for ${expression}`);
      await Bun.sleep(100);
    }
  }

  async goto(url: string) {
    await this.send("Page.navigate", { url });
    await this.until("document.readyState === 'complete'");
  }

  async key(key: string, code = key, text = key.length === 1 ? key : undefined) {
    const vk: Record<string, number> = { Escape: 27, Enter: 13, ArrowDown: 40, ArrowUp: 38 };
    const base = { key, code, windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk[key] ?? key.toUpperCase().charCodeAt(0), text };
    await this.send("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "keyDown", ...base });
    await this.send("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "keyUp", ...base });
  }

  async mouse(type: "mouseMoved" | "mousePressed" | "mouseReleased" | "mouseWheel", x: number, y: number, extra: object = {}) {
    await this.send("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type, x, y, button: type === "mouseMoved" || type === "mouseWheel" ? "none" : "left", clickCount: 1, ...extra });
  }

  async click(x: number, y: number) {
    await this.mouse("mouseMoved", x, y);
    await this.mouse("mousePressed", x, y);
    await this.mouse("mouseReleased", x, y);
  }

  /** The centre of the first element matching `selector` (optionally whose text includes `text`). */
  async center(selector: string, text?: string): Promise<{ x: number; y: number }> {
    const r = await this.eval(`(() => {
      const els = [...document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)})];
      const el = els.find(e => ${JSON.stringify(text ?? "")} === "" || e.textContent.includes(${JSON.stringify(text ?? "")}));
      if (!el) return null;
      el.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
      const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 };
    })()`);
    if (!r) throw new Error(`no ${selector}${text ? ` with "${text}"` : ""}`);
    return r;
  }

  async clickOn(selector: string, text?: string) {
    const { x, y } = await this.center(selector, text);
    await this.click(x, y);
  }

  async screenshot(name: string): Promise<string> {
    mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true });
    const r = await this.send("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png" });
    const path = join(shots, name);
    await Bun.write(path, Buffer.from(r.data, "base64"));
    return path;
  }
}

export class Browser {
  private constructor(private proc: Bun.Subprocess, private port: number) {}

  static async launch(width = 1600, height = 1000): Promise<Browser> {
    const exe = CHROMES.find(c => c && existsSync(c));
    if (!exe) throw new Error("no Chrome or Edge found (set CHROME)");
    const profile = resolve(import.meta.dir, "../.cache/chrome-profile");
    mkdirSync(profile, { recursive: true });
    const port = 9300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500);
    const proc = Bun.spawn([exe, "--headless=new", `--remote-debugging-port=${port}`, `--user-data-dir=${profile}`,
      `--window-size=${width},${height}`, "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check", "--disable-extensions", "about:blank"],
      { stdout: "ignore", stderr: "ignore", windowsHide: true });
    const b = new Browser(proc, port);
    const end = Date.now() + 15000;
    for (;;) {
      try {
        await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/version`);
        break;
      } catch {
        if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error("Chrome did not start");
        await Bun.sleep(200);
      }
    }
    return b;
  }

  async page(url: string): Promise<Page> {
    const targets = (await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/json/list`)).json()) as any[];
    const t = targets.find(t => t.type === "page");
    const ws = new WebSocket(t.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
    await new Promise((ok, fail) => { ws.onopen = ok; ws.onerror = fail; });
    const p = new Page(ws);
    await p.send("Runtime.enable");
    await p.send("Page.enable");
    await p.goto(url);
    return p;
  }

  async close() {
    this.proc.kill();
    await this.proc.exited;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { deflateSync } from "node:zlib";
import { decodePng, encodePng, selectChannels } from "../server/png";

test("encode then decode gives the same pixels", () => {
  const rgba = new Uint8Array(5 * 3 * 4).map((_, i) => (i * 37) & 255);
  const p = decodePng(encodePng(5, 3, rgba));
  expect([p.width, p.height]).toEqual([5, 3]);
  expect(p.rgba).toEqual(rgba);
});

test("every row filter is undone", () => {
  // One 2x5 RGB picture, each row written with a different filter (0 none, 1 sub, 2 up, 3 average, 4 paeth).
  const w = 2, bpp = 3, stride = w * bpp;
  const px = [...Array(5)].map((_, y) => [...Array(stride)].map((_, i) => (y * 50 + i * 23) & 255));
  const paeth = (a: number, b: number, c: number) => {
    const p = a + b - c, pa = Math.abs(p - a), pb = Math.abs(p - b), pc = Math.abs(p - c);
    return pa <= pb && pa <= pc ? a : pb <= pc ? b : c;
  };
  const raw: number[] = [];
  px.forEach((row, y) => {
    raw.push(y);
    row.forEach((v, i) => {
      const a = i >= bpp ? row[i - bpp]! : 0, b = y ? px[y - 1]![i]! : 0, c = y && i >= bpp ? px[y - 1]![i - bpp]! : 0;
      const pred = [0, a, b, (a + b) >> 1, paeth(a, b, c)][y]!;
      raw.push((v - pred) & 255);
    });
  });
  const png = encodePng(w, 5, new Uint8Array(w * 5 * 4));
  // Swap in an RGB header and the filtered data.
  const ihdrType = 8 + 8 + 9;
  png[ihdrType] = 2;
  const head = png.subarray(0, 8 + 25);
  const p = decodePng(withIdat(head, new Uint8Array(deflateSync(new Uint8Array(raw)))));
  for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++)
      expect([...p.rgba.subarray((y * w + x) * 4, (y * w + x) * 4 + 4)]).toEqual([...px[y]!.slice(x * 3, x * 3 + 3), 255]);
});

/** The reader does not check CRCs, so a header and an IDAT can be put together by hand. */
function withIdat(head: Uint8Array, idat: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(head.length + 12 + idat.length + 12);
  out.set(head);
  const v = new DataView(out.buffer);
  v.setUint32(head.length, idat.length);
  out.set(new TextEncoder().encode("IDAT"), head.length + 4);
  out.set(idat, head.length + 8);
  const end = head.length + 12 + idat.length;
  out.set(new TextEncoder().encode("IEND"), end + 4);
  return out;
}

test("channels: rgb drops alpha, one channel is grey, rgba is as it was", () => {
  const px = new Uint8Array([10, 20, 30, 0, 200, 100, 50, 128]);
  expect([...selectChannels(px, "rgb")]).toEqual([10, 20, 30, 255, 200, 100, 50, 255]);
  expect([...selectChannels(px, "g")]).toEqual([20, 20, 20, 255, 100, 100, 100, 255]);
  expect([...selectChannels(px, "a")]).toEqual([0, 0, 0, 255, 128, 128, 128, 255]);
  expect(selectChannels(px, "rgba")).toBe(px);
});
```
